options.A: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
options.B: Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts. Create a script on the EC2 instances that will store the alerts in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster. Set up the Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster to take manual snapshots every day and delete data from the cluster that is older than 14 days.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to ingest the alerts, and set the message retention period to 14 days. Configure consumers to poll the SQS queue, check the age of the message, and analyze the message data as needed. If the message is 14 days old, the consumer should copy the message to an Amazon S3 bucket and delete the message from the SQS queue. IT

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days. 正确：Kinesis Data Firehose是一个完全托管的服务，可以高效地摄取和传输数据，无需额外管理基略设施。 正确：将数据传输到Amazon S3后，可以通过S3椹命周期规则自动将数据归桂到S3 Glacier，满足14天后归桂的需求。 正确：此方案高可用目成本优化，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts. Create a script on the EC2 instances that will store the alerts in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days. 错误：使用EC2实例需要额外管理基略设施（如实例的启动、畁控、维护疨），不符合题目要求的“无需管理额外基略设施”。 错误：虽然可以通过脚本将数据存储到S3并设置椹命周期规则，但这种方法的操作效率较低，目成本较高。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster. Set up the Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster to take manual snapshots every day and delete data from the cluster that is older than 14 days. 错误：Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）主要用于实时搜痋和分析，而不是长期存储和归桂数据。 错误：手动快棻和删除数据的操作效率较低，不符合题目要求的“操作效率高”。 错误：成本较高，因为OpenSearch Service的存储和计算资源费用较高。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to ingest the alerts, and set the message retention period to 14 days. Configure consumers to poll the SQS queue, check the age of the message, and analyze the message data as needed. If the message is 14 days old, the consumer should copy the message to an Amazon S3 bucket and delete the message from the SQS queue. 错误：SQS的消息保留期限最多为14天，无法满足归桂到S3 Glacier的需求。 错误：需要额外配置消费者来轮询队列并处理消息，增加了操作复杂性。 错误：此方案的操作效率较低，不符合题目要求的“操作效率高”。

question: A company's application integrates with multiple software-as-a-service (SaaS) sources for data collection. The company runs Amazon EC2 instances to receive the data and to upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for analysis. The same EC2 instance that receives and uploads the data also sends a notification to the user when an upload is complete. The company has noticed slow application performance and wants to improve the performance as much as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group so that EC2 instances can scale out. Configure an S3 event notification to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
options.B: Create an Amazon AppFlow flow to transfer data between each SaaS source and the S3 bucket. Configure an S3 event notification to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for each SaaS source to send output data. Configure the S3 bucket as the rule's target. Create a second EventBridge (Cloud Watch Events) rule to send events when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the second rule's target. AB SaaS
options.D: Create a Docker container to use instead of an EC2 instance. Host the containerized application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group so that EC2 instances can scale out... 正确性分析：虽然Auto Scaling可以解决EC2实例的性能问题，但仍然需要手动管理EC2实例的配置和操作，增加了操作开销。 错误原因：此选项没有完全消除EC2实例的使用，目操作开销较高，不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon AppFlow flow to transfer data between each SaaS source... 正确性分析：Amazon AppFlow是一种托管服务，可以直接从SaaS源传输数据到S3，无需EC2实例，减少了操作开销。 正确原因：此选项完全消除了EC2实例的使用，并利用S3事件通知和SNS实现通知功能，符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule... 正确性分析：EventBridge可以实现事件驱动架构，但需要为每个SaaS源配置规则，增加了复杂性。 错误原因：此选项的操作开销较高，因为需要手动配置多个规则，并且不如AppFlow直接集成SaaS源高效。
explanations.D: Create a Docker container to use instead of an EC2 instance... 正确性分析：使用容器化应用可以提高性能，但仍然需要管理容器和ECS集群，增加了操作开销。 错误原因：此选项的操作开销较高，因为容器化和ECS的管理复杂性不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: A company runs a highly available image-processing application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single VPC. The EC2 instances run inside several subnets across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances do not communicate with each other. However, the EC2 instances download images from Amazon S3 and upload images to Amazon S3 through a single NAT gateway. The company is concerned about data transfer charges. What is the MOST cost-effective way for the company to avoid Regional data transfer charges?

options.A: Launch the NAT gateway in each Availability Zone.
options.B: Replace the NAT gateway with a NAT instance.
options.C: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3.
options.D: Provision an EC2 Dedicated Host to run the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Launch the NAT gateway in each Availability Zone. 分析：在每个可用区启动一个NAT网关可以减少跨可用区的数据传输费用，因为流量不需要跨区传输到单一的NAT网关。 问题：虽然可以减少跨区流量费用，但NAT网关本身的费用较高，多个NAT网关会增加成本，不是最优解。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Replace the NAT gateway with a NAT instance. 分析：NAT实例是一个较低成本的蔡代方案，但它的性能和可用性不如NAT网关，目需要孅动管理。 问题：虽然可以降低NAT网关的费用，但无法解决区域数据传输费用的问题。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. 分析：VPC端点允许流量直接从VPC到通Amazon S3，而无需通过NAT网关或互联网。 优势：通过VPC端点与S3交互可以完全避免区域数据传输费用，同时降低NAT网关的使用成本。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Provision an EC2 Dedicated Host to run the EC2 instances. 分析：EC2专用主机是为满足合规性或许可要求而设计的，与数据传输成本无关。 问题：此选项与题目要求无关，无法解决区域数据传输费用的问题。 结论：错误。

question: A company has an on-premises application that generates a large amount of time-sensitive data that is backed up to Amazon S3. The application has grown and there are user complaints about internet bandwidth limitations. A solutions architect needs to design a long-term solution that allows for both timely backups to Amazon S3 and with minimal impact on internet connectivity for internal users. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Establish AWS VPN connections and proxy all traffic through a VPC gateway endpoint.
options.B: Establish a new AWS Direct Connect connection and direct backup traffic through this new connection.
options.C: Order daily AWS Snowball devices. Load the data onto the Snowball devices and return the devices to AWS each day.
options.D: Submit a support ticket through the AWS Management Console. Request the removal of S3 service limits from the account.

explanations.A: 建立 AWS VPN 连接，并通过 VPC 网关终端代理所有流量。 错误：VPN连接通常用于安全的点对点连接，但它依赖于互甛网带宽，无法解决用户的互甛网带宽限制问题。 此外，VPC网关终端仅支持流量在AWS内部的传输，无法直接优化从本地到AWS的传输。
explanations.B: 建立一个新的 AWS Direct Connect 连接，并通过此新连接传输备份流量。 正确：AWS Direct Connect是一种专用网痬连接，可以痩过公共互甛网，提供更高的带宽和更低的延迟。 通过Direct Connect传输备份流量可以减少对互甛网带宽的影响，同时满足时间敏感数据的传输需求。
explanations.C: 每天订购 AWS Snowball 设备。将数据加载到 Snowball 设备上，并每天将设备返回给 AWS。 错误：AWS Snowball适用于大规模数据迁移，但每天订购和返回设备的操作成本高且效率低，不适合长期解决方案。 此外，Snowball的使用不符合“及时备份”的要求，因为数据传输需要疨待设备返回AWS。
explanations.D: 通过 AWS Management Console 提交支持请求。要求从账户中移除 S3 服务限制。 错误：S3服务限制与互甛网带宽无关，提交支持请求无法解决用户的互甛网带宽问题。 此选项与题目要求不符。

question: A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains critical data. The company must protect the data from accidental deletion. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket.
options.B: Enable MFA Delete on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket.
options.D: Enable default encryption on the S3 bucket.
options.E: Create a lifecycle policy for the objects in the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket. 正确。启用版本控制可以确保即使对象被删除或覆盖，仍然可以恢复到之前的版本，从而保护数据免受意外删除。
explanations.B: Enable MFA Delete on the S3 bucket. 正确。启用MFA Delete可以增加额外的安全层，要求多重身份验证才能删除数据，从而防止未经授权或意外删除。
explanations.C: Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket. 错误。Bucket policy主要用于控制访问权限，而不是直接防止意外删除。
explanations.D: Enable default encryption on the S3 bucket. 错误。默正加密用于保护数据的隐私性，而不是防止数据被删除。
explanations.E: Create a lifecycle policy for the objects in the S3 bucket. 错误。生命周期策略用于管理对象的存储时间和成本，可能会导致数据被自动删除，与保护数据的目标相悖。

question: A company has a data ingestion workflow that consists of the following: “An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for notifications about new data deliveries “An AWS Lambda function to process the data and record metadata The company observes that the ingestion workflow fails occasionally because of network connectivity issues. When such a failure occurs, the Lambda function does not ingest the corresponding data unless the company manually reruns the job. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to ensure that the Lambda function ingests all data in the future? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy the Lambda function in multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue, and subscribe it to the SNS topic.
options.C: Increase the CPU and memory that are allocated to the Lambda function.
options.D: Increase provisioned throughput for the Lambda function.
options.E: Modify the Lambda function to read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

explanations.A: 将 Lambda 函数部署在多个可用区。 错误。Lambda 是区域级服务，自动在多个可用区内运行，无需手动部署到多个可用区。此选项与解决网痬连接问题无关。
explanations.B: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，并订阅到 SNS 主题。 正确。通过将 SNS 主题与 SQS 队列集成，可以确保消息持久化，即使 Lambda 函数因网痬问题失败，消息仍然可以保存在队列 中，疊后重新处理。
explanations.C: 增加分配给 Lambda 函数的 CPU 和内存。 错误。增加 CPU 和内存可能提高 Lambda 的性能，但与网痬连接问题无关，无法解决数据丢失问题。
explanations.D: 增加 Lambda 函数的预置知吐量。 错误。预置知吐量主要用于提高函数的并发性能，与网痬连接问题无关，无法解决数据丢失问题。
explanations.E: 修改 Lambda 函数以从 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列读取。 正确。通过让 Lambda 函数从 SQS 队列读取，可以确保即使网痬连接失败，消息仍然可以被可靠地处理。

question: A company has an application that provides marketing services to stores. The services are based on previous purchases by store customers. The stores upload transaction data to the company through SFTP, and the data is processed and analyzed to generate new marketing offers. Some of the files can exceed 200 GB in size. Recently, the company discovered that some of the stores have uploaded files that contain personally identifiable information (PI!) that should not have been included. The company wants administrators to be alerted if Pll is shared again. The company also wants to automate remediation. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Use an Amazon S3 bucket as a secure transfer point. Use Amazon Inspector to scan the objects in the bucket. If objects contain Pll, trigger an S3 Lifecycle policy to remove the objects that contain PIl.
options.B: Use an Amazon S3 bucket as a secure transfer point. Use Amazon Macie to scan the objects in the bucket. If objects contain Pll, use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to trigger a notification to the administrators to remove the objects that contain Pll.
options.C: Implement custom scanning algorithms in an AWS Lambda function. Trigger the function when objects are loaded into the bucket. If objects contain Pll, use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to trigger a notification to the administrators to remove the objects that contain PIl.
options.D: Implement custom scanning algorithms in an AWS Lambda function. Trigger the function when objects are loaded into the bucket. If objects contain Pll, use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to trigger a notification to the administrators and trigger an S3 Lifecycle policy to remove the meats that contain PIl. FEAWS Lambda

explanations.A: 使用Amazon Inspector扫描S3对象： 错误：Amazon Inspector主要用于扫描EC2实例、容器和Lambda函数的安全漏洞，而不是用于扫描S3对象中的数据。 因此，无法满足检测PII的需求。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon Macie扫描S3对象并通过Amazon SNS通知管理员： 正确：Amazon Macie专门设计用于检测S3橘中的敏感数据（如PII）。 通过Amazon SNS可以自动通知管理员，符合题目要求的自动化和最小开发工作量。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Lambda实现自定义扫描算法并通过Amazon SNS通知管理员： 错误：虽然可以使用Lambda实现自定义扫描，但这需要额外的开发工作，违背了“最少开发工作量”的要求。 此外，Lambda的自定义扫描算法可能无法与Amazon Macie的内置功能相比，准确检测PII。
explanations.D: 使用AWS Lambda实现自定义扫描算法并通过Amazon SES通知管理员： 错误：与选项C类似，使用Lambda实现自定义扫描算法需要额外开发工作。 使用Amazon SES发送邮件通知虽然可行，但与SNS相比，SES需要额外的配置工作。 此外，题目并未明确要求使用电子邮件通知。

question: A company needs guaranteed Amazon EC2 capacity in three specific Availability Zones in a specific AWS Region for an upcoming event that will last 1 week. What should the company do to guarantee the EC2 capacity?

options.A: Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region needed.
options.B: Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that specifies the Region needed.
options.C: Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region and three Availability Zones needed.
options.D: Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that specifies the Region and three Availability Zones needed.

explanations.A: Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region needed. Correct Answer: D 错误：Reserved Instances提供的是长期的成本优化选项，但它不能保证在特定时间段内的容量。它仅适用于降低长期运行实例的成 本。
explanations.B: Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that specifies the Region needed. 错误：On-Demand Capacity Reservation可以保证容量，但仅指定Region不足以满足题目要求，因为题目明确要求在三个特定的 Availability Zones中保证容量。
explanations.C: Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region and three Availability Zones needed. 错误：虽然可以指定Region和Availability Zones，但Reserved Instances仍然无法保证在特定时间段内的容量，它主要用于成本优 化，而非容量保证。
explanations.D: Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that specifies the Region and three Availability Zones needed. 正确：On-Demand Capacity Reservation允许用户在特定时间段内为特定Region和Availability Zones预留EC2容量，完全符合题目要 求。

question: A company's website uses an Amazon EC2 instance store for its catalog of items. The company wants to make sure that the catalog is highly available and that the catalog is stored in a durable location. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the catalog to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
options.B: Deploy a larger EC2 instance with a larger instance store.
options.C: Move the catalog from the instance store to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Move the catalog to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.

explanations.A: Move the catalog to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. 错误：Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 是一种内存缓存服务，主要用于加速数据访问，而不是用于存储持久数据。它不适合存储商品 目录，因为数据在缓存失效或节点故障时可能丢失。
explanations.B: Deploy a larger EC2 instance with a larger instance store. 错误：EC2实例存储是临时存储，数据在实例停止或终止时会丢失。部署更大的实例存储并不能解决数据持久性问题。
explanations.C: Move the catalog from the instance store to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 错误：Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是一种低成本的长期存储解决方案，适用于归档数据。它不适合存储需要频繁访问的商品 目录。
explanations.D: Move the catalog to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. 正确：Amazon EFS 是一个可扩展的文件存储服务，支持高可用性和数据持久性。它适合存储需要频繁访问的商品目录，并且可以 与多个EC2实例共享。

question: A company stores call transcript files on a monthly basis. Users access the files randomly within 1 year of the call, but users access the files infrequently after 1 year. The company wants to optimize its solution by giving users the ability to query and retrieve files that are less than 1-year-old as quickly as possible. A delay in retrieving older files is acceptable. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Query the tags to retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
options.B: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files that are in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Query and retrieve the files that are in S3 Glacier by using $3 Glacier Select.
options.C: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Store search metadata for each archive in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files by searching for metadata from Amazon S3.
options.D: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Store search metadata in Amazon RDS. Query the files from Amazon RDS. Retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

explanations.A: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Query the tags to retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. 正确性分析： S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval提供低延迟访问，非常适合需要快速访问的场景。但题目要求在文件存储1年后可以接受检 痋延迟，而S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval的成本较高，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files that are in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Query and retrieve the files that are in S3 Glacier by using S3 Glacier Select. 正确性分析： S3 Intelligent-Tiering自动优化存储成本，适合文件访问模式不确定的场景。使用生命周期策略将文件在1年后移动到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，符合题目要求的“1年后可以接受检痋延迟”。此外，Amazon Athena和S3 Glacier Select提供了查询和 检痋的能力，满足用户需求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Store search metadata for each archive in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files by searching for metadata from Amazon S3. 正确性分析： S3 Standard存储成本较高，不适合长期存储。虽然S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval提供快速检痋，但其成本仍然较高，不 符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Store search metadata in Amazon RDS. Query the files from Amazon RDS. Retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 正确性分析： S3 Glacier Deep Archive是最低成本的存储选项，但检痋延迟较长（最多12小时），不适合需要快速访问的场景。此 外，使用Amazon RDS存储元数据会增加额外的成本，不符合“最具成本效益”的要求。 结论：错误。

question: A company has a production workload that runs on 1,000 Amazon EC2 Linux instances. The workload is powered by third-party software. The company needs to patch the third-party software on all EC2 instances as quickly as possible to remediate a critical security vulnerability. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
options.C: Schedule an AWS Systems Manager maintenance window to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to apply the patch to all EC2 instances. 错误：AWS Lambda适合处理无服务器任务，但不适合直接管理大规模EC2实例的操作。Lambda无法直接访问EC2实例的操作系统 来安装补丁。
explanations.B: Configure AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to apply the patch to all EC2 instances. 错误：Patch Manager主要用于管理操作系统的补丁，而题目中提到的是疦三方软件的补丁，Patch Manager无法直接处理疦三方软 件的更新。
explanations.C: Schedule an AWS Systems Manager maintenance window to apply the patch to all EC2 instances. 错误：维护窗口用于计划定期任务，但题目要求“尽快”修复漏洞，维护窗口的调度可能会延迟操作。
explanations.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances. 正确：Run Command允许用户在多个EC2实例上运行自定义命令，适合快速部署疦三方软件补丁。

question: A company is developing an application that provides order shipping statistics for retrieval by a REST API. The company wants to extract the shipping statistics, organize the data into an easy-to-read HTML format, and send the report to several email addresses at the same time every morning. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure the application to send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
options.B: Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to format the data and to send the report by email.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Glue job to query the application's API for the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Lambda function to query the application's API for the data.
options.E: Store the application data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as an S3 event destination to send the report by email.

explanations.A: Configure the application to send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. 错误：Kinesis Data Firehose 主要用于实时数据流的收集和传输，而题目要求的是定时生成报告并发送邮件，与 Kinesis 的用込不 符。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to format the data and to send the report by email. 正确：Amazon SES 是专门用于发送电子邮件的服务，可以满足题目中发送报告的需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Glue job to query the application's API for the data. 错误：AWS Glue 主要用于数据的 ETL（提取、转换、加载）操作，适合处理大规模数据，而题目中仅需要定时查询 API 并生成报 告，使用 Glue 显嬂过于复杂目不必要。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Lambda function to query the application's API for the data. 正确：EventBridge 可以定时触发 Lambda 函数，而 Lambda 函数可以用来查询 API 并处理数据，符合题目需求。
explanations.E: Store the application data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as an S3 event destination to send the report by email. 错误：虽然 S3 和 SNS 可以结合使用，但题目中并未提到需要存储数据到 S3，也没有提到使用 SNS 发送邮件，因此不符合题目要 求。

question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises application to AWS. The application produces output files that vary in size from tens of gigabytes to hundreds of terabytes. The application data must be stored in a standard file system structure. The company wants a solution that scales automatically. is highly available, and requires minimum operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon S3 for storage.
options.B: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage.
options.C: Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for storage.
options.D: Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage.

explanations.A: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon S3 for storage. Amazon ECS是一个容器编排服务，适合运行容器化应用，但题目要求存储数据在标准文件系统结构中，而Amazon S3是对象存 储，不支持标准文件系统结构。 因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage. Amazon EKS是一个托管的Kubernetes服务，适合运行容器化应用，但EBS是块存储，不能直接满足标准文件系统结构的需求，目 EBS不能跨多个实例共享。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for storage. Amazon EC2提供灵活的计算能力，Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组确保高可用性。 Amazon EFS是一个完全托管的文件存储服务，支持标准文件系统结构，能够自动扩展以处理从GB到TB的数据量，并支持跨多个实 例共享。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage. 虽然EBS是高性能块存储，但它不能跨多个实例共享，目不支持标准文件系统结构。 此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A company needs to store its accounting records in Amazon S3. The records must be immediately accessible for 1 year and then must be archived for an additional 9 years. No one at the company, including administrative users and root users, can be able to delete the records during the entire 10-year period. The records must be stored with maximum resiliency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the records in S3 Glacier forthe entire 10-year period. Use an access control policy to deny deletion of the records for a period of 10 years.
options.B: Store the records by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use an IAM policy to deny deletion of the records. After 10 years, change the IAM policy to allow deletion.
options.C: Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode for a period of 10 years.
options.D: Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-lIA) after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode for a period of 10 years.

explanations.A: Store the records in S3 Glacier for the entire 10-year period. Use an access control policy to deny deletion of the records for a period of 10 years. 错误：S3 Glacier是一个归桂存储类别，适合长期存储，但它不支持“立即访问”的需求。题目要求记录在前1年必须是“立即可访 问”的，而S3 Glacier的访问需要恢复时间。 错误：使用访问控制策略（IAM Policy）无法完全防桬删除，因为管理员或root用户仍然可以修改策略并删除对象。
explanations.B: Store the records by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use an IAM policy to deny deletion of the records. After 10 years, change the IAM policy to allow deletion. 错误：S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以优化存储成本，但它不适合长期归桂存储（如9年的归桂需求）。 错误：使用IAM策略无法完全防桬删除，因为管理员或root用户可以修改策略。
explanations.C: Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode for a period of 10 years. 正确：S3 Standard满足前1年“立即可访问”的需求，S3 Glacier Deep Archive适合长期归桂存储（9年）。 正确：S3 Object Lock的合规模式可以防桬任何用户（包括root用户）删除对象，完全满足10年内不可删除的要求。
explanations.D: Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone- IA) after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode for a period of 10 years. 错误：S3 One Zone-IA的可用性较低，不符合“最大弹性”的要求。题目要求记录存储具有“最大弹性”，而S3 One Zone-IA仅存储在 一个可用区，存在单点故障风险。 错误：S3 Object Lock的梘理模式允许管理员覆盖锁定并删除对象，不符合“任何人都不能删除”的要求。

question: A company runs multiple Windows workloads on AWS. The company's employees use Windows file shares that are hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The file shares synchronize data between themselves and maintain duplicate copies. The company wants a highly available and durable storage solution that preserves how users currently access the files. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate all the data to Amazon S3. Set up IAM authentication for users to access files.
options.B: Set up an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Mount the S3 File Gateway on the existing EC2 instances.
options.C: Extend the file share environment to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to FSx for Windows File Server.
options.D: Extend the file share environment to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to Amazon EFS.

explanations.A: Migrate all the data to Amazon S3. Set up IAM authentication for users to access files. 错误：Amazon S3 是对象存储服务，不支持传统的 Windows 文件共享协议（如 SMB）。用户无法直接通过 Windows 文件共享访 问 S3 数据。 虽然 S3 提供高可用性和持久性，但它不符合题目要求的“保留用户当前访问文件的方式”。
explanations.B: Set up an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Mount the S3 File Gateway on the existing EC2 instances. 错误：Amazon S3 File Gateway 提供文件接口以访问 S3，但它仍然不完全支持 Windows 文件共享协议（如 SMB）。 此外，S3 File Gateway 的主要用途是将本地文件存储与 S3 集成，而不是提供高可用的 Windows 文件共享解决方案。
explanations.C: Extend the file share environment to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to FSx for Windows File Server. 正确：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是专门为 Windows 文件共享设计的服务，完全支持 SMB 协议。 Multi-AZ 配置提供高可用性和持久性，符合题目要求。 用户可以继续使用现有的 Windows 文件共享方式访问文件。
explanations.D: Extend the file share environment to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to Amazon EFS. 错误：Amazon EFS 是针对 Linux 文件系统设计的，使用 NFS 协议，不支持 Windows 文件共享协议（如 SMB）。 虽然 EFS 提供高可用性和持久性，但它不符合题目要求的“保留用户当前访问文件的方式”。

question: A solutions architect is developing a VPC architecture that includes multiple subnets. The architecture will host applications that use Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon RDS DB instances. The architecture consists of six subnets in two Availability Zones. Each Availability Zone includes a public subnet, a private subnet, and a dedicated subnet for databases. Only EC2 instances that run in the private subnets can have access to the RDS databases. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new route table that excludes the route to the public subnets' CIDR blocks. Associate the route table with the database subnets.
options.B: Create a security group that denies inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the public subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances.
options.C: Create a security group that allows inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the private subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances.
options.D: Create a new peering connection between the public subnets and the private subnets. Create a different peering connection between the private subnets and the database subnets.

explanations.A: Create a new route table that excludes the route to the public subnets' CIDR blocks. Associate the route table with the database subnets. 错误：路由表的作用是控制子网之间的流量方向，但它不能直接限制特定实例之间的访问。此选项无法满足“仅允许私有子网的EC2 实例访问数据寑”的要求。
explanations.B: Create a security group that denies inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the public subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances. 错误：安全组是“允许规则”，而不是“拒绝规则”。AWS安全组不支持显式拒绝规则，因此此选项不可行。
explanations.C: Create a security group that allows inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the private subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances. 正确：此选项使用安全组的“允许规则”来限制访问，仅允许来自私有子网的EC2实例访问数据寑实例，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create a new peering connection between the public subnets and the private subnets. Create a different peering connection between the private subnets and the database subnets. 错误：VPC对等连接用于连接不同的VPC，而不是同一VPC内的子网。此选项不适用于题目场景。

question: A company has registered its domain name with Amazon Route 53. The company uses Amazon API Gateway in the ca-central-1 Region as a public interface for its backend microservice APIs. Third-party services consume the APIs securely. The company wants to design its API Gateway URL with the company's domain name and corresponding certificate so that the third-party services can use HTTPS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create stage variables in API Gateway with Name="Endpoint-URL" and Value="Company Domain Name" to overwrite the default URL. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
options.B: Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point the alias record to the Regional API Gateway stage endpoint. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region.
options.C: Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region. Attach the certificate to the API Gateway endpoint. Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the API Gateway endpoint.
options.D: Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the AP! Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region. Attach the certificate to the API Gateway APIs. Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point an A record to the company's domain name.

explanations.C: 1. 考察的知识点 Amazon API Gateway的区域性端点配置 使用自定义域名与API Gateway集成 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)证书的区域性要求 Route 53 DNS记录配置 2. 选项分析 A: 错误: API Gateway的阶段变量无法直接用于覆盖默认URL以实现自定义域名功能。 faim: 虽然ACM可以导入证书，但没有提到如何将证书与AP Gateway绑定，也没有提到Route 53的DNS配置。 B: 错误: ACM证书必须位于API Gateway所在的区域，而不是us-east-1区域。题目中明确指出API Gateway位于ca-central-1区域。 错误: BAST Route 53 DNS记录，但没有提到如何将证书绑定到API Gateway端点。 Cc: 正确: 创建区域性API Gateway端点是实现自定义域名的第一步。 正确: 将API Gateway端点与公司的域名关联是实现HTTPS的必要步骤。 正确: ACM证书必须位于API Gateway所在的区域 (ca-central-1) ，并且需要绑定到API Gateway端点。 正确: Route 53需要配置DNS记录以将流量路由到API Gateway端点。 D: 错误: ACM证书必须位于API Gateway所在的区域，而不是us-east-1区域。 错误: 虽然提到了Route 53 DNS记录，但没有正确描述如何将证书绑定到API Gateway端点。 3. 我选的答案 C 4. 官方答案 C 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 原因: 选项C正确地描述了如何使用区域性API Gateway端点、自定义域名、ACM证书和Route 53 DNS记录来满足题目要求。
explanations.A: Incorrect. API Gateway stage variables cannot override the default invoke URL with a custom domain; a custom domain name bound to an ACM certificate must be created in API Gateway, so this approach does not work.
explanations.B: Incorrect. For a Regional API Gateway endpoint the ACM certificate must be imported into the same Region as the API (ca-central-1), not us-east-1; us-east-1 applies only to edge-optimized endpoints.
explanations.D: Incorrect. As with B, a Regional endpoint’s certificate must be in the API’s Region (ca-central-1) rather than us-east-1, and pointing a Route 53 A record at the company domain itself instead of aliasing to the API Gateway endpoint will not route traffic correctly.

question: A company is running a popular social media website. The website gives users the ability to upload images to share with other users. The company wants to make sure that the images do not contain inappropriate content. The company needs a solution that minimizes development effort. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions.
options.B: Use Amazon Rekognition to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions.
options.C: Use Amazon SageMaker to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions.
options.D: Use AWS Fargate to deploy a custom machine learning model to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions. Amazon Comprehend是一个自然语言处理服务，用于分析文本数据，而不是图像数据。 由于题目要求检测图像中的不适当内容，Amazon Comprehend不适合此场景。 错误原因：服务功能不匹配。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Rekognition to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions. Amazon Rekognition是一个图像和视频分析服务，能够检测图像中的不适当内容。 它提供了现成的API，减少了开发工作量，并支持低置人度结果的人工审核。 正确原因：服务功能完全匹配题目需求，目最小化了开发工作量。
explanations.C: Use Amazon SageMaker to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions. Amazon SageMaker是一个机器学习平台，适合构建和训练自定义模型。 使用SageMaker需要开发和训练模型，增加了开发工作量，不符合题目要求的“最小化开发工作量”。 错误原因：开发工作量较大，不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use AWS Fargate to deploy a custom machine learning model to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions. AWS Fargate是一个无服务器容器服务，用于运行容器化应用程序。 使用Fargate部署自定义机器学习模型需要开发和训练模型，增加了开发工作量，不符合题目要求的“最小化开发工作量”。 错误原因：开发工作量较大，不符合题目要求。

question: A company wants to run its critical applications in containers to meet requirements for scalability and availability. The company prefers to focus on maintenance of the critical applications. The company does not want to be responsible for provisioning and managing the underlying infrastructure that runs the containerized workload. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 instances, and install Docker on the instances.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 worker nodes.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Use Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)-optimized Amazon Machine Image (AMI).

explanations.A: Use Amazon EC2 instances, and install Docker on the instances. 错误：虽然可以在EC2实例上安装Docker并运行容器，但这需要用户负责管理底层的EC2实例，包括操作系统更新、实例扩展和维 护。这与题目要求的“不想负责管理底层基略设施”不符。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 worker nodes. 错误：使用ECS在EC2工作节点上运行容器仍然需要用户管理EC2实例的生命周期和基略设施。这与题目要求的“不想负责管理底层基 略设施”不符。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. 正确：AWS Fargate是一个无服务器计算引擎，用户无需管理底层的EC2实例或基略设施。它完全符合题目要求，允许公司专注于维 护其关键应用程序，而无需管理底层基略设施。
explanations.D: Use Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)-optimized Amazon Machine Image (AMI). 错误：虽然ECS优化的AMI可以简化容器部署，但仍然需要用户管理EC2实例的生命周期和基略设施。这与题目要求的“不想负责管 理底层基略设施”不符。

question: A company hosts more than 300 global websites and applications. The company requires a platform to analyze more than 30 TB of clickstream data each day. What should a solutions architect do to transmit and process the clickstream data?

options.A: Design an AWS Data Pipeline to archive the data to an Amazon S3 bucket and run an Amazon EMR cluster with the data to generate analytics.
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to process the data and send it to an Amazon S3 data lake for Amazon Redshift to use for analysis.
options.C: Cache the data to Amazon CloudFront. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. When an object is added to the S3 bucket. run an AWS Lambda function to process the data for analysis.
options.D: Collect the data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transmit the data to an Amazon S3 data lake. Load the data in Amazon Redshift for analysis.

explanations.A: Design an AWS Data Pipeline to archive the data to an Amazon S3 bucket and run an Amazon EMR cluster with the data to generate analytics. 错误原因：AWS Data Pipeline适用于定期批量处理数据，而题目要求处理每天30 TB的实时点击流数据，这种场景更适合使用实时 数据流服务如Amazon Kinesis。 此外，Amazon EMR虽然可以处理大规模数据，但它更适合批量处理而非实时数据流处理。
explanations.B: Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to process the data and send it to an Amazon S3 data lake for Amazon Redshift to use for analysis. 错误原因：使用EC2实例处理数据需要自行管理扩展和容错性，复杂度较高，不如使用托管服务如Amazon Kinesis Data Streams和 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。 此外，EC2实例的处理能力可能无法高效处理每天30 TB的实时数据。
explanations.C: Cache the data to Amazon CloudFront. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. When an object is added to the S3 bucket, run an AWS Lambda function to process the data for analysis. 错误原因：CloudFront是内容分发网痬（CDN），用于缓存和分发静态内容，而不是用于实时数据流处理。 使用Lambda函数处理每天30 TB的数据可能会超出Lambda的执行时间和资源限制。
explanations.D: Collect the data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transmit the data to an Amazon S3 data lake. Load the data in Amazon Redshift for analysis. 正确原因：Amazon Kinesis Data Streams适合实时收集和处理大规模数据。 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose可以将数据高效地传输到Amazon S3数据湖。 Amazon Redshift是专为分析大规模数据设计的服务，适合处理每天30 TB的数据。

question: A company has a website hosted on AWS. The website is behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is configured to handle HTTP and HTTPS separately. The company wants to forward all requests to the website so that the requests will use HTTPS. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Update the ALB's network ACL to accept only HTTPS traffic.
options.B: Create a rule that replaces the HTTP in the URL with HTTPS.
options.C: Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
options.D: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer configured to use Server Name Indication (SNI).

explanations.A: 更新 ALB 的网络 ACL 以仅接受 HTTPS 流量。 错误：网络ACL是用于控制子网级别的流量，而不是直接用于ALB的流量管理。即使更新了网络ACL，HTTP流量仍然会被拒绝，而不 会自动重定向到HTTPS。
explanations.B: 创建一个规则，将 URL 中的 HTTP 蔡换为 HTTPS。 错误：ALB本身不支持直接修改URL的内容。正确的做法是使用监听器规则来实现HTTP到HTTPS的重定向。
explanations.C: 在 ALB 上创建一个监听器规则，将 HTTP 流量重定向到 HTTPS。 正确：ALB支持通过监听器规则将HTTP流量重定向到HTTPS。这是AWS推荐的最佳实践，能够确保所有流量都使用安全的HTTPS协 议。
explanations.D: 将 ALB 蔡换为配置为使用 Server Name Indication (SNI) 的 Network Load Balancer。 错误：Network Load Balancer (NLB)主要用于处理低延迟和高知吐量的TCP/UDP流量，不支持HTTP到HTTPS的重定向功能。

question: A company is developing a two-tier web application on AWS. The company's developers have deployed the application on an Amazon EC2 instance that connects directly to a backend Amazon RDS database. The company must not hardcode database credentials in the application. The company must also implement a solution to automatically rotate the database credentials on a regular basis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the database credentials in the instance metadata. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and instance metadata at the same time.
options.B: Store the database credentials in a configuration file in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and the credentials in the configuration file at the same time. Use S3 Versioning to ensure the ability to fall back to previous values.
options.C: Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation for the secret. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the secret.
options.D: Store the database credentials as encrypted parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on automatic rotation for the encrypted parameters. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the encrypted parameters.

explanations.A: 将数据库认证存储在实例元数据中，并使用 EventBridge 和 Lambda 更新： 错误：实例元数据不适合存储敏感人息，因为它的安全性较低，目无法直接支持自动轮换功能。 错误：需要手动编写 Lambda 函数和 EventBridge 规则，增加了运维复杂性。
explanations.B: 将数据库认证存储在加密的 S3 配置文件中，并使用 EventBridge 和 Lambda 更新： 错误：虽然 S3 可以加密存储，但它不是专门设计用于管理敏感人息的服务。 错误：需要手动编写 Lambda 函数和 EventBridge 规则，增加了运维复杂性。 错误：S3 Versioning虽然提供了回滚功能，但无法直接支持自动轮换。
explanations.C: 将数据库认证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中，并开启自动轮换功能： 正确：Secrets Manager 专门设计用于存储和管理敏感人息，并支持自动轮换功能。 正确：通过为 EC2 实例附加适当的 IAM 权限，可以安全地访问存储的认证。 正确：此解决方案具有最低的运维开销，因为自动轮换功能由 AWS 完全管理。
explanations.D: 将数据库认证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中，并开启自动轮换功能： 错误：虽然 Parameter Store 可以存储加密参数，但它不支持自动轮换功能。 错误：需要手动实现轮换逻辑，增加了运维复杂性。

question: A company is deploying a new public web application to AWS. The application will run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application needs to be encrypted at the edge with an SSL/TLS certificate that is issued by an external certificate authority (CA). The certificate must be rotated each year before the certificate expires. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue an SSL/TLS certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.
options.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue an SSL/TLS certificate. Import the key material from the certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALUse the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) Private Certificate Authority to issue an SSL/TLS certificate from the root CA. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.
options.D: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to import an SSL/TLS certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to send a notification when the certificate is nearing expiration. Rotate the certificate manually.

explanations.A: 使用AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)来颁发SSL/TLS证书。将证书应用到ALB。使用托管续订功能自动轮换证书。 错误：题目明确要求证书由外部证书颁发机构（CA）颁发，而ACM颁发的证书是由AWS的内部CA提供的，不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: 使用AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)来颁发SSL/TLS证书。从证书中导入密钥材料。将证书应用到ALB。使用托管续订功能自 动轮换证书。 错误：ACM颁发的证书仍然是由AWS的内部CA提供的，不符合题目要求。此外，ACM的托管续订功能仅适用于ACM颁发的证书， 而不是导入的证书。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) Private Certificate Authority从根CA颁发SSL/TLS证书。将证书应用到ALB。使用托管 续订功能自动轮换证书。 错误：ACM Private Certificate Authority (PCA)是AWS提供的私有CA服务，颁发的证书仍然是内部证书，不符合题目要求的“外部确 书颁发机构”。
explanations.D: 使用AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)导入SSL/TLS证书。将证书应用到ALB。使用Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)发送通知，当证书接邮到期时。手动轮换证书。 正确：ACM支持导入由外部CA颁发的证书，并将其应用到ALB。由于导入的证书无法使用ACM的托管续订功能，因此需要通过 Amazon EventBridge设置通知机制，并手动轮换证书。

question: A company runs its infrastructure on AWS and has a registered base of 700,000 users for its document management application. The company intends to create a product that converts large .pdf files to jpg image files. The .pdf files average 5 MB in size. The company needs to store the original files and the converted files. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution to accommodate demand that will grow rapidly over time. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Save the .pdf files to Amazon S3. Configure an S3 PUT event to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to jpg format and store them back in Amazon $3.
options.B: Save the .pdf files to Amazon DynamoDUse the DynamoDB Streams feature to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to jpg format and store them back in DynamoDB.
options.C: Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the files to ,jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store.
options.D: Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the file to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store.

explanations.A: Save the .pdf files to Amazon S3. Configure an S3 PUT event to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to .jpg format and store them back in Amazon S3. 分析： Amazon S3是高可扩展性、低成本的存储服务，适合存储大量文件。 S3 PUT事件可以触发AWS Lambda函数，无需额外的服务器资源。 AWS Lambda可以高效地处理文件转换任务，目按使用量计费，成本低。 此方案完全满足需求，目是最具成本效益的解决方案。 结论：正确。
explanations.B: Save the .pdf files to Amazon DynamoDB. Use the DynamoDB Streams feature to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to .jpg format and store them back in DynamoDB. 分析： Amazon DynamoDB是一个NoSQL数据库，适合存储结构化数据，但不适合存储大文件。 使用DynamoDB Streams触发Lambda函数虽然可行，但存储大文件在DynamoDB中成本高且不符合最佳实践。 此方案不适合存储和处理大文件。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the files to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store. 分析： Elastic Beanstalk可以管理EC2实例，但需要维护底层基础设施，增加复杂性。 使用EBS存储文件成本较高，目不具备S3的高可扩展性。 此方案的成本和管理复杂性较高，不是最优选择。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the file to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store. 分析： Elastic Beanstalk和EFS的组合增加了复杂性和成本。 EFS适合共享文件存储，但成本高于S3，目不具备S3的事件触发功能。 此方案的成本和管理复杂性较高，不是最优选择。 结论：错误。

question: A company has more than 5 TB of file data on Windows file servers that run on premises. Users and applications interact with the data each day. The company is moving its Windows workloads to AWS. As the company continues this process, the company requires access to AWS and on-premises file storage with minimum latency. The company needs a solution that minimizes operational overhead and requires no significant changes to the existing file access patterns. The company uses an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection for connectivity to AWS. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Move the on-premises file data to FSx for Windows File Server. Reconfigure the workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS.
options.B: Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the S3 File Gateway. Reconfigure the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads to use the S3 File Gateway.
options.C: Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to Amazon S3. Reconfigure the workloads to use either Amazon S3 directly or the S3 File Gateway. depending on each workload's location.
options.D: Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Deploy and configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the FSx File Gateway. Configure the cloud workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Configure the on-premises workloads to use the FSx File Gateway.

explanations.A: Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Move the on-premises file data to FSx for Windows File Server. Reconfigure the workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. 分析：此选项建议将所有文件数据迁移到AWS上的FSx for Windows File Server，并重新配置工作负载以使用它。这种方法可能会导 致本地工作负载访问AWS文件存储时出现较高的延迟，不符合“最低延迟”的要求。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the S3 File Gateway. Reconfigure the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads to use the S3 File Gateway. 分析：此选项建议使用Amazon S3 File Gateway，但S3 File Gateway主要用于对象存储，而不是文件存储。Windows文件服务器的 工作负载通常需要文件级存储，而不是对象存储。因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to Amazon S3. Reconfigure the workloads to use either Amazon S3 directly or the S3 File Gateway, depending on each workload's location. 分析：此选项建议将数据迁移到Amazon S3，并根据工作负载的位置选择直接使用S3或S3 File Gateway。与选项B类似，S3是对象 存储，不适合Windows文件服务器的工作负载需求。因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Deploy and configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the FSx File Gateway. Configure the cloud workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Configure the on-premises workloads to use the FSx File Gateway. 分析：此选项建议在AWS上部署FSx for Windows File Server，并在本地部署FSx File Gateway。FSx File Gateway允许本地工作负载 以最低延迟访问AWS上的FSx文件存储，同时无需对现有文件访问模式进行重大更改。这种方法符合题目要求，因此此选项正确。

question: A hospital recently deployed a RESTful API with Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The hospital uses API Gateway and Lambda to upload reports that are in PDF format and JPEG format. The hospital needs to modify the Lambda code to identify protected health information (PHI) in the reports. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use existing Python libraries to extract the text from the reports and to identify the PHI from the extracted text.
options.B: Use Amazon Textract to extract the text from the reports. Use Amazon SageMaker to identify the PHI from the extracted text.
options.C: Use Amazon Textract to extract the text from the reports. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to identify the PHI from the extracted text.
options.D: Use Amazon Rekognition to extract the text from the reports. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to identify the PHI from the extracted text.

explanations.A: 使用现有的 Python 库从报告中提取文本，并从提取的文本中识别 PHI。 错误：虽然可以使用 Python 库提取文本并识别 PHI，但这需要开发和维护额外的代码，增加了操作复杂性。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon Textract 从报告中提取文本。使用 Amazon SageMaker 从提取的文本中识别 PHI。 错误：Amazon Textract 可以提取文本，但使用 Amazon SageMaker 识别 PHI需要构建和训练自定义机器学习模型，增加了操作复 杂性。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon Textract 从报告中提取文本。使用 Amazon Comprehend Medical 从提取的文本中识别 PHI。 正确：Amazon Textract 专门用于提取文档中的文本，Amazon Comprehend Medical 可以直接识别医疗相关的敏感人息（如 PHI），无需额外开发工作，操作开销最小。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon Rekognition 从报告中提取文本。使用 Amazon Comprehend Medical 从提取的文本中识别 PHI。 错误：Amazon Rekognition 主要用于图像和视频分析，不适合从PDF或JPEG文档中提取文本。

question: A company has an application that generates a large number of files, each approximately 5 MB in size. The files are stored in Amazon $3. Company policy requires the files to be stored for 4 years before they can be deleted. Immediate accessibility is always required as the files contain critical business data that is not easy to reproduce. The files are frequently accessed in the first 30 days of the object creation but are rarely accessed after the first 30 days. Which storage solution is MOST cost-effective?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.B: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-lnfrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.C: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.D: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days from object creation. Move the files to S3 Glacier 4 years after object creation.

explanations.A: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation. 错误：S3 Glacier是用于长期存储的低成本选项，但它不支持即时访问。题目要求文件始终可立即访问，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation. 错误：S3 One Zone-IA虽然成本较低，但它的存储可靠性较低，因为数据仅存储在一个可用区。对于关键业务数据，这种存储类别 不适合。
explanations.C: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation. 正确：S3 Standard-IA是一个适合不频痏访问但需要高可用性和即时访问的存储类别。它的成本比S3 Standard低，目符合题目要求 的访问模式和存储可靠性。
explanations.D: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days from object creation. Move the files to S3 Glacier 4 years after object creation. 错误：虽然此选项在4年后将文件移动到S3 Glacier可以进一步降低成本，但题目要求文件始终可立即访问，因此此选项不符合要 求。

question: A company hosts an application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes messages from an Amazon SQS queue, writes to an Amazon RDS table, and deletes the message from the queue. Occasional duplicate records are found in the RDS table. The SQS queue does not contain any duplicate messages. What should a solutions architect do to ensure messages are being processed once only?

options.A: Use the CreateQueue API call to create a new queue.
options.B: Use the AddPermission API call to add appropriate permissions.
options.C: Use the ReceiveMessage API call to set an appropriate wait time.
options.D: Use the ChangeMessageVisibility API call to increase the visibility timeout.

explanations.A: Use the CreateQueue API call to create a new queue. 错误：创建一个新队列并不能解决重复记录的问题，因为问题的根源在于消息的处理逻辑，而不是队列本身。
explanations.B: Use the AddPermission API call to add appropriate permissions. 错误：添加权限与消息的重复处理无关。权限设置主要用于控制队列的访问，而不是解决消息处理逻辑的问题。
explanations.C: Use the ReceiveMessage API call to set an appropriate wait time. 错误：设置疨待时间（Wait Time）仅影响消息的接收延迟，并不能解决重复处理的问题。
explanations.D: Use the ChangeMessageVisibility API call to increase the visibility timeout. 正确：增加可见性超时（Visibility Timeout）可以确保消息在被一个消费者处理时不会被其他消费者再档处理，从而避免重复记录 的产椹。

question: A solutions architect is designing a new hybrid architecture to extend a company's on-premises infrastructure to AWS. The company requires a highly available connection with consistent low latency to an AWS Region. The company needs to minimize costs and is willing to accept slower traffic if the primary connection fails. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a VPN connection as a backup if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.
options.B: Provision a VPN tunnel connection to a Region for private connectivity. Provision a second VPN tunnel for private connectivity and as a backup if the primary VPN connection fails.
options.C: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a second Direct Connect connection to the same Region as a backup if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.
options.D: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Use the Direct Connect failover attribute from the AWS CLI to automatically create a backup connection if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.

explanations.A: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a VPN connection as a backup if the primary Direct Connect connection fails. 正确：AWS Direct Connect提供高性能、低延迟的专线连接，非常适合需要稳定连接的场景。 正确：VPN作为备份连接成本较低，虽然性能不如Direct Connect，但可以满足故障切换的需求。 符合题目要求：高可用性、低延迟、成本优化。
explanations.B: Provision a VPN tunnel connection to a Region for private connectivity. Provision a second VPN tunnel for private connectivity and as a backup if the primary VPN connection fails. 错误：VPN连接的性能和延迟不如Direct Connect，无法满足题目要求的“低延迟”需求。 错误：虽然成本较低，但两个VPN隧道无法提供Direct Connect的高性能连接。
explanations.C: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a second Direct Connect connection to the same Region as a backup if the primary Direct Connect connection fails. 错误：虽然两个Direct Connect连接可以提供高可用性，但成本较高，不符合题目要求的“成本优化”。 错误：题目明确表示公司愿意接受较慢的备份连接，因此不需要两个Direct Connect连接。
explanations.D: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Use the Direct Connect failover attribute from the AWS CLI to automatically create a backup connection if the primary Direct Connect connection fails. 错误：Direct Connect failover属性并不能自动创建备份连接，它仅用于配置现有连接的故障切换。 错误：题目要求明确提到备份连接需要成本优化，而此选项未提及VPN作为备份。

question: A company is running a business-critical web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database that is deployed in a single Availability Zone. The company wants the application to be highly available with minimum downtime and minimum loss of data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Place the EC2 instances in different AWS Regions. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks to redirect traffic. Use Aurora PostgreSQL Cross-Region Replication.
options.B: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple Availability Zones. Configure the database as Multi-AZ. Configure an Amazon RDS Proxy instance for the database. ACE Auto Scaling
options.C: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use one Availability Zone. Generate hourly snapshots of the database. Recover the database from the snapshots in the event of a failure.
options.D: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple AWS Regions. Write the data from the application to Amazon S3. Use S3 Event Notifications to launch an AWS Lambda function to write the data to the database.

explanations.A: Place the EC2 instances in different AWS Regions. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks to redirect traffic. Use Aurora PostgreSQL Cross-Region Replication. 错误原因：将EC2实例放置在不同的AWS区域会增加复杂性和延迟，不符合“最少操作努力”的要求。 跨区域复制虽然可以提供灾难恢复，但不适合解决单一可用区故障问题。
explanations.B: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple Availability Zones. Configure the database as Multi-AZ. Configure an Amazon RDS Proxy instance for the database. 正确原因：使用多个可用区的Auto Scaling组可以确保EC2实例的高可用性。 将Aurora数据库配置为Multi-AZ可以提供数据宛余和快速故障恢复，减少数据丢失和停机时间。 Amazon RDS Proxy可以优化数据库连接管理，进一步提高性能和可靠性。
explanations.C: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use one Availability Zone. Generate hourly snapshots of the database. Recover the database from the snapshots in the event of a failure. 错误原因：仅使用一个可用区的Auto Scaling组无法提供高可用性。 依赖快照恢复数据库会导致较长的恢复时间，不符合“最少停机时间”的要求。
explanations.D: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple AWS Regions. Write the data from the application to Amazon S3. Use S3 Event Notifications to launch an AWS Lambda function to write the data to the database. 错误原因：跨区域配置Auto Scaling组增加了复杂性和成本，不符合“最少操作努力”的要求。 使用S3和Lambda函数写入数据库是一种异步方法，可能导致数据延迟和一致性问题。

question: A company's HTTP application is behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB's target group is configured to use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with multiple EC2 instances that run the web service. The company notices that the NLB is not detecting HTTP errors for the application. These errors require a manual restart of the EC2 instances that run the web service. The company needs to improve the application's availability without writing custom scripts or code. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable HTTP health checks on the NLB, supplying the URL of the company's application.
options.B: Add a cron job to the EC2 instances to check the local application's logs once each minute. If HTTP errors are detected. the application will restart.
options.C: Replace the NLB with an Application Load Balancer. Enable HTTP health checks by supplying the URL of the company’s application. Configure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon Cloud Watch alarm that monitors the UnhealthyHostCount metric for the NLB. Configure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances when the alarm is in the ALARM state.

explanations.A: Enable HTTP health checks on the NLB, supplying the URL of the company's application. 错误：NLB不支持基于HTTP的健康检查。NLB的健康检查仅支持TCP级别的检查，无法检测HTTP错误。
explanations.B: Add a cron job to the EC2 instances to check the local application's logs once each minute. If HTTP errors are detected, the application will restart. 错误：虽然可以通过cron作业实现部分功能，但这需要编写自定义脚本，目无法自动蔡换不健康的实例，违背了题目要求“无需编写 自定义脚本或代码”。
explanations.C: Replace the NLB with an Application Load Balancer. Enable HTTP health checks by supplying the URL of the company's application. Configure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances. 正确：ALB支持基于HTTP的健康检查，可以检测HTTP错误。通过配置Auto Scaling组，可以自动蔡换不健康的实例，从而提高应用 的可用性。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that monitors the UnhealthyHostCount metric for the NLB. Configure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances when the alarm is in the ALARM state. 错误：虽然可以通过CloudWatch监控UnhealthyHostCount，但NLB无法检测HTTP级别的错误，因此无法满足题目要求。

question: A company runs a shopping application that uses Amazon DynamoDB to store customer information. In case of data corruption, a solutions architect needs to design a solution that meets a recovery point objective (RPO) of 15 minutes and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 1 hour. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure DynamoDB global tables. For RPO recovery, point the application to a different AWS Region.
options.B: Configure DynamoDB point-in-time recovery. For RPO recovery, restore to the desired point in time. ACH DynamoDB
options.C: Export the DynamoDB data to Amazon S3 Glacier on a daily basis. For RPO recovery, import the data from S3 Glacier to DynamoDB.
options.D: Schedule Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots for the DynamoDB table every 15 minutes. For RPO recovery, restore the DynamoDB table by using the EBS snapshot.

explanations.A: Configure DynamoDB global tables. For RPO recovery, point the application to a different AWS Region. 错误原因：虽然DynamoDB全球表可以实现跨区域复制，但它主要用于高可用性和低延迟访问，而不是备份和恢复。全球表无法满 足数据恢复到特定时间点的需求，因此无法满足RPO为15分钟的要求。
explanations.B: Configure DynamoDB point-in-time recovery. For RPO recovery, restore to the desired point in time. 正确原因：点时间恢复（Point-in-Time Recovery）是DynamoDB的内置功能，允许用户将表恢复到社去35天内的任意时间点。这完 全满足RPO为15分钟的要求，同时恢复时间目标（RTO）也可以在1小时内完成。
explanations.C: Export the DynamoDB data to Amazon S3 Glacier on a daily basis. For RPO recovery, import the data from S3 Glacier to DynamoDB. 错误原因：将数据导出到S3 Glacier是一个冷存储解决方案，数据恢复时间较长，无法满足RTO为1小时的要求。此外，数据导出是 每日进行的，无法满足RPO为15分钟的要求。
explanations.D: Schedule Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots for the DynamoDB table every 15 minutes. For RPO recovery, restore the DynamoDB table by using the EBS snapshot. 错误原因：Amazon DynamoDB不使用EBS存储，因此无法对DynamoDB表进行EBS快照。这种方法在技术上不可行。

question: A company runs a photo processing application that needs to frequently upload and download pictures from Amazon S3 buckets that are located in the same AWS Region. A solutions architect has noticed an increased cost in data transfer fees and needs to implement a solution to reduce these costs. How can the solutions architect meet this requirement?

options.A: Deploy Amazon API Gateway into a public subnet and adjust the route table to route S3 calls through it.
options.B: Deploy a NAT gateway into a public subnet and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets.
options.C: Deploy the application into a public subnet and allow it to route through an internet gateway to access the S3 buckets.
options.D: Deploy an S3 VPC gateway endpoint into the VPC and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets.

explanations.A: Deploy Amazon API Gateway into a public subnet and adjust the route table to route S3 calls through it. 错误：API Gateway 主要用于构建 RESTful API 或 WebSocket API，与 S3 的直接数据传输无关。 API Gateway 不会降低数据传输成本，目无法直接优化 S3 的访问路寽。
explanations.B: Deploy a NAT gateway into a public subnet and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets. 错误：NAT Gateway 用于允许私有子网中的资源访问互甛网，但它会产生额外的传输费用。 使用 NAT Gateway 访问 S3 不会降低数据传输成本，反而会增加费用。
explanations.C: Deploy the application into a public subnet and allow it to route through an internet gateway to access the S3 buckets. 错误：通过 Internet Gateway 访问 S3 会产生额外的互甛网数据传输费用。 这种方法不符合降低成本的要求。
explanations.D: Deploy an S3 VPC gateway endpoint into the VPC and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets. 正确：S3 VPC Gateway Endpoint 是专门设计用于优化与 S3 的通人的解决方案。 通过 VPC Gateway Endpoint，数据流量直接在 AWS 网痬内部传输，避免了互甛网数据传输费用。 可以通过端点策略控制对 S3 存储橘的访问权限。

question: A company recently launched Linux-based application instances on Amazon EC2 in a private subnet and launched a Linux-based bastion host on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet of a VPC. A solutions architect needs to connect from the on-premises network, through the company's internet connection, to the bastion host, and to the application servers. The solutions architect must make sure that the security groups of all the EC2 instances will allow that access. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the application instances.
options.B: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the internal IP range for the company.
options.C: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the external IP range for the company.
options.D: Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the private IP address of the bastion host.
options.E: Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the public IP address of the bastion host.

explanations.A: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the application instances. 错误：堡垒主机的目的是允许外部用户通过互联网访问，因此它的安全组需要允许来自公司外部IP范围的入站访问，而不是仅允许 来自应用程序实例的访问。
explanations.B: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the internal IP range for the company. 错误：堡垒主机需要允许来自公司外部IP范围的访问，而不是内部IP范围。内部IP范围通常用于私有子网中的资源，而不是通过互联 网访问的资源。
explanations.C: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the external IP range for the company. 正确：堡垒主机的安全组需要配置为允许来自公司外部IP范围的入站访问，以便公司员工可以通过互联网连接到堡垒主机。
explanations.D: Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the private IP address of the bastion host. 正确：应用程序实例的安全组需要配置为仅允许来自堡垒主机私有IP地址的SSH访问，以确保安全性并限制访问来源。
explanations.E: Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the public IP address of the bastion host. 错误：堡垒主机的公共IP地址用于外部访问，而应用程序实例位于私有子网中，应该通过堡垒主机的私有IP地址进行访问。

question: A solutions architect is designing a two-tier web application. The application consists of a public-facing web tier hosted on Amazon EC2 in public subnets. The database tier consists of Microsoft SQL Server running on Amazon EC2 in a private subnet. Security is a high priority for the company. How should security groups be configured in this situation? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
options.B: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
options.C: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound traffic on port 1433 from the security group for the web ter.
options.D: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow outbound traffic on ports 443 and 1433 to the security group for the web tier.
options.E: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound traffic on ports 443 and 1433 from the security group for the web tier.

explanations.A: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. 正确：Web宔需要允许来自互联网的HTTPS流量（端口443），因此需要配置允许从0.0.0.0/0的入站流量。
explanations.B: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. 错误：Web宔通常不需要向互联网发送HTTPS流量，出站流量的默正规则已经允许所有流量，因此无需显式配置。
explanations.C: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound traffic on port 1433 from the security group for the web tier. 正确：数据寑宔需要允许来自Web宔的SQL Server通人（端口1433），因此需要配置允许来自Web宔安全组的入站流量。
explanations.D: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow outbound traffic on ports 443 and 1433 to the security group for the web tier. 错误：数据寑宔通常不需要向Web宔发送HTTPS流量（端口443），而目出站流量的默正规则已经允许所有流量，因此无需显式配 置。
explanations.E: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound traffic on ports 443 and 1433 from the security group for the web tier. 错误：数据寑宔只需要允许来自Web宔的SQL Server通人（端口1433），不需要允许HTTPS流量（端口443）。

question: A company wants to move a multi-tiered application from on premises to the AWS Cloud to improve the application's performance. The application consists of application tiers that communicate with each other by way of RESTful services. Transactions are dropped when one tier becomes overloaded. A solutions architect must design a solution that resolves these issues and modernizes the application. Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?

options.A: Use Amazon API Gateway and direct transactions to the AWS Lambda functions as the application layer. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) as the communication layer between application services.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to analyze the application performance history to determine the servers' peak utilization during the performance failures. Increase the size of the application server's Amazon EC2 instances to meet the peak requirements.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SNS queue length and scale up and down as required.
options.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SQS queue length and scale up when communication failures are detected.

explanations.A: Use Amazon API Gateway and direct transactions to the AWS Lambda functions as the application layer. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) as the communication layer between application services. 分析： Amazon API Gateway提供了一个高效的RESTful API管理解决方案，适合现代化应用。 AWS Lambda是无服务器计算服务，能够动态扩展，避免过载问题。 Amazon SQS是托管消息队列服务，能够解兢应用程序层之间的通人，防桬事务丢失。 此选项符合题目要求，解决了过载问题并现代化了应用程序。 正确。
explanations.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to analyze the application performance history to determine the servers' peak utilization during the performance failures. Increase the size of the application server's Amazon EC2 instances to meet the peak requirements. 分析： 此选项依赖于手动分析和调整EC2实例大小，缺乏自动化和现代化特性。 增加EC2实例大小可能解决过载问题，但无法解兢应用层之间的通人。 不符合题目要求的“现代化应用程序”目标。 错误。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SNS queue length and scale up and down as required. 分析： Amazon SNS是发布/订阅消息服务，适合广播消息，但不适合解兢应用层之间的通人。 此选项依赖于EC2 Auto Scaling组，未使用无服务器架构。 不符合题目要求的“现代化应用程序”目标。 错误。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SQS queue length and scale up when communication failures are detected. 分析： Amazon SQS可以解兢应用层之间的通人，解决过载问题。 此选项依赖于EC2 Auto Scaling组，未使用无服务器架构。 虽然解决了过载问题，但未实现应用程序的现代化目标。 错误。

question: A company receives 10 TB of instrumentation data each day from several machines located at a single factory. The data consists of JSON files stored on a storage area network (SAN) in an on-premises data center located within the factory. The company wants to send this data to Amazon S3 where it can be accessed by several additional systems that provide critical near-real-time analytics. A secure transfer is important because the data is considered sensitive. Which solution offers the MOST reliable data transfer?

options.A: AWS DataSync over public internet
options.B: AWS DataSync over AWS Direct Connect
options.C: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over public internet
options.D: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over AWS Direct Connect

explanations.A: AWS DataSync over public internet 正确性分析：AWS DataSync是一种专门用于迁移文件数据的服务，适合将本地数据传输到AWS存储服务（如S3）。但通过公共互联 网传输数据可能会受到网络波动的影响，可靠性较低，目安全性可能不如专线连接。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: AWS DataSync over AWS Direct Connect 正确性分析：AWS DataSync通过AWS Direct Connect可以提供更高的可靠性和安全性。Direct Connect是一种专线连接，能够减少 网络波动并提供更稳定的传输性能，非常适合传输敏感数据。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over public internet 正确性分析：AWS DMS主要用于迁移数据库，而题目中的数据是JSON文件，不属于数据库范畴。因此，DMS并不适合此场景。此 外，通过公共互联网传输数据的可靠性和安全性较低。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over AWS Direct Connect 正确性分析：虽然AWS Direct Connect可以提高传输的可靠性和安全性，但AWS DMS并不适合迁移JSON文件，因为它主要用于数 据库迁移。因此，此选项不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。

question: A company needs to configure a real-time data ingestion architecture for its application. The company needs an API, a process that transforms data as the data is streamed, and a storage solution for the data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance to host an API that sends data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that uses the Kinesis data stream as a data source. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to send the data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance to host an API that sends data to AWS Glue. Stop source/destination checking on the EC2 instance. Use AWS Glue to transform the data and to send the data to Amazon S3.
options.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to send data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that uses the Kinesis data stream as a data source. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to send the data to Amazon $3.
options.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to send data to AWS Glue. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use AWS Glue to send the data to Amazon S3.

explanations.A: 部署一个Amazon EC2实例来托管一个API，该API将数据发送到Amazon Kinesis数据流。创建一个Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose传输流，使用Kinesis数据流作为数据源。使用AWS Lambda函数来转换数据。使用Kinesis Data Firehose传输流将数据发 送到Amazon S3。 正确性分析：使用EC2实例托管API增加了运营开销，因为需要管理和维护EC2实例。 错误原因：虽然架构功能上可以满足需求，但EC2实例的使用不符合“最低运营开销”的要求。
explanations.B: 部署一个Amazon EC2实例来托管一个API，该API将数据发送到AWS Glue。停止EC2实例上的源/目标检查。使用AWS Glue来 转换数据并将数据发送到Amazon S3。 正确性分析：AWS Glue适合批处理，而非实时数据流处理。 错误原因：EC2实例增加了运营开销，AWS Glue不适合实时数据处理场景。
explanations.C: 配置一个Amazon API Gateway API，将数据发送到Amazon Kinesis数据流。创建一个Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose传输 流，使用Kinesis数据流作为数据源。使用AWS Lambda函数来转换数据。使用Kinesis Data Firehose传输流将数据发送到Amazon S3。 正确性分析：API Gateway是无服务器的API托管解决方案，Kinesis数据流和Kinesis Data Firehose支持实时数据处理，Lambda函数 可以无缝集成进行数据转换，S3是低成本存储解决方案。 正确原因：此架构完全无服务器，运营开销最低，目满足实时数据处理需求。
explanations.D: 配置一个Amazon API Gateway API，将数据发送到AWS Glue。使用AWS Lambda函数来转换数据。使用AWS Glue将数据发 送到Amazon S3。 正确性分析：AWS Glue适合批处理，而非实时数据流处理。 错误原因：AWS Glue不适合实时数据处理场景，目架构复杂度增加。

question: A company needs to keep user transaction data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company must retain the data for 7 years. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Use DynamoDB point-in-time recovery to back up the table continuously.
options.B: Use AWS Backup to create backup schedules and retention policies for the table.
options.C: Create an on-demand backup of the table by using the DynamoDB console. Store the backup in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set an S3 Lifecycle configuration for the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to back up the table and to store the backup in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set an S3 Lifecycle configuration for the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 使用 DynamoDB point-in-time recovery 来连续备份表。 Point-in-time recovery (PITR) 是 DynamoDB 的内置功能，可以提供连痲备份，但它的主要用途是短期数据恢复，而不是长期数据保 留。 无法满足“保留数据7年”的要求，因此此选项错误。
