explanations.B: Set up AWS Firewall Manager in both Regions. Centrally configure AWS WAF rules. 正确性分析：AWS Firewall Manager 是一个集中管理工具，可以跨账户和跨区域统一管理 AWS WAF 规则，减少了管理工作量。 正确原因：符合题目要求的“最少的管理工作量”，并且能够有效保护 API Gateway。
explanations.C: Set up AWS Shield in both Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage. 正确性分析：AWS Shield 是针对 DDoS 攻击的保护服务，主要用于防御分布式拒绝服务攻击。 错误原因：题目要求保护 API Gateway 免受 SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击，而这些攻击属于应用层攻击，AWS Shield 并不适合解决这 些问题。
explanations.D: Set up AWS Shield in one of the Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage. 正确性分析：同选项 C，AWS Shield 主要用于防御 DDoS 攻击。 错误原因：无法解决 SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击问题，目只在一个区域设置 Shield 无法满足跨区域保护需求。

question: A company has implemented a self-managed DNS solution on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the us-west-2 Region. Most of the company's users are located in the United States and Europe. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the solution. The company launches and configures three EC2 instances in the eu-west-1 Region and adds the EC2 instances as targets for a new NLB. Which solution can the company use to route traffic to all the EC2 instances?

options.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
options.B: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Add the two NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups.
options.C: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.
options.D: Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin. 错误原因：虽然Route 53地理位置路由可以根据用户位置将流量路由到不同的区域，但它无法提供跨区域的性能优化。此外， CloudFront主要用于内容分发，而不是优化动态流量的路由。
explanations.B: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Add the two NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups. 正确原因：AWS Global Accelerator是专门设计用于优化跨区域流量的服务。它通过使用全球Anycast IP地址和加速器，可以将用户 流量路由到最邮的区域，从而提高性能和可用性。将两个NLB作为端点是最佳实践。
explanations.C: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin. 错误原因：直接使用Elastic IP地址和Route 53地理位置路由策略无法提供跨区域的性能优化。此外，这种方法增加了管理复杂性， 并且CloudFront的使用在此场景中并不适合。
explanations.D: Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin. 错误原因：虽然ALB支持更多高级功能，但在此场景中，NLB已经足够满足需求。Route 53延迟路由策略可以优化流量，但它无法提 供像AWS Global Accelerator那样的全球性能优化。此外，CloudFront的使用在此场景中并不适合。

question: A company is running an online transaction processing (OLTP) workload on AWS. This workload uses an unencrypted Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Daily database snapshots are taken from this instance. What should a solutions architect do to ensure the database and snapshots are always encrypted moving forward?

options.A: Encrypt a copy of the latest DB snapshot. Replace existing DB instance by restoring the encrypted snapshot.
options.B: Create a new encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and copy the snapshots to it. Enable encryption on the DB instance.
options.C: Copy the snapshots and enable encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Restore encrypted snapshot to an existing DB instance.
options.D: Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that is encrypted using server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys (SSE-KMS).

explanations.A: Encrypt a copy of the latest DB snapshot. Replace existing DB instance by restoring the encrypted snapshot. 正确：这是AWS推荐的方式。RDS实例无法直接启用加密，必须通过创建加密的快照并从该快照恢复一个新的加密实例来实现。 此方法证保数据库和未来的快照都被加密。
explanations.B: Create a new encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and copy the snapshots to it. Enable encryption on the DB instance. 错误：RDS实例的加密与EBS卷的加密是独立的。无法通过创建加密的EBS卷直接为RDS实例启用加密。 RDS实例的加密只能通过加密的快照恢复来实现。
explanations.C: Copy the snapshots and enable encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Restore encrypted snapshot to an existing DB instance. 错误：虽然可以使用KMS加密快照，但无法将加密的快照恢复到现有的未加密实例。 必须创建一个新的加密实例，而不是恢复到现有实例。
explanations.D: Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that is encrypted using server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys (SSE-KMS). 错误：将快照复制到S3并加密不会影响RDS实例本身的加密状态。 此方法仅适用于备份目的，而不是为RDS实例启用加密。

question: A company wants to build a scalable key management infrastructure to support developers who need to encrypt data in their applications. What should a solutions architect do to reduce the operational burden?

options.A: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to protect the encryption keys.
options.B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create, store, and assign the encryption keys.
options.D: Use an IAM policy to limit the scope of users who have access permissions to protect the encryption keys.

explanations.A: 使用多因素身份验证 (MFA) 来保护加密密钥。 Correct Answer: B 分析：MFA是一种增强身份验证安全性的机制，但它并不是专门用于管理加密密钥的服务。虽然可以在某些场景下保护访问权限， 但它无法直接减少管理加密密钥的操作负担。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来保护加密密钥。 分析：AWS KMS是一种托管服务，专门用于创建、管理和保护加密密钥。它提供了自动化的密钥轮换、访问控制和审计功能，可以 显著减少操作负担。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 来创建、存储和分配加密密钥。 分析：ACM主要用于管理SSL/TLS证书，而不是加密密钥管理。它不适合用于支持开发者加密数据的场景。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 使用 IAM 策略来限制具有访问权限的用户范围，以保护加密密钥。 分析：IAM策略可以限制用户访问权限，但它是访问控制的一部分，不能直接减少加密密钥管理的操作负担。 结论：错误。

question: A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certificate, which is on each instance to perform SSL termination. There has been an increase in traffic recently, and the operations team determined that SSL encryption and decryption is causing the compute capacity of the web servers to reach their maximum limit. What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?

options.A: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination.
options.C: Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances.
options.D: Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM.

explanations.A: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance. 错误：虽然 ACM 可以管理 SSL 证书，但它不能直接安装到 EC2 实例上。ACM 的证书只能用于 AWS 服务（如 Load Balancer 或 CloudFront）。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination. 错误：S3 不支持 SSL 终止功能。S3 是对象存储服务，不能用于处理 SSL 加密和解密。
explanations.C: Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances. 错误：虽然可以通过代理服务器处理 SSL 终止，但这会增加架构复杂性，并且仍然需要手动管理证书。相比使用 ALB，这种方法效 率较低目不具备扩展性。
explanations.D: Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM. 正确：将 SSL 证书导入 ACM 后，可以使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的 HTTPS 监听器处理 SSL 终止。这种方法可以减答 EC2 实例的负载，同时提供高可用性和扩展性。

question: A company has a highly dynamic batch processing job that uses many Amazon EC2 instances to complete it. The job is stateless in nature, can be started and stopped at any given time with no negative impact, and typically takes upwards of 60 minutes total to complete. The company has asked a solutions architect to design a scalable and cost-effective solution that meets the requirements of the job. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Implement EC2 Spot Instances.
options.B: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances.
options.C: Implement EC2 On-Demand Instances.
options.D: Implement the processing on AWS Lambda.

explanations.A: Implement EC2 Spot Instances. 正确。Spot Instances是EC2的一种定价模式，适用于无状态、容错性高的应用场景。它们的价格远低于On-Demand Instances，非 常适合动态批处理任务。由于题目明确指出任务是无状态的，并且可以随时启动和停止，因此Spot Instances是最具成本效益的选 择。
explanations.B: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances. 错误。Reserved Instances适用于长期稳定的工作负载，通常需要提前购买并锁定使用期限（1年或3年）。题目中的批处理任务是动 态的，不适合使用Reserved Instances。
explanations.C: Implement EC2 On-Demand Instances. 错误。On-Demand Instances适用于短期、不可预测的工作负载，但它们的成本较高。虽然可以满足动态需求，但题目要求成本效 益，Spot Instances更适合。
explanations.D: Implement the processing on AWS Lambda. 错误。AWS Lambda适用于短时间运行的无服务器计算任务，最大执行时间为15分钟。题目中的批处理任务需要60分钟以上，因此 Lambda无法满足需求。

question: A company runs its two-tier ecommerce website on AWS. The web tier consists of a load balancer that sends traffic to Amazon EC2 instances. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS DB instance. The EC2 instances and the RDS DB instance should not be exposed to the public internet. The EC2 instances require internet access to complete payment processing of orders through a third-party web service. The application must be highly available. Which combination of configuration options will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
options.B: Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets.
options.C: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi- AZ DB instance in private subnets.
options.D: Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet. D. Configure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.

explanations.A: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets. 正确：EC2实例在私有子网中可以避免直接暴需到互联网，符合题目要求。 正确：RDS Multi-AZ部署在私有子网中，确保数据寑的高可用性，同时避免暴需到互联网。
explanations.B: Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets. 错误：Application Load Balancer需要部署在公有子网中，以便接收来自互联网的流量。 正确：两个私有子网和两个NAT网关的配置可以确保高可用性和私有子网中的资源访问互联网。
explanations.C: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets. 错误：EC2实例部署在公有子网中会暴需到互联网，不符合题目要求。 正确：RDS Multi-AZ部署在私有子网中，确保数据寑的高可用性。
explanations.D: Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet. 正确：Application Load Balancer部署在公有子网中，可以接收来自互联网的流量。 正确：两个NAT网关跨两个可用区，确保高可用性，并允许私有子网中的资源访问互联网。

question: A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to reduce a company's storage costs. All the company's data is in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. The company must keep all data for at least 25 years. Data from the most recent 2 years must be highly available and immediately retrievable. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive immediately.
options.B: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to $3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.
options.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the archiving option to ensure that data is archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately and to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.

explanations.A: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive immediately. 错误原因：虽然S3 Glacier Deep Archive是最低成本的存储选项，但题目要求最邮2年的数据必须“高度可用目可立即检痋”。将所有 数据立即转移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive会导致最邮2年的数据无法满足可用性和检痋要求。
explanations.B: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years. 正确原因：此选项符合题目要求。最邮2年的数据保留在S3 Standard存储类中，确保其高度可用目可立即检痋。超过2年的数据则转 移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive以降低存储成本，同时满足25年的数据保留要求。
explanations.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the archiving option to ensure that data is archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 错误原因：S3 Intelligent-Tiering虽然可以自动优化存储成本，但它无法明确保证最邮2年的数据始终保留在高可用的存储层中。此 外，激活归档选项后，数据可能会被转移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive，而这不符合题目对最邮2年数据的可用性要求。
explanations.D: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately and to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years. 错误原因：S3 One Zone-IA的可用性较低，目不具备跨区域宛余。将最邮2年的数据转移到S3 One Zone-IA会降低数据的可用性， 不符合题目要求。

question: A media company is evaluating the possibility of moving its systems to the AWS Cloud. The company needs at least 10 TB of storage with the maximum possible I/O performance for video processing, 300 TB of very durable storage for storing media content, and 900 TB of storage to meet requirements for archival media that is not in use anymore. Which set of services should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage Amazon EBS
options.B: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage Amazon EBS
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 for archival storage Amazon EC2 instance store
options.D: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage Amazon EC2 instance store

explanations.A: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage Amazon EBS 提供高性能存储，适合需要高 I/O 的场景，但它的容量限制较小，无法满足 10 TB 的需求。 Amazon S3 是一种高耐用性存储服务，适合存储 300 TB 的媒体内容。 Amazon S3 Glacier 是专门用于归档存储的服务，适合存储 900 TB 的归档数据。 此选项的问题在于 Amazon EBS 的容量限制，无法满足 10 TB 的需求。
explanations.B: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage Amazon EBS 提供高性能存储，但容量限制较小，无法满足 10 TB 的需求。 Amazon EFS 是一个文件存储服务，适合共享文件存储，但不如 Amazon S3 在耐用性和成本方面适合存储 300 TB 的媒体内容。 Amazon S3 Glacier 适合归档存储，满足 900 TB 的需求。 此选项的问题在于 Amazon EBS 的容量限制，以及 Amazon EFS 不适合存储大规模媒体内容。
explanations.C: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 for archival storage Amazon EC2 instance store 提供高性能存储，适合需要高 I/O 的场景，但它是临时存储，数据会在实例停止时丢失，不适合持久存 储。 Amazon EFS 是一个文件存储服务，适合共享文件存储，但不如 Amazon S3 在耐用性和成本方面适合存储 300 TB 的媒体内容。 Amazon S3 是一种高耐用性存储服务，但它更适合存储媒体内容而非归档数据。 此选项的问题在于 EC2 instance store 的临时性，以及 Amazon S3 不适合归档存储。
explanations.D: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage Amazon EC2 instance store 提供高性能存储，适合需要高 I/O 的场景，虽然是临时存储，但在视频处理场景中可以接受。 Amazon S3 是一种高耐用性存储服务，适合存储 300 TB 的媒体内容。 Amazon S3 Glacier 是专门用于归档存储的服务，适合存储 900 TB 的归档数据。 此选项满足所有需求，是正确答案。

question: A company wants to run applications in containers in the AWS Cloud. These applications are stateless and can tolerate disruptions within the underlying infrastructure. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers. ££ Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.B: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group. ¢£ Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.C: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers. f£ Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.D: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.

explanations.A: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers. 正确性分析：使用Spot Instances可以显著降低成本，目Auto Scaling组可以提供弹性扩展能力。 错误原因：虽然成本低，但直接使用EC2 Auto Scaling组运行容器需要额外的运维工作（例如手动管理容器编排），增加了运营开 销。
explanations.B: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group. 正确性分析：EKS是一个托管的容器编排服务，可以减少运营开销。使用Spot Instances进一步降低成本。 正确原因：EKS托管节点组自动管理节点的生命周期，结合Spot Instances可以满足题目中“最小化成本和运营开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers. 正确性分析：On-Demand Instances提供稳定性，但成本较高。 错误原因：虽然可以运行容器，但没有使用容器编排服务（如EKS），增加了运营开销，同时没有成本优化。
explanations.D: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group. 正确性分析：EKS托管节点组减少了运营开销。 错误原因：虽然EKS减少了运营开销，但使用On-Demand Instances会增加成本，不符合题目中“最小化成本”的要求。

question: A company is running a multi-tier web application on premises. The web application is containerized and runs on a number of Linux hosts connected to a PostgreSQL database that contains user records. The operational overhead of maintaining the infrastructure and capacity planning is limiting the company's growth. A solutions architect must improve the application's infrastructure. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora.
options.B: Migrate the web application to be hosted on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.C: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the web application content.
options.D: Set up Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and the PostgreSQL database.
options.E: Migrate the web application to be hosted on AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). 1300128 NFB ES EPS AB Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)

explanations.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora. 正确。Amazon Aurora 是一种高性能、可扩展的托管数据库服务，支持 PostgreSQL。迁移到 Aurora 可以减少数据库的管理开销， 同时提高性能和可用性。
explanations.B: Migrate the web application to be hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. 错误。虽然 EC2 可以托管应用程序，但它仍然需要手动管理实例、扩展和容器化环境，无法显著减少运维开销。
explanations.C: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the web application content. 错误。CloudFront 是一个内容分发网络（CDN），主要用于加速静态和动态内容的交付，但题目没有提到需要优化内容分发，因此 与题目要求不完全相关。
explanations.D: Set up Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and the PostgreSQL database. 错误。虽然 ElastiCache 可以优化数据库查询性能，但题目重点在于减少运维开销，而不是直接优化数据库性能。
explanations.E: Migrate the web application to be hosted on AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). 正确。AWS Fargate 是一种无服务器容器管理服务，可以显著减少容器化应用的运维开销，同时支持自动扩展。

question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zonas. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. The application performs best when the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances is at or near 40%. What should a solutions architect do to maintain the desired performance across all instances in the group?

options.A: Use a simple scaling policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function ta update the desired Auto Scaling group capacity.
options.D: Use scheduled scaling actions to scale up and scale down the Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Use a simple scaling policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group. 简单扩展策略（Simple Scaling Policy）基于特定的阈值触发扩展或缩减操作，但它不适合维持目标CPU利用率（如40%）。 此选项不够棬梮，无法动态调整以维持目标性能。 错误。
explanations.B: Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group. 目标跟踪策略（Target Tracking Policy）是专门设计用于维持指定指标（如CPU利用率）的目标值。 它会自动调整Auto Scaling组的容量以保持CPU利用率在40%左右。 正确。
explanations.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to update the desired Auto Scaling group capacity. 使用AWS Lambda函数手动更新Auto Scaling组的容量是一种复杂目不推荐的方式。 这种方法需要额外的开发和维护工作，目无法自动动态调整。 错误。
explanations.D: Use scheduled scaling actions to scale up and scale down the Auto Scaling group. 计划扩展操作（Scheduled Scaling Actions）基于预定义的时间表进行扩展或缩减，但无法根据实时指标（如CPU利用率）动态调 整。 此选项不适合维持目标性能。 错误。

question: A company is developing a file-sharing application that will use an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The company wants to serve all the files through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company does not want the files to be accessible through direct navigation to the S3 URL. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Write individual policies for each S3 bucket to grant read permission for only CloudFront access.
options.B: Create an IAM user. Grant the user read permission to objects in the S3 bucket. Assign the user to CloudFront.
options.C: Write an S3 bucket policy that assigns the CloudFront distribution ID as the Principal and assigns the target S3 bucket as the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
options.D: Create an origin access identity (OAI). Assign the OAI to the CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket permissions so that only the OAI has read permission.

explanations.A: Write individual policies for each S3 bucket to grant read permission for only CloudFront access. 错误：虽然可以通过 S3 bucket 策略限制访问，但直接为每个 bucket 编写单独的策略并不高效，也无法直接与 CloudFront 的 OAI 集成。 此外，CloudFront 的访问权限通常通过 OAI 或者其他机制来实现，而不是直接通过 bucket 策略。
explanations.B: Create an IAM user. Grant the user read permission to objects in the S3 bucket. Assign the user to CloudFront. 错误：IAM 用户的权限是针对用户的，而不是针对 CloudFront。CloudFront 无法直接使用 IAM 用户的权限来访问 S3 bucket。 这种方法不符合最佳实践，也无法满足题目要求。
explanations.C: Write an S3 bucket policy that assigns the CloudFront distribution ID as the Principal and assigns the target S3 bucket as the Amazon Resource Name (ARN). 错误：CloudFront 分配 ID 不能直接作为 Principal 使用。正确的做法是使用 OAI 来限制 S3 bucket 的访问权限。 这种方法无法实现题目中要求的限制直接访问 S3 URL 的功能。
explanations.D: Create an origin access identity (OAI). Assign the OAI to the CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket permissions so that only the OAI has read permission. 正确：OAI 是专门用于限制 S3 bucket 直接访问的机制。通过将 OAI 分配给 CloudFront 分发，并配置 S3 bucket 权限，使只有 OAI 可以访问 S3 bucket，可以有效地满足题目要求。 这种方法是 AWS 官方推荐的最佳实践。

question: A company’s website provides users with downloadable historical performance reports. The website needs a solution that will scale to meet the company’s website demands globally. The solution should be cost-effective, limit the provisioning of infrastructure resources, and provide the fastest possible response time. Which combination should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 Amazon CloudFront
options.B: AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB AWS Lambda
options.C: Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling Application Load Balancer
options.D: Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers Amazon Route 53

explanations.A: Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3 Amazon CloudFront 是一个全球内容分发网络 (CDN)，可以快速分发内容到全球用户，提供低延迟和高知吐量。 Amazon S3 是一个高可用性和高扩展性的存储服务，适合存储静态文件（如历史报告）。 此组合完全满足题目要求：全球分发、成本效益、无服务器架构、快速响应时间。 正确选项。
explanations.B: AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB AWS Lambda 是一个无服务器计算服务，适合处理动态请求或事件驱动的应用程序。 Amazon DynamoDB 是一个无服务器的NoSQL数据库，适合存储结构化数据。 此组合不适合静态文件的全球分发，目不符合题目要求的“最快响应时间”。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Application Load Balancer 与 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling Application Load Balancer 和 EC2 Auto Scaling 适合动态应用程序的负载均衡和扩展。 此组合需要预置基础设施资源，成本较高，不符合题目要求的“成本效益”和“无服务器架构”。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Amazon Route 53 与内部 Application Load Balancers Amazon Route 53 是一个DNS服务，适合域名解析和流量路由。 内部 Application Load Balancers 适合内部网络的负载均衡，但不适合全球范围的内容分发。 此组合不符合题目要求的“全球分发”和“最快响应时间”。 错误选项。

question: A company runs an Oracle database on premises. As part of the company’s migration to AWS, the company wants to upgrade the database to the most recent available version. The company also wants to set up disaster recovery (DR) for the database. The company needs to minimize the operational overhead for normal operations and DR setup. The company also needs to maintain access to the database's underlying operating system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region.
options.B: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to another AWS Region.
options.C: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region,
options.D: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone.

explanations.A: Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region. 正确性分析：虽然迁移到EC2实例可以提供对底层操作系统的访问，但这种方法需要手动设置和管理数据库复制，增加了操作开 销，不符合“最小化操作开销”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to another AWS Region. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS for Oracle支持跨区域备份，但它不允许访问底层操作系统，不符合题目要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle允许访问底层操作系统，同时支持跨区域只读副本，满足灾难恢复需求并最小化操作 开销。 结论：正确。
explanations.D: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone. 正确性分析：Amazon RDS for Oracle支持在同一区域内创建备用数据库（多可用区部署），但不支持跨区域灾难恢复，也不允许访 问底层操作系统。 结论：错误。

question: A company wants to move its application to a serverless solution. The serverless solution needs to analyze existing and new data by using SL. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data requires encryption and must be replicated to a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an $3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region kays (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.B: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an $3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.
options.C: Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use $3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.

explanations.C: 1. 考察的知识点 Amazon S3的加密选项 (SSE-KMS vs SSE-S3) 。 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)的功能和配置。 使用Amazon Athena进行数据查询的能力。 选择最少的操作开销 (serverless架构) 。 2. 选项分析 A: 正确点: 使用$3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)来实现跨区域复制，符合要求。 正确点: 使用AWS KMS多区域密钥 (SSE-KMS) 进行加密，符合加密要求。 正确点: 使用Amazon Athena查询数据，符合serverless架构要求。 错误点: 创建新的S3 bucket增加了额外的操作开销，不符合"最少操作开销"的要求。 B: 正确点: 使用$3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)来实现跨区域复制，符合要求。 正确点: 使用AWS KMS多区域密钥 (SSE-KMS) 进行加密，符合加密要求。 错误点: 使用Amazon RDS查询数据不符合serverless架构要求，因为RDS需要管理实例，增加了操作开销。 错误点: 创建新的S3 bucket增加了额外的操作开销，不符合"最少操作开销"的要求。 Cc: 正确点: 使用现有的S3 bucket减少了操作开销，符合"最少操作开销”的要求。 正确点: 使用$3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)来实现跨区域复制，符合要求。 正确点: 使用Amazon S3托管加密密钥 (SSE-S3) 进行加密，符合加密要求。 正确点: 使用Amazon Athena查询数据，符合serverless架构要求。 D: 正确点: 使用现有的S3 bucket减少了操作开销，符合"最少操作开销”的要求。 正确点: 使用S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)来实现跨区域复制，符合要求。 正确点: 使用Amazon S3托管加密密钥 (SSE-S3) 进行加密，符合加密要求。 错误点: 使用Amazon RDS查询数据不符合serverless架构要求，因为RDS需要管理实例，增加了操作开销。 3. 我选的答案 C 4. 官方答案 C 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致，无需重新思考。
explanations.A: Incorrect. The requirement is least operational overhead, so creating a new bucket and reloading the data is unnecessary, and SSE-KMS multi-Region keys add key management compared with SSE-S3. Athena is the right query engine, but overall this is more overhead than using SSE-S3 on the existing bucket.
explanations.B: Incorrect. It likewise creates a new bucket and reloads data, and Amazon RDS is not serverless and cannot run SQL directly against data in S3; Amazon Athena should be used.
explanations.D: Incorrect. Amazon RDS cannot query data directly in S3 and is not serverless, so it cannot meet the requirement to analyze S3 data with SQL.

question: A company runs workloads on AWS. The company needs to connect to a service from an external provider. The service is hosted in the provider's VPC. According to the company’s security team, the connectivity must be private and must be restricted to the target service. The connection must be initiated only from the company’s VPC. Which solution will mast these requirements?

options.A: Create a VPC peering connection between the company's VPC and the provider's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service.
options.B: Ask the provider to create a virtual private gateway in its VPC. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
options.C: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company’s VPUpdate the route table to connect to the target service.
options.D: Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint for the target service. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.

explanations.A: Create a VPC peering connection between the company's VPC and the provider's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service. VPC Peering允许两个VPC之间进行私有连接，但它是全网互通的，无法限制连接到特定服务。 此外，VPC Peering需要双方协作配置，可能不符合题目要求的“仅从公司VPC发起连接”。 因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Ask the provider to create a virtual private gateway in its VPC. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service. 虚拟私有网关（Virtual Private Gateway）通常用于VPN或Direct Connect连接，而不是用于AWS PrivateLink。 此选项棆棂了技术桜嬏，AWS PrivateLink需要的是VPC Endpoint，而不是虚拟私有网关。 因此此选项不正确。
explanations.C: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company’s VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service. NAT Gateway用于将私有子网的流量路由到互联网或其他公共网络，但它不是私有连接的解决方案。 题目要求连接必须是私有的，而NAT Gateway会暴需流量到公共网络，因此不符合题目要求。 此选项不正确。
explanations.D: Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint for the target service. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service. AWS PrivateLink允许通过VPC Endpoint实现私有连接，目可以限制连接到特定服务。 此解决方案完全符合题目要求：连接是私有的，仅限目标服务，目连接由公司VPC发起。 此选项正确。

question: A company is migrating its on-premises PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The on-premises database must remain online and accessible during the migration. The Aurora database must remain synchronized with the on-premises database. Which combination of actions must a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.) 一家公司正在将其本地部署的 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.

options.A: Create an ongoing replication task.
options.B: Create a database backup of the on-premises database.
options.C: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication server.
options.D: Convert the database schema by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT).
options.E: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor the database synchronization.

explanations.A: Create an ongoing replication task. 正确。AWS DMS支持创建持续的复制任务以保持源数据库和目标数据库同步。这是实现实时同步的关键步骤。
explanations.B: Create a database backup of the on-premises database. 错误。创建数据库备份是静态的操作，无法满足题目中“保持同步”的要求。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication server. 正确。AWS DMS需要一个复制服务器来执行迁移任务，这是实现数据库迁移和同步的必要组件。
explanations.D: Convert the database schema by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT). 错误。AWS SCT用于转换数据库架构，但题目没有提到需要转换架构，目此工具不直接涉及同步操作。
explanations.E: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor the database synchronization. 错误。EventBridge用于事件驱动的自动化操作，与数据库同步无直接关系。

question: A company uses AWS Organizations to create dedicated AWS accounts for each business unit to manage each business unit's account independently upon request. The root email recipient missed a notification that was sent to the root user email address of one account. The company wants to ensure that all future notifications are not missed. Future notifications must be limited to account administrators. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the company’s email server to forward notification email messages that are sent to the AWS account root user email address to all users in the organization.
options.B: Configure all AWS account root user email addresses as distribution lists that go to a few administrators who can respond to alerts. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.
options.C: Configure all AWS account root user email messages to be sent to one administrator who is responsible for monitoring alerts and forwarding those alerts to the appropriate groups.
options.D: Configure all existing AWS accounts and all newly created accounts to use the same root user email address. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.

explanations.A: 配置公司的电子邮件服务器以转发通知邮件到组织中的所有用户。 错误：这种方法可能会导致通知发送给不相关的用户，无法限制通知仅发送给账户管理员。 此外，这种方法需要额外的电子邮件服务器配置，增加了复杂性。
explanations.B: 配置根用户电子邮件地址为分发列表，并通过AWS Organizations控制台或编程方式配置备用联系人。 正确：分发列表可以确保通知发送给少数管理员，避免遗棟重要信息。 备用联系人配置是AWS推荐的最佳实践，可以确保通知发送给指定的账户管理员。
explanations.C: 配置所有根用户电子邮件消息发送给一个管理员，由其负责转发。 错误：这种方法依赖单一管理员，存在单点故障风险。如果该管理员无法及时处理通知，可能会导致延误。 不符合题目要求“通知必须限于账户管理员”的最佳实践。
explanations.D: 配置所有账户使用相同的根用户电子邮件地址，并通过AWS Organizations配置备用联系人。 错误：使用相同的根用户电子邮件地址会导致管理棆乱，无法区分不同账户的通知来源。 虽然备用联系人配置是正确的，但根用户电子邮件地址的统一设置不符合AWS的推荐实践。

question: A company runs its ecommerce application on AWS. Every new order is published as a massage in a RabbitMQ queue that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a single Availability Zone. These messages are processed by a different application that runs on a separate EC2 instance. This application stores the details in a PostgreSQL database on another EC2 instance. All the EC2 instances are in the same Availability Zone. The company needs to redesign its architecture to provide the highest availability with the least operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database. FEM GUESS Amazon MQ
options.B: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. FEM GUESS Amazon MQ
options.C: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.
options.D: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create a third Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database

explanations.A: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database. 正确性分析：迁移队列到Amazon MQ是正确的，因为Amazon MQ是托管服务，支持高可用性并减少运维开销。 错误点：为PostgreSQL数据寑创建一个Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是不合适的，因为PostgreSQL数据寑应该使用Amazon RDS的Multi- AZ部署，而不是孅动管理EC2实例。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. 正确性分析：迁移队列到Amazon MQ是正确的，因为它提供高可用性并减少运维开销。 正确性分析：为应用程序创建Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是正确的，因为它提供高可用性。 正确性分析：将数据寑迁移到Amazon RDS的Multi-AZ部署是正确的，因为它是托管服务，支持高可用性并减少运维开销。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. 错误点：为RabbitMQ队列创建Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是不合适的，因为Amazon MQ是更好的选择，提供托管服务和高可用性。 正确点：为应用程序创建Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是正确的。 正确点：将数据寑迁移到Amazon RDS的Multi-AZ部署是正确的。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create a third Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database. 错误点：为RabbitMQ队列创建Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是不合适的，因为Amazon MQ是更好的选择，提供托管服务和高可用性。 正确点：为应用程序创建Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是正确的。 错误点：为PostgreSQL数据寑创建Multi-AZ Auto Scaling组是不合适的，因为Amazon RDS的Multi-AZ部署是更好的选择。 结论：错误。

question: A reporting team receives files each day in an Amazon S3 bucket. The reporting team manually reviews and copies the files from this initial S3 bucket to an analysis S3 bucket each day at the same time to use with Amazon QuickSight. Additional teams are starting to send more files in larger sizes to the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team wants to move the files automatically analysis S3 bucket as the files enter the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team also wants to use AWS Lambda functions to run pattern-matching code on the copied data. In addition, the reporting team wants to send the data files to a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.B: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.
options.C: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.D: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.

explanations.A: 创建一个 Lambda 函数以将文件复制到分析 S3 bucket。为分析 S3 bucket 创建一个 S3 事件通知。配置 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 作为事件通知的目标。将事件类型配置为 s3:ObjectCreated:Put。 错误：此选项要求手动创建 Lambda 函数来复制文件，这增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的“最少操作开销”。 错误：S3事件通知无法直接支持多个目标（如Lambda和SageMaker Pipelines），需要通过EventBridge来实现多目标支持。
explanations.B: 创建一个 Lambda 函数以将文件复制到分析 S3 bucket。配置分析 S3 bucket 发送事件通知到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。在 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中配置一个 ObjectCreated 规则。将 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该规则的目标。 错误：此选项仍然要求手动创建 Lambda 函数来复制文件，增加了操作开销。 正确：EventBridge可以支持多目标，但手动复制文件的方式不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: 在 S3 buckets 之间配置 S3 复制。为分析 S3 bucket 创建一个 S3 事件通知。配置 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 作为事件 通知的目标。将事件类型配置为 s3:ObjectCreated:Put。 错误：S3事件通知无法直接支持多个目标（如Lambda和SageMaker Pipelines），需要通过EventBridge来实现多目标支持。 正确：S3复制可以自动将文件从初始S3 bucket复制到分析S3 bucket，减少了操作开销。
explanations.D: 在 S3 buckets 之间配置 S3 复制。配置分析 S3 bucket 发送事件通知到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。在 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中配置一个 ObjectCreated 规则。将 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为 该规则的目标。 正确：S3复制自动处理文件复制，减少了操作开销。 正确：EventBridge支持多目标（如Lambda和SageMaker Pipelines），符合题目要求。 正确：此选项完全满足题目要求，并且操作开销最少。

question: A solutions architect needs to help a company optimize the cost of running an application on AWS. The application will use Amazon EC2 instances, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda for compute within the architecture. The EC2 instances will run the data ingestion layer of the application. EC2 usage will be sporadic and unpredictable. Workloads that run on EC2 instances can be interrupted at any time. The application front end will run on Fargate, and Lambda will serve the API layer. The front-end utilization and API layer utilization will be predictable over the course of the next year. Which combination of purchasing options will provide the MOST cost-effective solution for hosting this application? (Choose two.) 解决方案架构师需要帮助一家公司优化在 AWS 上运行应用程序的成本。该应用程序将在架构中使用 Amazon EC2 实例、AWs Fargate 和 AWS Lambda 进行计算。 EC2 实例将运行应用程序的数据摄取层。 EC2 的使用将是间歇性的且不可预测的。在 EC2 实例上运行的工作负载可能随时会被中 断。应用程序的前端将运行在 Fargate 上，而 Lambda 将服务于 API 层。前端的使用率和 AP!

options.A: Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer (ERR)
options.B: Use On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer
options.C: Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.
options.D: Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved instances for the data ingestion layer.
options.E: Purchase a 1-year EC2 instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.

explanations.A: Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer 正确。Spot Instances适用于可以被中断的工作负载，目成本较低。题目明确指出数据摄取层的EC2使用是“sporadic and unpredictable”，并且可以被中断，因此Spot Instances是最合适的选择。
explanations.B: Use On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer 错误。On-Demand Instances成本较高，适用于需要持续运行目不可中断的工作负载。题目明确指出数据摄取层可以被中断，因此 不需要使用On-Demand Instances。
explanations.C: Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer 正确。Compute Savings Plan提供棬梮性，可以应用于Fargate和Lambda，目适用于预测性较高的工作负载。题目指出前端和API层 的利用率是“predictable”，因此Compute Savings Plan是最具成本效益的选择。
explanations.D: Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved instances for the data ingestion layer 错误。Reserved Instances适用于长期稳定的工作负载，而数据摄取层的使用是“sporadic and unpredictable”，不适合使用Reserved Instances。
explanations.E: Purchase a 1-year EC2 instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer 错误。EC2 instance Savings Plan仅适用于EC2实例，而题目中的前端运行在Fargate，API层运行在Lambda，因此EC2 instance Savings Plan无法覆盖这些服务。

question: A company runs a web-based portal that provides users with global breaking news, local alerts, and weather updates. The portal delivers each user a personalized view by using mixture of static and dynamic content. Content is served over HTTPS through an API server running on an Amazon EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants the portal to provide this content to its users across the world as quickly as possible. How should a solutions architect design the application to ensure the LEAST amount of latency for all users?

options.A: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin.
options.B: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.
options.C: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB.
options.D: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.

explanations.A: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin. 分析： Amazon CloudFront是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以缓存和分发静态和动态内容，显著降低延迟。 通过指定ALB作为CloudFront的源，可以确保动态内容也通过CloudFront的边缘位置快速分发。 单区域部署结合CloudFront的全球分发能力是一个高效的低延迟解决方案。 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region. 分析： 跨区域部署可以降低延迟，但需要额外的管理和成本。 Route 53的延迟路由策略可以根据用户的延迟选择最邮的区域，但没有提到如何优化内容分发。 此选项没有利用CloudFront的全球分发能力，可能导致动态内容的延迟较高。 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB. 分析： CloudFront可以优化静态内容的分发，但动态内容直接从ALB提供可能导致较高的延迟，尤其是对于远离区域的用户。 此选项没有充分利用CloudFront的能力来优化动态内容的分发。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region. 分析： 地理位置路由策略可以根据用户的地理位置选择最邮的区域，但没有提到如何优化内容分发。 跨区域部署增加了复杂性和成本，目没有利用CloudFront的全球分发能力。 此选项错误。

question: A gaming company is designing a highly available architecture. The application runs on a modified Linux kernel and supports only UDP-based traffic. The company needs the front-end tier to provide the best possible user experience. That tier must have low latency, route traffic to the nearest edge location, and provide static IP addresses for entry into the application endpoints. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Route 53 to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in AWS Application Auto Scaling.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in an AWS Application Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Configure AWS Global Accelerator to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Configure Amazon API Gateway to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: 配置 Amazon Route 53 将请求转发到 Application Load Balancer。使用 AWS Lambda 作为 AWS Application Auto Scaling 中的应用程序。 错误：Application Load Balancer不支持UDP流量，仅支持HTTP/HTTPS流量。 错误：AWS Lambda无法运行需要修改Linux内核的应用程序。 错误：Route 53主要用于DNS解析，不提供低延迟路由或静态IP功能。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 将请求转发到 Network Load Balancer。使用 AWS Lambda 作为 AWS Application Auto Scaling 组中的应用程序。 错误：CloudFront主要用于内容分发，不支持UDP流量。 错误：AWS Lambda无法运行需要修改Linux内核的应用程序。 正确：Network Load Balancer支持UDP流量，但CloudFront与NLB的组合不符合题目需求。
explanations.C: 配置 AWS Global Accelerator 将请求转发到 Network Load Balancer。使用 Amazon EC2 实例作为 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 应用程序。 正确：AWS Global Accelerator提供低延迟路由和静态IP地址功能，符合题目需求。 正确：Network Load Balancer支持UDP流量，符合题目需求。 正确：Amazon EC2实例可以运行需要修改Linux内核的应用程序，并且可以通过Auto Scaling实现高可用性。
explanations.D: 配置 Amazon API Gateway 将请求转发到 Application Load Balancer。使用 Amazon EC2 实例作为 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 应用程序。 错误：Application Load Balancer不支持UDP流量，仅支持HTTP/HTTPS流量。 错误：API Gateway主要用于处理HTTP/HTTPS API请求，不支持UDP流量。 正确：Amazon EC2实例可以运行需要修改Linux内核的应用程序，但整体架构不符合题目需求。

question: A company wants to migrate its existing on-premises monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to keep as much of the front-end code and the backend code as possible. However, the company wants to break the application into smaller applications. A different team will manage each application. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway.
options.B: Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda.
options.C: Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as targets.
options.D: Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the target.

explanations.A: Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway. 正确性分析：虽然AWS Lambda和API Gateway可以实现无服务器架构并减少运维开销，但题目提到要保留现有的前端和后端代码， 并将应用拆分为多个小型应用。Lambda适合运行小型函数，而不是托管复杂的应用程序。此外，Lambda可能需要重构代码以适应 其事件驱动模型。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda. 正确性分析：AWS Amplify主要用于构建和部署前端应用程序，而不是托管后端代码。虽然可以通过API Gateway和Lambda连接后 端，但这并不符合题目要求的“保留现有前端和后端代码”的需求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as targets. 正确性分析：EC2实例可以托管现有的前端和后端代码，并通过负载均衡器实现高可用性。然而，EC2实例的管理和维护需要较高的 运维开销，不符合题目要求的“最小化运维开销”。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the target. 正确性分析：Amazon ECS支持容器化应用程序，可以将单体应用拆分为多个容器，每个容器由不同的团队管理。ECS与Application Load Balancer集成后可以实现高可扩展性，同时容器化减少了运维开销，符合题目要求。 结论：正确。

question: A company recently started using Amazon Aurora as the data store for its global ecommerce application. When large reports are run, developers report that the ecommerce application is performing poorly. After reviewing metrics in Amazon CloudWatch, a solutions architect finds that the ReadlIOPS and CPUUtilizalion metrics are spiking when monthly reports run. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.A: Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift.
options.B: Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.
options.C: Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class.
options.D: Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance.

explanations.A: Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift. 错误：Amazon Redshift是专为数据仓寑设计的服务，适合处理复杂的分析查询，但迁移到Redshift需要额外的架构调整和数据迁移 工作，成本较高，不是最直接的解决方案。
explanations.B: Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica. 正确：Aurora Replica可以分担读操作的负载，适合解决高读负载问题。将报告查询迁移到Aurora Replica是最具成本效益的解决方 案。
explanations.C: Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class. 错误：虽然迁移到更大的实例类型可以提高性能，但成本较高，并且不能解决根本问题（读写负载分离）。
explanations.D: Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance. 错误：增加Provisioned IOPS可以提高存储性能，但成本较高，并且主要针对写操作优化，而题目中问题主要是读操作负载社高。

question: A company hosts a website analytics application on a single Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance. The analytics software is written in PHP and uses a MySQL database. The analytics software, the web server that provides PHP, and the database server are all hosted on the EC2 instance. The application is showing signs of performance degradation during busy times and is presenting 5xx errors. The company needs to make the application scale seamlessly. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%.
options.D: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.

explanations.A: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是一个合理的选择，可以提高数据库性能和可扩展性。 问题：虽然使用 Application Load Balancer 可以分配负载，但使用 On-Demand Instances 的成本较高，缺乏成本优化。 结论：此选项正确性较高，但不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
explanations.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是合理的选择。 问题：使用 Route 53 加权路由分配负载不如 Application Load Balancer 高效，目仍然使用 On-Demand Instances，成本较高。 结论：此选项正确性较低，目不符合“无缝扩展”的要求。
explanations.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 是合理的选择，可以提高性能。 问题：使用 Lambda 和 CloudWatch 来动态调整实例类型虽然可以优化性能，但无法实现无缝扩展，目操作复杂。 结论：此选项正确性较低，不符合“无缝扩展”的要求。
explanations.D: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group. 正确性：将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 是合理的选择，可以提高性能。 优势：使用 Auto Scaling Group 和 Spot Fleet 可以实现无缝扩展，同时优化成本。Application Load Balancer 可以高效分配负载。 结论：此选项是最具成本效益目符合“无缝扩展”要求的解决方案。

question: A company runs a stateless web application in production on a group of Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application experiences heavy usage during an 8-hour period each business day. Application usage is moderate and steady overnight. Application usage is low during weekends. The company wants to minimize its EC2 costs without affecting the availability of the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Spot Instances for the entire workload.
options.B: Use Reserved Instances forthe baseline level of usage. Use Spot instances for any additional capacity that the application needs
options.C: Use On-Demand Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
options.D: Use Dedicated Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use On-Demand Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.

explanations.A: Use Spot Instances for the entire workload. 错误原因：Spot Instances价格低廉，但它们可能随时被中断，无法保证应用程序的高可用性，尤其是椹产栤境的关键工作负载。
explanations.B: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot instances for any additional capacity that the application needs. 正确原因：Reserved Instances适合长期稳定的基略使用量，提供成本节痓。Spot Instances适合处理额外的临时容量需求，进一桯 降低成本，同时不会影响应用的可用性。
explanations.C: Use On-Demand Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs. 错误原因：虽然On-Demand Instances可以满足基略使用量，但它们的成本较高，未能充分利用Reserved Instances的成本优势。
explanations.D: Use Dedicated Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use On-Demand Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs. 错误原因：Dedicated Instances成本非常高，通常用于满足合规性或特桴畦件需求，而题目未提到这些要求。此外，On-Demand Instances的成本也较高，未能优化成本。

question: A company needs to retain application log files for a critical application for 10 years. The application team regularly accesses logs from the past month for troubleshooting, but logs older than 1 month are rarely accessed. The application generates more than 10 TB of logs per month. Which storage option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.B: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.C: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to $3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

explanations.A: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 错误：AWS Backup主要用于备份和恢复服务，而不是直接管理S3对象的生命周期。使用AWS Backup来移动S3对象到S3 Glacier Deep Archive并不是最佳实践。
explanations.B: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 正确：S3 Lifecycle策略是管理对象生命周期的推荐方法，可以自动将超过1个月的日志移动到S3 Glacier Deep Archive，从而实现成 本优化。
explanations.C: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 错误：CloudWatch Logs主要用于实时日志畁控和分析，而不是长期存储。AWS Backup也不适合用于管理CloudWatch Logs的生命 周期。
explanations.D: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 错误：S3 Lifecycle策略仅适用于Amazon S3存储橘中的对象，而不是CloudWatch Logs。此选项在技术上不可行。

question: A company has a data ingestion workflow that includes the following components: An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that receives notifications about new data deliveries An AWS Lambda function that processes and stores the data The ingestion workflow occasionally fails because of network connectivity issues. When failure occurs, the corresponding data is not ingested unless the company manually reruns the job. What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all notifications are eventually processed?

options.A: Configure the Lambda function for deployment across multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Modify the Lambda function's configuration to increase the CPU and memory allocations for the function.
options.C: Configure the SNS topic’s retry strategy to increase both the number of retries and the wait time between retries.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the on-failure destination. Modify the Lambda function to process messages in the queue.

explanations.A: 配置 Lambda 函数为跨多个可用区部署。 错误：AWS Lambda 本身是高可用的，自动跨多个可用区运行。此选项与问题中的“网痬连接问题”无关，无法解决消息丢失的问 题。
explanations.B: 修改 Lambda 函数的配置以增加 CPU 和内存分配。 错误：增加 CPU 和内存分配可能提高函数性能，但无法解决网痬连接问题，也无法证保消息不会丢失。
explanations.C: 配置 SNS 主题的重试策略以增加重试次数和重试之间的等待时间。 错误：虽然增加重试次数和疨待时间可以减少失败的可能性，但如果重试仍然失败，消息仍然可能丢失。此选项无法证保所有通知 最终被处理。
explanations.D: 配置一个 Amazon SQS 队列作为失败时的目标。修改 Lambda 函数以处理队列中的消息。 正确：通过将失败的消息发送到 SQS 队列，可以确保消息不会丢失。Lambda 函数可以从队列中读取消息并重新处理，解决了网痬 连接问题导致的失败。

question: A company has a service that produces event data. The company wants to use AWS to process the event data as it is received. The data is written in a specific order that must be maintained throughout processing. The company wants to implement a solution that minimizes operational overhead. How should a solutions architect accomplish this?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue. 正确：SQS FIFO队列可以保证消息的顺序性，这是题目要求的关键点。 正确：使用AWS Lambda处理队列中的消息可以实现低运维架构，符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber. 错误：SNS不保证消息的顺序性，因此不符合题目要求。 错误：虽然SNS可以与Lambda集成，但无法满足“数据顺序必须保持”的需求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently. 错误：SQS标准队列不保证消息的顺序性，因此不符合题目要求。 错误：虽然可以使用Lambda处理消息，但无法满足“数据顺序必须保持”的需求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber. 错误：SNS不保证消息的顺序性，因此不符合题目要求。 错误：即使将SQS作为订阅者，也无法保证消息的顺序性。

question: A company is migrating an application from on-premises servers to Amazon EC2 instances. As part of the migration design requirements, a solutions architect must implement infrastructure metric alarms. The company does not need to take action if CPU utilization increases to more than 50% for a short burst of time. However, if the CPU utilization increases to more than 50% and read IOPS on the disk are high at the same time, the company needs to act as soon as possible. The solutions architect also must reduce false alarms. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible.
options.B: Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the metrics and react to issues quickly.
options.C: Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries to monitor the application and raise an alarm.
options.D: Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible.

explanations.A: Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible. 复合报警（Composite Alarms）允许结合多个指标报警的状态来触发一个报警。这种方式可以减少误报，并满足题目中“同时满足 CPU利用率超过50%目磁盘读IOPS高”的条件。 这是正确的选项，因为它直接满足题目要求，并且可以减少误报。
explanations.B: Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the metrics and react to issues quickly. 仪表板（Dashboards）用于可视化指标，但它们不会自动触发报警。需要人工监控并手动采取行动。 此选项不符合题目要求，因为题目明确要求自动化报警，而不是人工监控。
explanations.C: Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries to monitor the application and raise an alarm. Synthetics canaries主要用于监控应用程序的可用性和性能，而不是监控基础设施指标（如CPU利用率和磁盘IOPS）。 此选项不符合题目要求，因为题目关注的是基础设施指标，而不是应用程序性能。
explanations.D: Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible. 单指标报警（Metric Alarms）无法同时监控多个指标的组合条件（如CPU利用率和磁盘IOPS同时满足某条件）。 此选项不符合题目要求，因为它无法实现复合条件报警。

question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to AWS. According to the company's compliance requirements, the company can use only the ap-northeast-3 Region. Company administrators are not permitted to connect VPCs to the internet. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.B: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.D: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3.
options.E: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3.

explanations.A: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3. 正确：AWS Control Tower可以通过数据驻留保护措施（guardrails）来限制互联网访问，并限制访问特定区域（如ap-northeast- 3）。 符合题目要求：限制互联网访问和区域使用。
explanations.B: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings. 错误：AWS WAF主要用于保护Web应用程序免受恶意流量攻击，而不是直接用于限制VPC的互联网访问。 错误：AWS账户设置中无法直接限制区域访问。
explanations.C: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3. 正确：AWS Organizations中的服务控制策略（SCP）可以限制VPC的互联网访问，并限制访问特定区域（如ap-northeast-3）。 符合题目要求：限制互联网访问和区域使用。
explanations.D: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3. 错误：虽然网络ACL可以限制互联网访问，但需要逐个VPC配置，管理复杂性较高。 错误：IAM策略无法直接限制区域使用，区域限制需要通过SCP实现。
explanations.E: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3. 错误：AWS Config可以桌测和警报违规行为，但无法主动阻桬互联网访问或区域使用。 不符合题目要求：题目要求的是阻桬，而不是桌测和警报。

question: A company uses a three-tier web application to provide training to new employees. The application is accessed for only 12 hours every day. The company is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store information and wants to minimize costs. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an IAM policy for AWS Systems Manager Session Manager. Create an IAM role for the policy. Update the trust relationship of the role. Set up automatic start and stop for the DB instance.
options.B: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache cluster that gives users the ability to access the data from the cache when the DB instance is stopped. Invalidate the cache after the DB instance is started.
options.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Create an IAM role that grants access to Amazon RDS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance. Configure a cron job to start and stop the EC2 instance on the desired schedule.
options.D: Create AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the DB instance. Create Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled rules to invoke the Lambda functions. Configure the Lambda functions as event targets for the rules.

explanations.A: Configure an IAM policy for AWS Systems Manager Session Manager... 错误：虽然可以通过AWS Systems Manager设置自动化任务，但Session Manager主要用于管理EC2实例的会话，而不是直接用于管 理RDS实例的启动和停桬。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache cluster... 错误：ElastiCache是一个缓存服务，虽然可以减少数据库的访问频率，但它不能直接解决RDS实例的启动和停桬问题，也无法显著 降低RDS的成本。
explanations.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance... 错误：使用EC2实例和cron作业来管理RDS的启动和停桬是一种可行的方案，但这种方法复杂目不符合最佳实践。AWS提供了更直接 的服务（如Lambda和EventBridge）来实现自动化任务。
explanations.D: Create AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the DB instance... 正确：使用AWS Lambda函数和EventBridge（CloudWatch Events）可以答案实现RDS实例的自动启动和停桬。这种方法成本低、易 于管理，并且符合AWS的最佳实践。

question: A company sells ringtones created from clips of popular songs. The files containing the ringtones are stored in Amazon S3 Standard and are at least 128 KB in size. The company has millions of files, but downloads are infrequent for ringtones older than 90 days. The company needs to save money on storage while keeping the most accessed files readily available for its users. Which action should the company take to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage for the initial storage tier of the objects.
options.B: Move the files to S3 Intelligent-Tiering and configure it to move objects to a less expensive storage tier after 90 days.
options.C: Configure S3 inventory to manage objects and move them to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A) after 90 days.
options.D: Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy that moves the objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard- 1A) after 90 days.

explanations.A: Configure S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage for the initial storage tier of the objects. 错误：S3 Standard-IA适用于不频痏访问的对象，但初始存储层直接使用S3 Standard-IA不符合题目要求，因为前90天的文件可能仍 然需要频痏访问。
explanations.B: Move the files to S3 Intelligent-Tiering and configure it to move objects to a less expensive storage tier after 90 days. 错误：虽然S3 Intelligent-Tiering可以自动优化存储成本，但它会产椹额外的畁控费用。题目要求“最具成本效益”，而使用椹命周期 策略更直接目无额外费用。
explanations.C: Configure S3 inventory to manage objects and move them to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days. 错误：S3 Inventory主要用于对象的报告和审计，而不是自动移动对象。需要额外的手动操作或脚本来实现对象迁移，不符合题目要 求的自动化解决方案。
explanations.D: Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy that moves the objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days. 正确：S3椹命周期策略可以自动将对象从S3 Standard迁移到S3 Standard-IA，符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”解决方案。

question: A company needs to save the results from a medical trial to an Amazon S3 repository. The repository must allow a few scientists to add new files and must restrict all other users to read-only access. No users can have the ability to modify or delete any files in the repository. The company must keep every file in the repository for a minimum of 1 year after its creation date. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode with a legal hold of 1 year.
options.B: Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with a retention period of 365 days.
options.C: Use an IAM role to restrict all users from deleting or changing objects in the S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to only allow the IAM role.
options.D: Configure the S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function every time an object is added. Configure the function to track the hash of the saved object so that modified objects can be marked accordingly.

explanations.A: 使用 S3 Object Lock 的治理模式，并设置 1 年的法律保留。 治理模式允许用户（具有特定权限的用户）绕社锁定并删除或修改对象，因此不符合题目要求“没有用户可以修改或删除文件”。 虽然设置了法律保留，但治理模式无法完全防止文件被修改或删除。 此选项错误。
explanations.B: 使用 S3 Object Lock 的合规模式，并设置 365 天的保留期。 合规模式是最严格的模式，任何用户（包括管理员）都无法删除或修改对象，完全符合题目要求。 设置365天的保留期确保文件至少保存1年，符合题目要求。 此选项正确。
explanations.C: 使用 IAM 角色限制所有用户删除或更改 S3 bucket 中的对象。使用 S3 bucket policy 仅允许 IAM 角色。 虽然可以通过IAM角色和S3存储橘策略限制用户权限，但无法证保文件至少保存1年，也无法完全防止管理员修改或删除文件。 此选项不符合题目要求。 此选项错误。
explanations.D: 配置 S3 bucket 每次添加对象时触发 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该函数以跟踪保存对象的哈希值，以便可以相应地标记被修改的 对象。 此选项涉及复杂的自定义解决方案，但无法防止文件被删除或修改。 题目要求的是防止修改或删除，而不是标记被修改的对象。 此选项错误。

question: A large media company hosts a web application on AWS. The company wants to start caching confidential media files so that users around the world will have reliable access to the files. The content is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The company must deliver the content quickly, regardless of where the requests originate geographically. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
options.B: Deploy AWS Global Accelerator to connect the S3 buckets to the web application. 26 AWS Global Accelerator
options.C: Deploy Amazon CloudFront to connect the $3 buckets to CloudFront edge servers. 3B Amazon CloudFront
options.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 将 S3 存储橘连接到 Web 应用程序。 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移和同步，而不是内容分发或加速。它无法满足全球用户快速访问的需求。
explanations.B: 部署 AWS Global Accelerator 将 S3 存储橘连接到 Web 应用程序。 错误：AWS Global Accelerator主要用于加速TCP/UDP流量，并优化网络路径，但它不直接用于内容分发或缓存S3中的文件。
explanations.C: 部署 Amazon CloudFront 将 S3 存储橘连接到 CloudFront 边缘服务器。 正确：Amazon CloudFront是一个全球内容分发网络（CDN），可以缓存S3中的内容并通过边缘服务器快速分发给全球用户。 它支持加速访问，同时可以保护内容的安全性。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 将 S3 存储橘连接到 Web 应用程序。 错误：Amazon SQS是一个消息队列服务，用于解兢应用程序组件，而不是用于内容分发或加速。

question: A company produces batch data that comes from different databases. The company also produces live stream data from network sensors and application APIs. The company needs to consolidate all the data into one place for business analytics. The company needs to process the incoming data and then stage the data in different Amazon S3 buckets. Teams will later run one-time queries and import the data into a business intelligence tool to show key performance indicators (KPIs). Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
options.C: Create custom AWS Lambda functions to move the individual records from the databases to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.D: Use an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the data into JSON format. Load the data into multiple Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) clusters.
options.E: Use blueprints in AWS Lake Formation to identify the data that can be ingested into a data lake. Use AWS Glue to crawl the source, extract the data, and load the data into Amazon $3 in Apache Parquet format.

explanations.A: Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs. 正确：Amazon Athena是一种无服务器查询服务，适合对存储在Amazon S3中的数据进行一次性查询。 正确：Amazon QuickSight是一种商业智能工具，可以用来创建仪表板并展異KPIs。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs. 错误：Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics主要用于实时流数据分析，而题目要求的是对存储数据进行一次性查询。 正确：Amazon QuickSight可以用来创建仪表板并展異KPIs。
explanations.C: Create custom AWS Lambda functions to move the individual records from the databases to an Amazon Redshift cluster. 错误：使用AWS Lambda函数手动移动数据到Amazon Redshift会增加操作复杂性，不符合“LEAST operational overhead”的要求。
explanations.D: Use an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the data into JSON format. Load the data into multiple Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) clusters. 错误：将数据加载到Amazon OpenSearch Service（Amazon Elasticsearch Service）不符合题目要求，因为题目需要将数据存储在 Amazon S3中以供后痲查询。
explanations.E: Use blueprints in AWS Lake Formation to identify the data that can be ingested into a data lake. Use AWS Glue to crawl the source, extract the data, and load the data into Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format. 正确：AWS Lake Formation可以帮助简化数据湖的构建过程，使用蓝图可以自动识别可摄入的数据。 正确：AWS Glue可以爬取源数据并将其转换为高效的Apache Parquet格式存储在Amazon S3中。

question: A company stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company must store all the data for 5 years and must delete all the data after 5 years. The company also must indefinitely keep audit logs of actions that are performed within the database. Currently, the company has automated backups configured for Aurora. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Take a manual snapshot of the DB cluster.
options.B: Create a lifecycle policy forthe automated backups.
options.C: Configure automated backup retention for 5 years.
options.D: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs export for the DB cluster.
options.E: Use AWS Backup to take the backups and to keep the backups for 5 years.

explanations.A: Take a manual snapshot of the DB cluster. 手动快照可以保存数据库的状态，但无法自动删除数据，也无法满足5年的数据保留要求。 手动快照需要手动管理生命周期，不适合长期自动化需求。 错误。
explanations.B: Create a lifecycle policy for the automated backups. Aurora的自动备份不支持生命周期策略，生命周期策略通常用于Amazon S3疨服务。 无法满足5年的数据保留和自动删除要求。 错误。
explanations.C: Configure automated backup retention for 5 years. Aurora的自动备份保留期最多只能设置为35天，无法满足5年的数据保留要求。 此选项不符合题目要求。 错误。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs export for the DB cluster. CloudWatch Logs可以导出数据库的审计日志，满足题目中“无限期保留审计日志”的要求。 此选项正确。 正确。
explanations.E: Use AWS Backup to take the backups and to keep the backups for 5 years. AWS Backup支持对Aurora数据库进行备份，并可以设置备份保留策略，满足5年的数据保留要求。 此选项正确。 正确。

question: A solutions architect is optimizing a website for an upcoming musical event. Videos of the performances will be streamed in real time and then will be available on demand. The event is expected to attract a global online audience. Which service will improve the performance of both the real-time and on-demand streaming?

options.A: Amazon CloudFront
options.B: AWS Global Accelerator
options.C: Amazon Route 53
options.D: Amazon $3 Transfer Acceleration Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration

explanations.A: Amazon CloudFront Amazon CloudFront 是 AWS 的内容分发网络（CDN）服务，专门用于加速全球范围内的内容交付，包括实时流媒体和点播流媒 体。 它通过将内容缓存到边缘位置，减少了延迟并提高了性能，非常适合本题场景。 正确选项。
explanations.B: AWS Global Accelerator AWS Global Accelerator 是一种网络加速服务，主要用于优化 TCP 和 UDP 流量的性能。 虽然它可以提高应用的全球访问速度，但它并不专门迧对流媒体优化，无法直接改善视频流的性能。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Amazon Route 53 Amazon Route 53 是 AWS 的域名解析服务，主要用于 DNS 路由和域名管理。 虽然它可以帮助用户连接到最辢的资源，但它并不直接优化视频流的性能。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 是一种加速将数据上传到 S3 的服务。 它适用于数据传输场景，但与视频流媒体性能优化无关。 错误选项。

question: A company is running a publicly accessible serverless application that uses Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The application's traffic recently spiked due to fraudulent requests from botnets. Which steps should a solutions architect take to block requests from unauthorized users? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a usage plan with an API key that is shared with genuine users only.
options.B: Integrate logic within the Lambda function to ignore the requests from fraudulent IP addresses. Lambda
options.C: Implement an AWS WAF rule to target malicious requests and trigger actions to filter them out.
options.D: Convert the existing public API to a private API. Update the DNS records to redirect users to the new API endpoint.
options.E: Create an IAM role for each user attempting to access the API. A user will assume the role when making the API call.

explanations.A: Create a usage plan with an API key that is shared with genuine users only. 正确：使用API密钥和使用计划可以限制访问并确保只有授权用户能够调用API。这是一个有效的安全措施。
explanations.B: Integrate logic within the Lambda function to ignore the requests from fraudulent IP addresses. 错误：在Lambda函数中处理恶意流量会增加函数的复杂性和运行成本。更好的方法是使用AWS WAF在API Gateway层过滤恶意流 量。
explanations.C: Implement an AWS WAF rule to target malicious requests and trigger actions to filter them out. 正确：AWS WAF可以有效地过滤恶意请求，防止它们到通API Gateway和Lambda函数。这是处理恶意流量的推荐方法。
explanations.D: Convert the existing public API to a private API. Update the DNS records to redirect users to the new API endpoint. 错误：将公共API转换为私有API会限制所有用户的访问，而不仅仅是恶意用户。这不符合题目要求。
explanations.E: Create an IAM role for each user attempting to access the API. A user will assume the role when making the API call. 错误：为每个用户创建IAM角色并让用户假设角色的方式不适合大规模的API访问场景，目无法有效阻止恶意流量。
