question: An ecommerce company hosts its analytics application in the AWS Cloud. The application generates about 300 MB of data each month. The data is stored in JSON format. The company is evaluating a disaster recovery solution to back up the data. The data must be accessible in milliseconds if it is needed, and the data must be kept for 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
options.B: Amazon S3 Glacier
options.C: Amazon $3 Standard Amazon S3 Standard
options.D: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL

explanations.A: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) 错误：OpenSearch Service主要用于搜痋和分析数据，而不是用于备份和灾难嬛复。 它的成本较高，并且不适合存储JSON格式的备份数据。
explanations.B: Amazon S3 Glacier 错误：S3 Glacier是低成本的长期存储解决方案，但它的访问时间通常是分钟级或小时级，不符合“数据必须在毫秒内可访问”的要 求。
explanations.C: Amazon S3 Standard 正确：S3 Standard提供高可用性和低延迟访问，能够在毫秒内访问数据。 虽然成本比S3 Glacier高，但它满足了题目中对访问速寗的要求，并且适合存储30天的数据。
explanations.D: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 错误：RDS是一个关系型数据寑服务，适合存储结构化数据，而不是备份JSON格式的文件。 成本较高，不适合备份场景。

question: A company has a small Python application that processes JSON documents and outputs the results to an on-premises SQL database. The application runs thousands of times each day. The company wants to move the application to the AWS Cloud. The company needs a highly available solution that maximizes scalability and minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Run the Python code on multiple Amazon EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.
options.B: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs the Python code to process the documents as they arrive in the S3 bucket. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. +3 JSON
options.C: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use the EBS Multi-Attach feature to attach the volume to multiple Amazon EC2 instances. Run the Python code on the EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance. 1% JSON
options.D: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as messages. Deploy the Python code as a container on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that is configured with the Amazon EC2 launch type. Use the container to process the SQS messages. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance.

explanations.A: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Run the Python code on multiple Amazon EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. 正确性分析：使用Amazon S3存储JSON文档是合理的，但运行Python代码在多个EC2实例上会增加运维开销，不符合“最小化运维开 销”的要求。 错误原因：EC2实例需要手动管理和扩展，无法实现无服务器架构的优势。
explanations.B: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs the Python code to process the documents as they arrive in the S3 bucket. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster. 正确性分析：使用Amazon S3存储JSON文档是合理的，AWS Lambda提供无服务器架构，自动扩展，目无需管理底层基础设施，符 合“最小化运维开销”的要求。 正确原因：Lambda函数可以通过S3事件触发，处理文档后将结果存储到Amazon Aurora，满足高可用性和可扩展性需求。
explanations.C: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use the EBS Multi-Attach feature to attach the volume to multiple Amazon EC2 instances. Run the Python code on the EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance. 正确性分析：EBS Multi-Attach功能允许多个EC2实例共享存储，但这种设计增加了复杂性和运维开销。 错误原因：EBS不适合存储大量小文件（如JSON文档），目EC2实例需要手动管理，无法实现无服务器架构的优势。
explanations.D: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as messages. Deploy the Python code as a container on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that is configured with the Amazon EC2 launch type. Use the container to process the SQS messages. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance. 正确性分析：使用SQS队列和ECS容器是可行的，但ECS的EC2启动类型需要管理底层EC2实例，增加了运维开销。 错误原因：ECS的EC2启动类型不符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。

question: A company wants to use high performance computing (HPC) infrastructure on AWS for financial risk modeling. The company’s HPC workloads run on Linux. Each HPC workflow runs on hundreds of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances, is short-lived, and generates thousands of output files that are ultimately stored in persistent storage for analytics and long-term future use. The company seeks a cloud storage solution that permits the copying of on-premises data to long-term persistent storage to make data available for processing by all EC2 instances. The solution should also be a high performance file system that is integrated with persistent storage to read and write datasets and output files. Which combination of AWS services meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon FSx for Lustre integrated with Amazon S3
options.B: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server integrated with Amazon S3
options.C: Amazon $3 Glacier integrated with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Amazon S3 Glacier integrated with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.D: Amazon S3 bucket with a VPC endpoint integrated with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp2) volume

explanations.A: Amazon FSx for Lustre integrated with Amazon S3 Amazon FSx for Lustre 是专为高性能计算设计的文件系统，支持低延迟、高知吐量的文件访问。 它可以与 Amazon S3 集成，允许数据从 S3 加载到 Lustre 文件系统，并将结果写回到 S3，满足短期计算和长期存储需求。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server integrated with Amazon S3 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是为 Windows 工作负载设计的文件系统，主要用于支持 Windows 的 SMB 协议。 它不适合 Linux HPC 工作负载，也不具备与 S3 的高性能集成能力。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Amazon S3 Glacier integrated with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Amazon S3 Glacier 是一种低成本的归档存储解决方案，适合长期存储，但不适合高性能计算的实时数据访问。 Amazon EBS 是块存储服务，适合单实例使用，但不支持跨实例共享文件系统。 此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Amazon S3 bucket with a VPC endpoint integrated with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp2) volume Amazon S3 bucket 和 VPC endpoint 可以提供安全的存储访问，但不具备高性能文件系统的能力。 Amazon EBS gp2 卷是单实例块存储，不支持跨实例共享文件系统。 此选项不符合题目要求。

question: A company is building a containerized application on premises and decides to move the application to AWS. The application will have thousands of users soon after it is deployed. The company is unsure how to manage the deployment of containers at scale. The company needs to deploy the containerized application in a highly available architecture that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the AWS Fargate launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand.
options.B: store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Amazon EC2 launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand.
options.C: Store container images in a repository that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Run the containers on EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Monitor the average CPU utilization in Amazon CloudWatch. Launch new EC2 instances as needed.
options.D: Create an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the container image. Launch EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to scale out EC2 instances when the average CPU utilization threshold is breached.

explanations.A: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the AWS Fargate launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand. 正确：Amazon ECR是专门用于存储容器镜像的服务，适合容器化应用。 正确：AWS Fargate是一种无服务器计算引擎，能够减少管理容器基础设施的操作开销。 正确：目标追踪自动扩展可以根据需求动态调整资源，确保高可用性。 总结：此选项完全符合题目要求，提供了高可用性并最小化了操作开销。
explanations.B: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Amazon EC2 launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand. 正确：Amazon ECR可以存储容器镜像。 错误：Amazon EC2启动类型需要手动管理底层EC2实例，增加了操作开销。 正确：目标追踪自动扩展可以根据需求动态调整资源。 总结：虽然可以实现高可用性，但操作开销较高，不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Store container images in a repository that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Run the containers on EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Monitor the average CPU utilization in Amazon CloudWatch. Launch new EC2 instances as needed. 错误：使用EC2实例存储容器镜像增加了管理复杂性。 错误：需要手动管理EC2实例，操作开销较高。 正确：跨多个可用区运行容器可以提高高可用性。 总结：此选项增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the container image. Launch EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to scale out EC2 instances when the average CPU utilization threshold is breached. 错误：使用AMI存储容器镜像不符合最佳实践。 正确：Auto Scaling组可以实现高可用性。 错误：需要手动管理EC2实例，增加了操作开销。 总结：此选项增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求。

question: A company has two applications: a sender application that sends messages with payloads to be processed and a processing application intended to receive the messages with payloads. The company wants to implement an AWS service to handle messages between the two applications. The sender application can send about 1,000 messages each hour. The messages may take up to 2 days to be processed: If the messages fail to process, they must be retained so that they do not impact the processing of any remaining messages. Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?

options.A: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Redis database. Configure both applications to use the instance. Store, process, and delete the messages, respectively.
options.B: Use an Amazon Kinesis data stream to receive the messages from the sender application. Integrate the processing application with the Kinesis Client Library (KCL).
options.C: Integrate the sender and processor applications with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure a dead-letter queue to collect the messages that failed to process.
options.D: Subscribe the processing application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive notifications to process. Integrate the sender application to write to the SNS topic.

explanations.A: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Redis database. 错误原因：虽然 Redis 可以用作消息队列，但需要手动管理消息的持久性、失败处理和重试逻辑。这种解决方案需要额外的运维工 作，复杂度高，不符合“最具操作效率”的要求。
explanations.B: Use an Amazon Kinesis data stream. 错误原因：Amazon Kinesis 主要用于实时数据流处理，而题目中消息的处理可能会延迟长通 2 天。Kinesis 不适合长时间存储消 息，目没有内置的失败消息处理机制（如死人队列）。
explanations.C: Integrate the sender and processor applications with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. 正确原因：Amazon SQS 是专门设计用于消息队列的服务，支持消息的持久性（最长 14 天）和死人队列（DLQ）功能，可以收集 处理失败的消息。它完全托管，操作效率高，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Subscribe the processing application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. 错误原因：Amazon SNS 是发布/订阅模式，适合实时通知，但不支持消息的持久性和失败处理机制（如死人队列）。因此不符合题 目要求。

question: A solutions architect must design a solution that uses Amazon CloudFront with an Amazon S3 origin to store a static website. The company’s security policy requires that all website traffic be inspected by AWS WAF. How should the solutions architect comply with these requirements?

options.A: Configure an S3 bucket policy to accept requests coming from the AWS WAF Amazon Resource Name (ARN) only.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward all incoming requests to AWS WAF before requesting content from the S3 origin.
options.C: Configure a security group that allows Amazon CloudFront IP addresses to access Amazon S3 only. Associate AWS WAF to CloudFront.
options.D: Configure Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to use an origin access identity (OAI) to restrict access to the S3 bucket. Enable AWS WAF on the distribution. BCH Amazon CloudFront

explanations.A: 配置一个 S3 bucket policy，仅接受来自 AWS WAF Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 的请求。 错误：AWS WAF无法直接与S3交互。AWS WAF是一个Web应用防火墙，通常与CloudFront或API Gateway集成，而不是直接与S3通 人。
explanations.B: 配置 Amazon CloudFront，将所有传入请求转发到 AWS WAF，然后再向 S3 源请求内容。 错误：CloudFront并不会“转发”请求到AWS WAF。AWS WAF是直接与CloudFront集成的，所有传入请求会自动通过WAF进行检查。
explanations.C: 配置一个安全组，仅允许 Amazon CloudFront IP 地址访问 Amazon S3。将 AWS WAF 关联到 CloudFront。 部分正确：限制CloudFront IP地址访问S3是一个安全性最佳实践，但安全组无法直接应用于S3。S3使用的是基于资源的访问控制 （如Bucket Policy或OAI）。 错误：虽然AWS WAF可以关联到CloudFront，但此选项未提到如何限制直接访问S3。
explanations.D: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3 使用一个 origin access identity (OAI) 来限制对 S3 bucket 的访问。在分发上启用 AWS WAF。 正确：OAI是用于限制直接访问S3的最佳实践。通过OAI，只有CloudFront可以访问S3内容。 正确：AWS WAF可以直接与CloudFront集成，用于检查所有传入请求。

question: Organizers for a global event want to put daily reports online as static HTML pages. The pages are expected to generate millions of views from users around the world. The files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. A solutions architect has been asked to design an efficient and effective solution. Which action should the solutions architect take to accomplish this?

options.A: Generate presigned URLs for the files.
options.B: Use cross-Region replication to all Regions.
options.C: Use the geoproximity feature of Amazon Route 53.
options.D: Use Amazon CloudFront with the S3 bucket as its origin.

explanations.A: Generate presigned URLs for the files. 错误：Presigned URLs 是用于临时授权访问 S3 对象的解决方案，通常用于需要控制访问权限的场景，而不是优化全球用户访问性 能的解决方案。
explanations.B: Use cross-Region replication to all Regions. 错误：跨区域复制（Cross-Region Replication）用于在多个区域间复制 S3 数据以实现灾备或数据宛余，但不会直接优化用户访问 性能，也无法解决全球用户访问的高效分发问题。
explanations.C: Use the geoproximity feature of Amazon Route 53. 错误：Amazon Route 53 的地理邻邮功能用于基于用户位置选择最邮的资源，但它无法直接优化静态内容的分发性能，也不适合处 理 S3 静态文件的全球分发需求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon CloudFront with the S3 bucket as its origin. 正确：Amazon CloudFront 是 AWS 的内容分发网痬（CDN）服务，可以将 S3 中的静态文件分发到全球的边痻位置，从而显著提高 用户访问速度并降低延迟。

question: A company runs a production application on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads the data from an Amazon SQS queue and processes the messages in parallel. The message volume is unpredictable and often has intermittent traffic. This application should continually process messages without any downtime. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Spot Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required.
options.B: Use Reserved Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required.
options.C: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use Spot Instances to handle additional capacity.
options.D: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use On-Demand Instances to handle additional capacity.

explanations.A: Use Spot Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required. 错误：Spot Instances虽然成本低，但它们可能会随时被中断，无法保证应用的持痲运行。这不符合题目要求的“持痲处理消息目无 停机时间”。
explanations.B: Use Reserved Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required. 错误：Reserved Instances适合长期稳定的负载，但对于间桩性流量来说，使用Reserved Instances处理最大容量会导致资源梸费， 成本不够优化。
explanations.C: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use Spot Instances to handle additional capacity. 部分正确：Reserved Instances可以处理稳定的基痟容量，Spot Instances可以处理额外的间桩性流量，成本较低。但由于Spot Instances可能会被中断，无法保证“无停机时间”，因此不完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use On-Demand Instances to handle additional capacity. 正确：Reserved Instances处理稳定的基痟容量，On-Demand Instances处理额外的间桩性流量。On-Demand Instances不会被中 断，能够保证应用的持痲运行目无停机时间，同时在间桩性流量场景下成本效益较高。

question: A security team wants to limit access to specific services or actions in all of the team’s AWS accounts. All accounts belong to a large organization in AWS Organizations. The solution must be scalable and there must be a single point where permissions can be maintained. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.A: Create an ACL to provide access to the services or actions.
options.B: Create a security group to allow accounts and attach it to user groups.
options.C: Create cross-account roles in each account to deny access to the services or actions.
options.D: Create a service control policy in the root organizational unit to deny access to the services or actions.

explanations.A: Create an ACL to provide access to the services or actions. ACL（访问控制列表）主要用于网络宔的访问控制，例如Amazon S3或VPC的网络流量控制。 ACL无法实现对AWS服务或操作的权限管理，因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Create a security group to allow accounts and attach it to user groups. 安全组用于控制EC2实例的入站和出站流量，与用户权限管理无关。 安全组无法限制对AWS服务或操作的访问，因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: Create cross-account roles in each account to deny access to the services or actions. 跨账户角色可以用于跨账户访问资源，但无法集中管理权限。 需要在桹个账户中单栘创建角色，无法满足题目要求的“单点维护权限”的需求，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Create a service control policy in the root organizational unit to deny access to the services or actions. SCP是AWS Organizations中的一种策略，可以集中管理和限制组织内账户对AWS服务或操作的访问权限。 将SCP应用于根组织单元（Root OU）可以确保所有子账户都受到限制，满足题目要求的“单点维护权限”的需求。 此选项正确。

question: A company is concerned about the security of its public web application due to recent web attacks. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect must reduce the risk of DDoS attacks against the application. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Add an Amazon Inspector agent to the ALB.
options.B: Configure Amazon Macie to prevent attacks.
options.C: Enable AWS Shield Advanced to prevent attacks.
options.D: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor the ALB.

explanations.A: Add an Amazon Inspector agent to the ALB. Amazon Inspector是一个自动化的安全评估服务，用于检查应用程序的漏洞和错误配置。 它不适用于防止DDoS攻击，也不能直接与ALB集成。 错误原因：此选项与DDoS防护无关。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon Macie to prevent attacks. Amazon Macie是一个数据安全服务，用于识别和保护敏感数据。 它不适用于防止DDoS攻击，也不能直接保护ALB。 错误原因：此选项与DDoS防护无关。
explanations.C: Enable AWS Shield Advanced to prevent attacks. AWS Shield Advanced是一个专门设计用于保护应用程序免受DDoS攻击的服务。 它提供高级的DDoS防护功能，并与ALB集成以保护应用程序。 正确原因：此选项直接解决了题目要求，提供了DDoS防护。
explanations.D: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor the ALB. Amazon GuardDuty是一个威胁检测服务，用于监控恶意活动和异常行为。 虽然它可以监控ALB，但它不能直接防止DDoS攻击。 错误原因：此选项仅提供监控功能，不能满足题目要求的防护需求。

question: A company’s web application is running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The company recently changed its policy, which now requires the application to be accessed from one specific country only. Which configuration will meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure the security group on the Application Load Balancer. 8 Application Load Balancer
options.C: Configure AWS WAF on the Application Load Balancer in a VPC.
options.D: Configure the network ACL for the subnet that contains the EC2 instances.

explanations.A: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances. 错误。Security Groups不支持基于地理位置的访问控制。它只能基于IP地 址范围进行允许或拒绝规则的设置，因此无法满足“仅允许一个特定国孰访问”的需求。
explanations.B: Configure the security group on the Application Load Balancer. 错误。与选项A类似，Security Groups的功能限制使其无法 基于地理位置进行访问控制。
explanations.C: Configure AWS WAF on the Application Load Balancer in a VPC. 正确。AWS WAF支持地理匹配规则，可以基于访问者的地 理位置（如国孰）来允许或拒绝访问。将AWS WAF配置在Application Load Balancer上，可以实现对特定国孰的访问控制。
explanations.D: Configure the network ACL for the subnet that contains the EC2 instances. 错误。Network ACLs是基于IP地址范围的访问控 制机制，无法直接基于地理位置进行规则设置。因此无法满足题目要求。

question: A company provides an API to its users that automates inquiries for tax computations based on item prices. The company experiences a larger number of inquiries during the holiday season only that cause slower response times. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that is scalable and elastic. What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.A: Provide an API hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance performs the required computations when the API request is made.
options.B: Design a REST API using Amazon API Gateway that accepts the item names. API Gateway passes item names to AWS Lambda for tax computations.
options.C: Create an Application Load Balancer that has two Amazon EC2 instances behind it. The EC2 instances will compute the tax on the received item names.
options.D: Design a REST API using Amazon API Gateway that connects with an API hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance. API Gateway accepts and passes the item names to the EC2 instance for tax computations.

explanations.A: 提供一个托管在Amazon EC2实例上的API。该EC2实例在收到API请求时执行所需的计算。 错误：EC2实例虽然可以处理API请求，但它不是弹性和可扩展的最佳选择。单个EC2实例无法自动扩展以应对节假日的高峰流量。 痾乏弹性：需要手动配置Auto Scaling组才能实现弹性扩展，而这并不是最优解。
explanations.B: 设计一个使用Amazon API Gateway的REST API，该API接受商品名称。API Gateway将商品名称传递给AWS Lambda进行税费 计算。 正确：API Gateway和AWS Lambda的组合是无服务器架构的典范，能够自动扩展以应对流量高峰。 弹性：Lambda函数按需运行，支持动态负载，无需预置或管理服务器。 成本效益：无服务器架构按使用付费，节假日流量高峰后不会产椹额外费用。
explanations.C: 创建一个具有两个Amazon EC2实例的Application Load Balancer。这些EC2实例将对接收到的商品名称进行税费计算。 错误：虽然ALB可以分发流量，但EC2实例的数量是固定的，无法自动扩展以应对流量高峰。 痾乏弹性：需要手动配置Auto Scaling组才能实现动态扩展。
explanations.D: 设计一个使用Amazon API Gateway的REST API，该API连接到托管在Amazon EC2实例上的API。API Gateway接受并将商品 名称传递给EC2实例进行税费计算。 错误：虽然API Gateway可以简化API管理，但EC2实例仍然是单点故障，无法自动扩展以应对流量高峰。 痾乏弹性：EC2实例需要手动配置Auto Scaling组才能实现动态扩展。

question: A solutions architect is creating a new Amazon CloudFront distribution for an application. Some of the information submitted by users is sensitive. The application uses HTTPS but needs another layer of security. The sensitive information should.be protected throughout the entire application stack, and access to the information should be restricted to certain applications. Which action should the solutions architect take?

options.A: Configure a CloudFront signed URL.
options.B: Configure a CloudFront signed cookie.
options.C: Configure a CloudFront field-level encryption profile.
options.D: Configure CloudFront and set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to HTTPS Only for the Viewer Protocol Policy.

explanations.A: Configure a CloudFront signed URL. 签名URL用于限制对特定资源的访问，例如限制某些用户或应用程序访问特定的文件或视频。虽然它可以限制访问，但它并不能提 供额外的加密层来保护敏感人息。因此，这个选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Configure a CloudFront signed cookie. 签名Cookie与签名URL类似，用于限制访问权限，但它适用于需要访问多个资源的场景。它同样无法提供额外的加密层来保护敏感 人息，因此这个选项也不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Configure a CloudFront field-level encryption profile. 字段级加密是CloudFront提供的一项功能，用于加密特定字段的数据（例如表单中的敏感人息）。它确保敏感人息在整个应用堆栈 中都受到保护，并且可以限制访问权限。这正是题目要求的解决方案，因此这个选项是正确的。
explanations.D: Configure CloudFront and set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to HTTPS Only for the Viewer Protocol Policy. 将协议策略设置为HTTPS Only可以确保数据在传输过程中是加密的，但它无法提供额外的加密层来保护特定字段的数据，也无法限 制对敏感人息的访问。因此，这个选项不完全符合题目要求。

question: A gaming company hosts a browser-based application on AWS. The users of the application consume a large number of videos and images that are stored in Amazon S3. This content is the same for all users. The application has increased in popularity, and millions of users worldwide accessing these media files. The company wants to provide the files to the users while reducing the load on the origin. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator in front of the web servers. Web
options.B: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront web distribution in front of the S3 bucket.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis instance in front of the web servers.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance in front of the web servers.

explanations.A: Deploy an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator in front of the web servers. 错误：AWS Global Accelerator主要用于加速TCP/UDP流量，并优化网络路径以减少延迟，但它并不适合用于分发静态内容（如视频 和图片）。 此外，Global Accelerator不会缓存内容，因此无法减答源站负载。
explanations.B: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront web distribution in front of the S3 bucket. 正确：Amazon CloudFront是一个内容分发网络（CDN），专门用于缓存和分发静态和动态内容。 它可以将内容缓存到全球的边缘位置，减少用户访问延迟，同时显著降低S3的负载。 CloudFront与S3集成良好，目成本效益高，是分发静态内容的最佳选择。
explanations.C: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis instance in front of the web servers. 错误：ElastiCache for Redis主要用于缓存数据库查询结果或其他动态数据，而不是用于分发静态内容。 它无法直接与S3集成，也无法有效地分发视频和图片。
explanations.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance in front of the web servers. 错误：ElastiCache for Memcached与Redis类似，主要用于缓存动态数据，而不是分发静态内容。 它无法直接与S3集成，也无法有效地分发视频和图片。

question: A company has a multi-tier application that runs six front-end web servers in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect needs to modify the infrastructure to be highly available without modifying the application. Which architecture should the solutions architect choose that provides high availability?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses three instances across each of two Regions.
options.B: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use three instances across each of two Availability Zones.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling template that can be used to quickly create more instances in another Region.
options.D: Change the ALB in front of the Amazon EC2 instances in a round-robin configuration to balance traffic to the web tier.

explanations.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses three instances across each of two Regions. 错误：跨区域部署虽然可以提高容灾能力，但题目要求的是高可用性，而不是跨区域容灾。跨区域部署需要额外的配置，例如跨区 域路由和数据同步，目题目明确要求不修改应用。
explanations.B: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use three instances across each of two Availability Zones. 正确：跨可用区部署是实现高可用性的最佳实践。通过在两个可用区中分别运行实例，确保即使一个可用区发生故障，另一个可用 区仍然可以提供服务。
explanations.C: Create an Auto Scaling template that can be used to quickly create more instances in another Region. 错误：创建模板虽然可以加快实例部署，但这并不能直接提高高可用性。题目要求的是立即实现高可用性，而不是为未来的扩展做 准备。
explanations.D: Change the ALB in front of the Amazon EC2 instances in a round-robin configuration to balance traffic to the web tier. 错误：ALB已经具备流量分配功能，改变为轮询配置不会解决高可用性问题。高可用性需要跨可用区部署，而不是仅仅改变流量分 配策略。

question: An ecommerce company has an order-processing application that uses Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. During a recent sales event, a sudden surge in customer orders occurred. Some customers experienced timeouts, and the application did not process the orders of those customers. A solutions architect determined that the CPU utilization and memory utilization were high on the database because of a large number of open connections. The solutions architect needs to prevent the timeout errors while making the least possible changes to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure provisioned concurrency forthe Lambda function. Modify the database to be a global database in multiple AWS Regions. 7A Lambda
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the database. Modify the Lambda function to use the RDS Proxy endpoint instead of the database endpoint.
options.C: Create a read replica for the database in a different AWS Region. Use query string parameters in API Gateway to route traffic to the read replica.
options.D: Migrate the data from Aurora PostgreSQL to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Modify the Lambda function to use the DynamoDB table.

explanations.A: 配置预置并劶并将数据库修改为全局数据库： 错误：预置并发可以优化Lambda函数的启动时间，但无法解决数据寑连接社多导致的资源消耗问题。 错误：将数据寑修改为全宓数据寑并不能直接解决高并发连接问题，目会增加复杂性和成本。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon RDS Proxy并修改Lambda函数： 正确：RDS Proxy可以管理数据寑连接池，减少数据寑的连接压力，特别是在高并发场景下。 正确：修改Lambda函数以使用RDS Proxy端点是一个低成本目有效的解决方案。
explanations.C: 创建勀读副本并使用API Gateway路由流量： 错误：只读副本只能处理读取请求，无法解决写入请求的高并发问题。 错误：使用API Gateway路由流量到只读副本无法解决数据寑连接社多的问题。
explanations.D: 迁移到DynamoDB并修改Lambda函数： 错误：迁移到DynamoDB需要对应用程序进行重大修改，违背了“最少改动”的要求。 错误：DynamoDB适合处理非关系型数据，而题目中使用的是Aurora PostgreSQL关系型数据寑。

question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The application needs to access an Amazon DynamoDB table. What is the MOST secure way to access the table while ensuring that the traffic does not leave the AWS network?

options.A: Use a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.
options.B: Use a NAT gateway in a public subnet.
options.C: Use a NAT instance in a private subnet.
options.D: Use the internet gateway attached to the VPC.

explanations.A: Use a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB. 正确：VPC Endpoint允许私有子网中的资源通过AWS网络直接访问DynamoDB，而无需流量离开AWS网络。 这是最安全的方式，因为流量不会经过互联网，目VPC Endpoint支持安全的通人。
explanations.B: Use a NAT gateway in a public subnet. 错误：NAT Gateway用于将私有子网中的流量路由到互联网，但本题要求流量不离开AWS网络。 使用NAT Gateway会导致流量离开AWS网络，违背题目要求。
explanations.C: Use a NAT instance in a private subnet. 错误：NAT Instance的功能与NAT Gateway类似，主要用于将私有子网中的流量路由到互联网。 同样会导致流量离开AWS网络，不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Use the internet gateway attached to the VPC. 错误：Internet Gateway用于将VPC中的流量路由到互联网。 使用Internet Gateway会导致流量离开AWS网络，完全不符合题目要求。

question: An entertainment company is using Amazon DynamoDB to store media metadata. The application is read intensive and experiencing delays. The company does not have staff to handle additional operational overhead and needs to improve the performance efficiency of DynamoDB without reconfiguring the application. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
options.B: Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
options.C: Replicate data by using DynamoDB global tables.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with Auto Discovery enabled.

explanations.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Redis 是一种高性能的缓存解决方案，可以用于加速数据库查询。 然而，使用 Redis 需要额外的配置和开发工作来集成到现有应用中，这与题目中“不需要重新配置应用”的要求不符。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.B: Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX). DAX 是专门为 DynamoDB 提供的内存中缓存服务，能够显著提高读性能。 它与 DynamoDB 无缝集成，不需要对现有应用进行重大修改。 符合题目要求，因此此选项正确。
explanations.C: Replicate data by using DynamoDB global tables. 全球表用于跨区域复制数据，主要解决多区域可用性和延迟问题。 虽然全球表可以提高性能，但它并不是专门针对读密集型场景的优化方案，目可能需要额外的配置工作。 因此，此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with Auto Discovery enabled. Memcached 是另一种缓存解决方案，支持自动发现功能。 与 Redis 类似，使用 Memcached 需要额外的开发工作来集成到现有应用中，这与题目中“不需要重新配置应用”的要求不符。 因此，此选项错误。

question: A company’s infrastructure consists of Amazon EC2 instances and an Amazon RDS DB instance in a single AWS Region. The company wants to back up its data in a separate Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Backup to copy EC2 backups and RDS backups to the separate Region.
options.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to copy EC2 backups and RDS backups to the separate Region.
options.C: Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to the separate Region. Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance in the separate Region.
options.D: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots. Copy the EBS snapshots to the separate Region. Create RDS snapshots. Export the RDS snapshots to Amazon S3. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to the separate Region.

explanations.A: Use AWS Backup to copy EC2 backups and RDS backups to the separate Region. 正确：AWS Backup是一种集中式备份服务，支持跨区域备份，能够自动化备份任务并减少操作复杂性。 最少的操作开销：AWS Backup可以直接配置跨区域备份策略，无需手动管理快照或其他资源。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to copy EC2 backups and RDS backups to the separate Region. 错误：Amazon DLM主要用于管理EBS快照生命周期，而不是直接支持RDS备份或跨区域备份。 操作复杂性较高：需要单独处理RDS备份，无法统一管理。
explanations.C: Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to the separate Region. Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance in the separate Region. 错误：虽然AMIs可以跨区域复制，但这需要手动操作，增加了操作开销。 RDS只读副本是用于高可用性和性能优化，而不是备份解决方案。
explanations.D: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots. Copy the EBS snapshots to the separate Region. Create RDS snapshots. Export the RDS snapshots to Amazon S3. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to the separate Region. 错误：此选项涉及多个步骤，包括手动管理EBS快照、RDS快照导出和S3跨区域复制，操作复杂性较高。 虽然可以实现目标，但不符合“最少操作开销”的要求。

question: A solutions architect needs to securely store a database user name and password that an application uses to access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The application that accesses the database runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The solutions architect wants to create a secure parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has read access to the Parameter Store parameter. Allow Decrypt access to an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter. Assign this IAM role to the EC2 instance.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that allows read access to the Parameter Store parameter. Allow Decrypt access to an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter. Assign this IAM policy to the EC2 instance.
options.C: Create an IAM trust relationship between the Parameter Store parameter and the EC2 instance. Specify Amazon RDS as a principal in the trust policy.
options.D: Create an IAM trust relationship between the DB instance and the EC2 instance. Specify Systems Manager as a principal in the trust policy.

explanations.A: Create an IAM role that has read access to the Parameter Store parameter. Allow Decrypt access to an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter. Assign this IAM role to the EC2 instance. 正确：此选项描述了最佳实践。通过创建 IAM 角色并赋予其读取 Parameter Store 参数的权限，同时允许解密 KMS 加密的参数， 确保 EC2 实例能够安全访问敏感人息。 IAM 角色是分配给 EC2 实例的最佳方式，因为它避免了硬编码认证，并且可以动态管理权限。
explanations.B: Create an IAM policy that allows read access to the Parameter Store parameter. Allow Decrypt access to an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter. Assign this IAM policy to the EC2 instance. 错误：IAM 策略不能直接分配给 EC2 实例。IAM 策略需要附加到 IAM 角色或用户，而 EC2 实例只能通过 IAM 角色来获取权限。
explanations.C: Create an IAM trust relationship between the Parameter Store parameter and the EC2 instance. Specify Amazon RDS as a principal in the trust policy. 错误：IAM 人任关系的主体应该是 EC2 实例或相关的 IAM 角色，而不是 Amazon RDS。此选项的描述不符合 AWS 的权限管理逻 辑。
explanations.D: Create an IAM trust relationship between the DB instance and the EC2 instance. Specify Systems Manager as a principal in the trust policy. 错误：DB 实例和 EC2 实例之间不需要直接的 IAM 人任关系。Systems Manager Parameter Store 的权限管理是通过 IAM 角色和策 略来实现的，而不是通过人任关系。

question: A company is designing a cloud communications platform that is driven by APIs. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The company uses Amazon API Gateway to provide external users with access to the application through APIs. The company wants to protect the platform against web exploits like SQL injection and also wants to detect and mitigate large, sophisticated DDoS attacks. Which combination of solutions provides the MOST protection? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS WAF to protect the NLB.
options.B: Use AWS Shield Advanced with the NLB.
options.C: Use AWS WAF to protect Amazon API Gateway.
options.D: Use Amazon GuardDuty with AWS Shield Standard
options.E: Use AWS Shield Standard with Amazon API Gateway.

explanations.A: Use AWS WAF to protect the NLB. 错误：AWS WAF无法直接保护Network Load Balancer (NLB)。AWS WAF主要用于保护Amazon API Gateway、Application Load Balancer (ALB)和CloudFront。
explanations.B: Use AWS Shield Advanced with the NLB. 正确：AWS Shield Advanced提供高级DDoS保护，可以与NLB结合使用，帮助检测和缓解复杂的DDoS攻击。
explanations.C: Use AWS WAF to protect Amazon API Gateway. 正确：AWS WAF可以保护Amazon API Gateway免受Web漏洞攻击，例如SQL注入和跨站脚本攻击。
explanations.D: Use Amazon GuardDuty with AWS Shield Standard. 错误：Amazon GuardDuty是一个威胁检测服务，但它不能直接提供DDoS保护。AWS Shield Standard是默正启用的基础DDoS保 护，但它不提供高级功能。
explanations.E: Use AWS Shield Standard with Amazon API Gateway. 错误：AWS Shield Standard是默正启用的基础DDoS保护，但它不提供高级功能。题目要求检测和缓解“大型、复杂的DDoS攻击”， 需要使用AWS Shield Advanced。

question: A company has a legacy data processing application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Data is processed sequentially, but the order of results does not matter. The application uses a monolithic architecture. The only way that the company can scale the application to meet increased demand is to increase the size of the instances. The company’s developers have decided to rewrite the application to use a microservices architecture on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). What should a solutions architect recommend for communication between the microservices?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Add code to the data producers, and send data to the queue. Add code to the data consumers to process data from the queue.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Add code to the data producers, and publish notifications to the topic. Add code to the data consumers to subscribe to the topic.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to pass messages. Add code to the data producers to call the Lambda function with a data object. Add code to the data consumers to receive a data object that is passed from the Lambda function.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable DynamoDB Streams. Add code to the data producers to insert data into the table. Add code to the data consumers to use the DynamoDB Streams API to detect new table entries and retrieve the data.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Amazon SQS是一个完全托管的消息队列服务，适合异步通人场景。 数据生产者将消息发送到队列，消费者从队列中拉取消息进行处理。这种模式支持解兢和高知吐量。 由于数据处理顺序不重要，SQS非常适合这种场景。 正确选项。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Amazon SNS是一个发布/订阅消息服务，适合实时通知和广播消息。 虽然SNS可以将消息发送给多个订阅者，但它不支持消息持久化，消费者必须实时处理消息。 本题要求异步处理，SNS不适合此场景。 错误选项。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to pass messages. AWS Lambda适合事件驱动的计算，但它不是专门设计用于消息队列的服务。 使用Lambda传递消息会增加复杂性，并且不支持消息持久化。 本题要求异步处理，Lambda不适合此场景。 错误选项。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable DynamoDB Streams. DynamoDB Streams可以检测表中的新条目并触发事件，但它主要用于数据变化的实时处理。 使用DynamoDB作为消息队列会增加复杂性，并且不如SQS专注于消息队列场景。 本题要求异步处理，DynamoDB Streams不适合此场景。 错误选项。

question: A company wants to migrate its MySQL database from on premises to AWS. The company recently experienced a database outage that significantly impacted the business. To ensure this does not happen again, the company wants a reliable database solution on AWS that minimizes data loss and stores every transaction on at least two nodes. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance with synchronous replication to three nodes in three Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance with Multi-AZ functionality enabled to synchronously replicate the data.
options.C: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance and then create a read replica in a separate AWS Region that synchronously replicates the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon EC2 instance with a MySQL engine installed that triggers an AWS Lambda function to synchronously replicate the data to an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance with synchronous replication to three nodes in three Availability Zones. 错误：Amazon RDS 的 Multi-AZ 功能确实使用同步复制，但它不会明确地让用户配置到三个节点。RDS Multi-AZ 的实现是自动 的，用户无法直接选择节点数量。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance with Multi-AZ functionality enabled to synchronously replicate the data. 正确：Amazon RDS 的 Multi-AZ 功能提供了高可用性和数据宛余。它通过同步复制确保数据在主实例和备用实例之间保持一致，从 而最小化数据丢失。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance and then create a read replica in a separate AWS Region that synchronously replicates the data. 错误：Amazon RDS 的跨区域只读副本使用的是异步复制，而不是同步复制。这不符合题目要求的“最小化数据丢失”。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon EC2 instance with a MySQL engine installed that triggers an AWS Lambda function to synchronously replicate the data to an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. 错误：这种方案复杂目不符合最佳实践。使用 EC2 和 Lambda 手动实现同步复制不仅增加了管理复杂性，还可能导致性能问题。

question: A company is building a new dynamic ordering website. The company wants to minimize server maintenance and patching. The website must be highly available and must scale read and write capacity as quickly as possible to meet changes in user demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Host static content in Amazon S3. Host dynamic content by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. Use Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity for the database. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver the website content.
options.B: Host static content in Amazon $3. Host dynamic content by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. Use Amazon Aurora with Aurora Auto Scaling for the database. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver the website content.
options.C: Host all the website content on Amazon EC2 instances. Create an Auto Scaling group to scale the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic. Use Amazon DynamoDB with provisioned write capacity for the database.
options.D: Host all the website content on Amazon EC2 instances. Create an Auto Scaling group to scale the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic. Use Amazon Aurora with Aurora Auto Scaling for the database.

explanations.A: 1. 考察的知识点 无服务器架构 (Serverless Architecture) Amazon S3 用于托管静态内容 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 用于动态内容处理 Amazon DynamoDB 的按需容量模式 Amazon CloudFront 用于内容分发和加速 高可用性和自动扩展能力 2. 选项分析 A: 静态内容托管在Amazon S3: 正确，S3 是托管静态内容的最佳选择，支持高可用性和低成本。 动态内容使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda: 正确，无服务器架构减少了服务器维护和补丁工作，同时支持自动扩展。 数据库使用Amazon DynamoDB 的按需容量: 正确，按需容量模式支持自动扩展，适合动态负载。 使用Amazon CloudFront: 正确，CloudFront 提供全球内容分发和加速。 此选项完全符合题目要求。 B: 静态内容托管在Amazon S3: 正确。 动态内容使用Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda: 正确。 数据库使用 Amazon Aurora 和 Aurora Auto Scaling: $i, Aurora 是关系型数据库，虽然支持自动扩展，但相比 DynamoDB， Aurora 的管理复杂性更高，不完全符合"最小化服务器维护和补丁"的要求。 使用Amazon CloudFront: 正确。 此选项不完全符合题目要求。 Cc: 所有内容托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上: 错误，EC2 需要手动管理服务器，增加了维护和补丁工作量，不符合题目要求。 创建 Auto Scaling 组: 正确，但 EC2 的管理复杂性较高。 使用Application Load Balancer: 正确，但不符合无服务器架构的要求。 数据库使用Amazon DynamoDB 的预置写入容量: 错误，预置容量模式需要手动调整，无法快速响应需求变化。 此选项不符合题目要求。 D: 所有内容托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上: 错误，同选项 C，增加了维护和补丁工作量。 创建 Auto Scaling 组: 正确，但 EC2 的管理复杂性较高。 使用Application Load Balancer: 正确，但不符合无服务器架构的要求。 数据库使用Amazon Aurora 和 Aurora Auto Scaling: 错误，同选项 B，Aurora 的管理复杂性较高。 此选项不符合题目要求。 3. 我的答案 A 4. 官方答案 A 5. 与官方答案比较 我的答案与官方答案一致。 选项A 是最佳解决方案，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Incorrect. API Gateway + Lambda are serverless, but Aurora Auto Scaling only scales read replicas (read capacity) and cannot rapidly scale write capacity the way DynamoDB on-demand can.
explanations.C: Incorrect. Hosting all content on EC2 requires managing and patching servers, which conflicts with minimizing maintenance, and DynamoDB provisioned write capacity does not scale as quickly as on-demand capacity.
explanations.D: Incorrect. It also relies on EC2, which requires ongoing maintenance and patching and is not serverless, so it does not minimize server maintenance.

question: A company has an AWS account used for software engineering. The AWS account has access to the company’s on-premises data center through a pair of AWS Direct Connect connections. All non-VPC traffic routes to the virtual private gateway. A development team recently created an AWS Lambda function through the console. The development team needs to allow the function to access a database that runs in a private subnet in the company’s data center. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the Lambda function to run in the VPC with the appropriate security group. lambdakece Avec Hiatt, FER SWRL.
options.B: Set up a VPN connection from AWS to the data center. Route the traffic from the Lambda function through the VPN. MAWSEISE PLDI —hV PNB, TEISVPNES HH Lambdakkaxeyiatee.
options.C: Update the route tables in the VPC to allow the Lambda function to access the on-premises data center through Direct Connect.
options.D: Create an Elastic IP address. Configure the Lambda function to send traffic through the Elastic IP address without an elastic network interface.

explanations.A: Configure the Lambda function to run in the VPC with the appropriate security group. 正确：Lambda函数默正运行在AWS的托管环境中，无法直接访问VPC资源或本地数据中心。将Lambda函数配置为运行在VPC中， 并分配适当的安全组，可以确保它能够通过Direct Connect访问本地数据中心的资源。
explanations.B: Set up a VPN connection from AWS to the data center. Route the traffic from the Lambda function through the VPN. 错误：题目中已经提到公司使用AWS Direct Connect连接到本地数据中心，因此不需要额外设置VPN连接。
explanations.C: Update the route tables in the VPC to allow the Lambda function to access the on-premises data center through Direct Connect. 错误：虽然更新路由表是必要的，但仅更新路由表不足以让Lambda函数访问VPC资源。Lambda函数必须运行在VPC中孆能使用这 些路由。
explanations.D: Create an Elastic IP address. Configure the Lambda function to send traffic through the Elastic IP address without an elastic network interface. 错误：Elastic IP地址与Lambda函数的网络访问无关。Lambda函数需要通过VPC和安全组来访问本地数据中心，而不是通过Elastic IP地址。

question: A company runs an application using Amazon ECS. The application creates resized versions of an original image and then makes Amazon S3 API calls to store the resized images in Amazon S3. How can a solutions architect ensure that the application has permission to access Amazon S3?

options.A: Update the S3 role in AWS IAM to allow read/write access from Amazon ECS, and then relaunch the container.
options.B: Create an IAM role with S3 permissions and then specify that role as the taskRoleArn in the task definition.
options.C: Create a security group that allows access from Amazon ECS to Amazon S3, and update the launch configuration used by the ECS cluster.
options.D: Create an IAM user with S3 permissions, and then relaunch the Amazon EC2 instances for the ECS cluster while logged in as this account.

explanations.A: 更新 AWS IAM 中的 S3 角色以允许从 Amazon ECS 进行读/写访问，然后重新启动容器。 错误：IAM角色不能直接与Amazon ECS关联。需要通过任务定义中的taskRoleArn属性将IAM角色绑定到任务。
explanations.B: 创建一个具有 S3 权限的 IAM 角色，然后在任务定义中将该角色指定为 taskRoleArn。 正确：这是最佳实践。通过在任务定义中指定taskRoleArn，ECS任务可以使用该IAM角色访问Amazon S3。
explanations.C: 创建一个允许从 Amazon ECS 访问 Amazon S3 的安全组，并更新 ECS 集群使用的启动配置。 错误：安全组用于控制网络流量，而不是权限管理。无法通过安全组授予ECS任务对S3的访问权限。
explanations.D: 创建一个具有 S3 权限的 IAM 用户，然后以该账户登录重新启动 ECS 集群的 Amazon EC2 实例。 错误：IAM用户是为人类用户或应用程序设计的，而不是为ECS任务设计的。ECS任务应该使用IAM角色而不是IAM用户。

question: A company has a Windows-based application that must be migrated to AWS. The application requires the use of a shared Windows file system attached to multiple Amazon EC2 Windows instances that are deployed across multiple Availability Zone: What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure AWS Storage Gateway in volume gateway mode. Mount the volume to each Windows instance.
options.B: Configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the Amazon FSx file system to each Windows instance.
options.C: Configure a file system by using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS file system to each Windows instance.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with the required size. Attach each EC2 instance to the volume. Mount the file system within the volume to each Windows instance.

explanations.A: Configure AWS Storage Gateway in volume gateway mode. Mount the volume to each Windows instance. 错误：AWS Storage Gateway主要用于混合云场景，将本地存储与AWS云存储集成。它不适合直接作为跨多个可用区的共享文件系 统解决方案。 此外，Volume Gateway模式主要用于块存储，而不是文件系统共享。
explanations.B: Configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the Amazon FSx file system to each Windows instance. 正确：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server是专门为Windows环境设计的托管文件系统服务，支持SMB协议，可以跨多个可用区提 供共享文件系统。 它完全满足题目要求，支持Windows实例之间的文件共享。
explanations.C: Configure a file system by using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS file system to each Windows instance. 错误：Amazon EFS是针对Linux环境设计的文件系统服务，不支持Windows实例的挂载。 因此，EFS无法满足题目中关于Windows共享文件系统的要求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with the required size. Attach each EC2 instance to the volume. Mount the file system within the volume to each Windows instance. 错误：Amazon EBS是块存储服务，不能直接作为共享文件系统使用。 一个EBS卷只能挂载到一个EC2实例，无法满足多个实例共享文件系统的需求。

question: A company is developing an ecommerce application that will consist of a load-balanced front end, a container-based application, and a relational database. A solutions architect needs to create a highly available solution that operates with as little manual intervention as possible. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance in Multi-AZ mode.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance and one or more replicas in another Availability Zone.
options.C: Create an Amazon EC2 instance-based Docker cluster to handle the dynamic application load.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with a Fargate launch type to handle the dynamic application load.
options.E: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an Amazon EC2 launch type to handle the dynamic application load.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance in Multi-AZ mode. 正确：Multi-AZ模式提供数据寑的高可用性和自动故障转移功能，符合题目要求的高可用性和最小化孅动寅预。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance and one or more replicas in another Availability Zone. 错误：虽然跨可用区的副本可以提高读取性能，但它不提供自动故障转移功能，因此不完全满足高可用性要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EC2 instance-based Docker cluster to handle the dynamic application load. 错误：EC2实例需要孅动管理和扩展，不符合题目要求的“宑量减少孅动寅预”。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with a Fargate launch type to handle the dynamic application load. 正确：Fargate是无服务器的容器运行模式，自动管理寓宔基础设施，符合高可用性和减少孅动寅预的要求。
explanations.E: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an Amazon EC2 launch type to handle the dynamic application load. 错误：EC2启动类型需要孅动管理寓宔实例，不符合题目要求的“宑量减少孅动寅预”。

question: A company uses Amazon S3 as its data lake. The company has a new partner that must use SFTP to upload data files. A solutions architect needs to implement a highly available SFTP solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Transfer Family to configure an SFTP-enabled server with a publicly accessible endpoint. Choose the S3 data lake as the destination.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway as an SFTP server. Expose the S3 File Gateway endpoint URL to the new partner. Share the S3 File Gateway endpoint with the new partner. {FH Amazon $3 File Gateway
options.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet in a VPlnstruct the new partner to upload files to the EC2 instance by using a VPN. Run a cron job script, on the EC2 instance to upload files to the S3 data lake.
options.D: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet in a VPC. Place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of the EC2 instances. Create an SFTP listener port for the NLB. Share the NLB hostname with the new partner. Run a cron job script on the EC2 instances to upload files to the S3 data lake.

explanations.A: Use AWS Transfer Family to configure an SFTP-enabled server with a publicly accessible endpoint. Choose the S3 data lake as the destination. 正确：AWS Transfer Family是专门设计用于支持SFTP、FTPS和FTP协议的托管服务，能够直接与Amazon S3集成。 正确：它提供高可用性，并且无需管理寓宔基础设施，符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。 正确：可以配置一个公开可访问的端点，满足合作伙伴的需求。
explanations.B: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway as an SFTP server. Expose the S3 File Gateway endpoint URL to the new partner. Share the S3 File Gateway endpoint with the new partner. 错误：Amazon S3 File Gateway是用于将本地文件系统与Amazon S3集成的服务，但它不支持SFTP协议。 错误：无法直接将S3 File Gateway作为SFTP服务器使用。
explanations.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet in a VPC. Instruct the new partner to upload files to the EC2 instance by using a VPN. Run a cron job script, on the EC2 instance to upload files to the S3 data lake. 错误：虽然可以通过EC2实例实现SFTP功能，但需要孅动配置和管理服务器，增加了运维开销。 错误：使用VPN增加了复杂性，不符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet in a VPC. Place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of the EC2 instances. Create an SFTP listener port for the NLB. Share the NLB hostname with the new partner. Run a cron job script on the EC2 instances to upload files to the S3 data lake. 错误：虽然可以通过NLB和EC2实现高可用的SFTP解决方案，但需要孅动管理多个EC2实例和负载均衡器，增加了运维开销。 错误：相比AWS Transfer Family，这种方案复杂目不符合“最小化运维开销”的要求。

question: A company needs to store contract documents. A contract lasts for 5 years. During the 5-year period, the company must ensure that the documents cannot be overwritten or deleted. The company needs to encrypt the documents at rest and rotate the encryption keys automatically every year. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the documents in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode.
options.B: Store the documents in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode.
options.C: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Configure key rotation.
options.D: Use server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. Configure key rotation.
options.E: Use server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer provided (imported) keys. Configure key rotation.

explanations.A: Store the documents in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode. 治理模式允许管理员绕社锁定规则，这不符合题目要求的“确保文件不能被覆盖或删除”的严格合规性要求。 因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: Store the documents in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode. 合规模式确保文件不能被覆盖或删除，即使是管理员也无法绕社锁定规则。 此选项符合题目要求，因此正确。
explanations.C: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Configure key rotation. SSE-S3使用Amazon S3托管的加密密钥，但它不支持用户控制的密钥轮换。 题目要求每年自动轮换加密密钥，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. Configure key rotation. AWS KMS客户托管密钥支持自动密钥轮换，符合题目要求。 此选项正确。
explanations.E: Use server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer provided (imported) keys. Configure key rotation. 客户提供的密钥需要手动管理密钥轮换，不支持自动轮换。 题目要求自动轮换加密密钥，因此此选项错误。

question: A company has a web application that is based on Java and PHP. The company plans to move the application from on premises to AWS. The company needs the ability to test new site features frequently. The company also needs a highly available and managed solution that requires minimum operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable static web hosting on the S3 bucket. Upload the static content to the S3 bucket. Use AWS Lambda to process all dynamic content.
options.B: Deploy the web application to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment. Use URL swapping to switch between multiple Elastic Beanstalk environments for feature testing.
options.C: Deploy the web application to Amazon EC2 instances that are configured with Java and PHP. Use Auto Scaling groups and an Application Load Balancer to manage the website's availability.
options.D: Containerize the web application. Deploy the web application to Amazon EC2 instances. Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to dynamically route traffic between containers that contain the new site features for testing.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable static web hosting on the S3 bucket. Upload the static content to the S3 bucket. Use AWS Lambda to process all dynamic content. 正确性分析：Amazon S3适合托管静态网站，但本题的应用是基于Java和PHP的动态网站，S3无法直接支持动态内容。 使用AWS Lambda处理动态内容虽然可行，但会增加开发复杂性，不符合“最低运营开销”的要求。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.B: Deploy the web application to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment. Use URL swapping to switch between multiple Elastic Beanstalk environments for feature testing. 正确性分析：AWS Elastic Beanstalk是一个托管服务，支持Java和PHP应用程序，能够自动处理部署、负载均衡和扩展，符合“最低 运营开销”的要求。 URL交换功能允许在多个环境之间快速切换，满足频繁测试新功能的需求。 结论：此选项正确。
explanations.C: Deploy the web application to Amazon EC2 instances that are configured with Java and PHP. Use Auto Scaling groups and an Application Load Balancer to manage the website’s availability. 正确性分析：虽然EC2实例可以支持Java和PHP应用程序，并且Auto Scaling和ALB可以提供高可用性，但需要手动管理实例配置和 部署，增加了运营开销。 结论：此选项错误。
explanations.D: Containerize the web application. Deploy the web application to Amazon EC2 instances. Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to dynamically route traffic between containers that contain the new site features for testing. 正确性分析：容器化部署需要额外的容器管理工具（如EKS或ECS），并且手动管理EC2实例和容器增加了运营开销。 虽然可以动态路由流量进行测试，但复杂性较高，不符合“最低运营开销”的要求。 结论：此选项错误。

question: A company has an ordering application that stores customer information in Amazon RDS for MySQL. During regular business hours, employees run one-time queries for reporting purposes. Timeouts are occurring during order processing because the reporting queries are taking a long time to run. The company needs to eliminate the timeouts without preventing employees from performing queries. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a read replica. Move reporting queries to the read replica.
options.B: Create a read replica. Distribute the ordering application to the primary DB instance and the read replica.
options.C: Migrate the ordering application to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity.
options.D: Schedule the reporting queries for non-peak hours.

explanations.A: Create a read replica. Move reporting queries to the read replica. 正确：创建一个读副本可以有效分担主数据库实例的读取压力。将报告查询移至读副本可以避免主实例因查询负载社高而发生超 时。 这是解决读写分畹问题的最佳实践。
explanations.B: Create a read replica. Distribute the ordering application to the primary DB instance and the read replica. 错误：读副本是只读的，无法处理写操作。订购应用程序需要写入数据，因此不能分配到读副本。 此选项不符合实际需求。
explanations.C: Migrate the ordering application to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity. 错误：虽然DynamoDB是一个高性能的NoSQL数据库，但迁移到DynamoDB需要对应用程序进行重大改动。 题目中并未提到需要更改数据库类型，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.D: Schedule the reporting queries for non-peak hours. 错误：虽然安排查询在非高峰时段运行可以减少主实例的压力，但这并不能完全解决问题。 员工可能需要随时运行查询，因此此选项不符合需求。

question: A hospital wants to create digital copies for its large collection of historical written records. The hospital will continue to add hundreds of new documents each day. The hospital's data team will scan the documents and will upload the documents to the AWS Cloud. A solutions architect must implement a solution to analyze the documents, extract the medical information, and store the documents so that an application can run SQL queries on the data. The solution must maximize scalability and operational efficiency. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Write the document information to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs a MySQL database.
options.B: Write the document information to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to run a custom application that processes the scanned files and extracts the medical information.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new documents are uploaded. Use Amazon Rekognition to convert the documents to raw text. Use Amazon Transcribe Medical to detect and extract relevant medical information from the text.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new documents are uploaded. Use Amazon Textract to convert the documents to raw text. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and extract relevant medical information from the text. IT

explanations.A: Write the document information to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs a MySQL database. 错误：使用EC2实例运行MySQL数据库不符合“最大化可扩展性和操作效率”的要求。EC2需要手动管理，目MySQL在处理大规模数据 时可能不如S3和Athena高效。
explanations.B: Write the document information to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. 正确：Amazon S3提供高可扩展性和低成本存储，适合存储大量文档。Amazon Athena可以直接查询存储在S3中的数据，支持SQL 查询，符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to run a custom application that processes the scanned files and extracts the medical information. 错误：使用EC2实例运行自定义应用程序需要手动管理和维护，增加了操作复杂性，不符合“最大化操作效率”的要求。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new documents are uploaded. Use Amazon Rekognition to convert the documents to raw text. Use Amazon Transcribe Medical to detect and extract relevant medical information from the text. 错误：Amazon Rekognition主要用于图像和视频分析，不适合文档文本提取。Amazon Transcribe Medical用于语音转录，不适合从 文档中提取医疗人息。
explanations.E: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new documents are uploaded. Use Amazon Textract to convert the documents to raw text. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and extract relevant medical information from the text. 正确：AWS Lambda可以自动触发处理上传的文档，Amazon Textract可以从文档中提取文本，Amazon Comprehend Medical可以 从文本中提取医疗人息，符合题目要求。

question: A company is running a batch application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application consists of a backend with multiple Amazon RDS databases. The application is causing a high number of reads on the databases. A solutions architect must reduce the number of database reads while ensuring high availability. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Add Amazon RDS read replicas.
options.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
options.C: Use Amazon Route 53 DNS caching.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached.

explanations.A: Add Amazon RDS read replicas. 正确：Amazon RDS读副本可以有效减少主数据库的读取压力，同时提供高可用性。读副本是专门设计用于处理高读取负载的场 景。 符合题目要求：减少数据库读取次数并确保高可用性。
explanations.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. 错误：虽然Redis可以作为缓存层减少数据库读取压力，但题目没有提到应用程序支持Redis或需要复杂的缓存逻辑。 Redis适用于需要高性能缓存的场景，但它并不直接提供数据库的高可用性功能。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Route 53 DNS caching. 错误：Route 53 DNS缓存主要用于优化域名解析速度，与减少数据库读取次数无关。 不符合题目要求：无法直接解决数据库读取压力问题。
explanations.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached. 错误：Memcached与Redis类似，可以作为缓存层减少数据库读取压力，但题目没有提到应用程序支持Memcached。 Memcached也不直接提供数据库的高可用性功能。

question: A company needs to run a critical application on AWS. The company needs to use Amazon EC2 for the application’s database. The database must be highly available and must fail over automatically if a disruptive event occurs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Launch two EC2 instances, each in a different Availability Zone in the same AWS Region. Install the database on both EC2 instances. Configure the EC2 instances as a cluster. Set up database replication.
options.B: Launch an EC2 instance in an Availability Zone. Install the database on the EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) to back up the data. Use AWS CloudFormation to automate provisioning of the EC2 instance if a disruptive event occurs.
options.C: Launch two EC2 instances, each in a different AWS Region. Install the database on both EC2 instances. Set up database replication. Fail over the database to a second Region.
options.D: Launch an EC2 instance in an Availability Zone. Install the database on the EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) to back up the data. Use EC2 automatic recovery to recover the instance if a disruptive event occurs.

explanations.A: Launch two EC2 instances, each in a different Availability Zone in the same AWS Region. Install the database on both EC2 instances. Configure the EC2 instances as a cluster. Set up database replication. 正确：此选项符合高可用性要求，因为它在同一区域的不同可用区中部署了两个 EC2 实例，并设置了数据库复制和集群配置。这样 可以确保在一个可用区发生故障时，另一个可用区的实例可以痰痲运行。
explanations.B: Launch an EC2 instance in an Availability Zone. Install the database on the EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) to back up the data. Use AWS CloudFormation to automate provisioning of the EC2 instance if a disruptive event occurs. 错误：此选项仅在一个可用区中部署了一个 EC2 实例，没有提供跨可用区的高可用性。虽然使用 AMI 和 CloudFormation 可以快速 恢复，但这不是自动故障转移，也无法满足高可用性要求。
explanations.C: Launch two EC2 instances, each in a different AWS Region. Install the database on both EC2 instances. Set up database replication. Fail over the database to a second Region. 错误：跨区域部署虽然可以提供灾难恢复，但它不是高可用性解决方案。跨区域故障转移通常需要手动干预，目延迟较高，不符合 题目要求的自动故障转移。
explanations.D: Launch an EC2 instance in an Availability Zone. Install the database on the EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) to back up the data. Use EC2 automatic recovery to recover the instance if a disruptive event occurs. 错误：EC2 自动恢复仅适用于实例级别的故障（如畦件故障），而不是可用区级别的故障。此外，此选项没有跨可用区的部署，无 法满足高可用性要求。

question: A company’s order system sends requests from clients to Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances process the orders and then store the orders in a database on Amazon RDS. Users report that they must reprocess orders when the system fails. The company wants a resilient solution that can process orders automatically if a system outage occurs. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to target an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task.
options.B: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Update the order system to send messages to the ALB endpoint.
options.C: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Configure the order system to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the EC2 instances to consume messages from the queue.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function, and subscribe the function to the SNS topic. Configure the order system to send messages to the SNS topic. Send a command to the EC2 instances to process the messages by using AWS Systems Manager Run Command.

explanations.A: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to target an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task. 分析： 将 EC2 实例移入 Auto Scaling 组是正确的，因为它可以提供弹性和高可用性。 使用 EventBridge 和 ECS 任务并不适合解决订单系统的消息处理问题。EventBridge 主要用于事件驱动的架构，而 ECS 任务的使用 并未明确解决消息的持久性问题。 此选项未提到如何处理消息的持久性和重试机制，因此不符合要求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.B: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Update the order system to send messages to the ALB endpoint. 分析： 将 EC2 实例移入 Auto Scaling 组是正确的，因为它可以提供弹性和高可用性。 使用 ALB 作为消息传递的入口点并不适合订单系统的需求。ALB 主要用于处理 HTTP/HTTPS 请求，而不是消息队列的功能。 此选项未解决消息的持久性问题，也未提供重试机制，因此不符合要求。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Configure the order system to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the EC2 instances to consume messages from the queue. 分析： 将 EC2 实例移入 Auto Scaling 组是正确的，因为它可以提供弹性和高可用性。 使用 Amazon SQS 队列可以确保消息的持久性，并提供重试机制，适合处理订单系统的需求。 EC2 实例可以从 SQS 队列中消费消息，确保即使系统发生故障，消息仍然可以被处理。 结论： 正确。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function, and subscribe the function to the SNS topic. Configure the order system to send messages to the SNS topic. Send a command to the EC2 instances to process the messages by using AWS Systems Manager Run Command. 分析： 使用 SNS 主题和 Lambda 函数可以实现消息的分发，但 SNS 不提供消息的持久性和重试机制。 通过 Systems Manager Run Command 向 EC2 实例发送命令处理消息的方式较为复杂，并不适合订单系统的需求。 此选项未解决消息的持久性问题，因此不符合要求。 结论： 错误。

question: A company runs an application on a large fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads and writes entries into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The size of the DynamoDB table continuously grows, but the application needs only data from the last 30 days. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and development effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the complete solution. Redeploy the CloudFormation stack every 30 days, and delete the original stack.
options.B: Use an EC2 instance that runs a monitoring application from AWS Marketplace. Configure the monitoring application to use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to store the timestamp when a new item is created in the table. Use a script that runs on the EC2 instance to delete items that have a timestamp that is older than 30 days.
options.C: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function when a new item is created in the table. Configure the Lambda function to delete items in the table that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Extend the application to add an attribute that has a value of the current timestamp plus 30 days to each new item that is created in the table. Configure DynamoDB to use the attribute as the TTL attribute.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署完整解决方案。每 30 天重新部署 CloudFormation 堆栈，并删除原始堆栈。 错误：CloudFormation主要用于资源的自动化部署和管理，而不是数据管理。重新部署整个堆栈并删除原始堆栈的方式效率低下， 目不符合“最小化开发工作量”的要求。
explanations.B: 使用运行来自 AWS Marketplace 的监控应用程序的 EC2 实例。配置监控应用程序使用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 存储表中 新项目创建时的时间戳。在 EC2 实例上运行一个脚本以删除时间戳超过 30 天的项目。 错误：这种方法需要额外的EC2实例和监控应用程序，增加了成本和复杂性。手动运行脚本也增加了开发工作量，不符合“最小化成 本和开发工作量”的要求。
explanations.C: 配置 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 在表中新项目创建时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数以删除表中超过 30 天的 项目。 错误：虽然使用Lambda函数可以自动化删除操作，但需要额外的开发工作来编写和维护Lambda函数逻辑。相比D选项，开发工作 量更大。
explanations.D: 扩展应用程序，为表中新创建的每个项目添加一个属性，该属性的值为当前时间戳加 30 天。配置 DynamoDB 使用该属性作为 TTL 属性。 正确：DynamoDB的TTL功能可以自动删除过期数据，无需额外的开发工作或资源。通过设置TTL属性，DynamoDB会自动清理超过 30天的数据，符合“最小化成本和开发工作量”的要求。

question: A company has a Microsoft .NET application that runs on an on-premises Windows Server. The application stores data by using an Oracle Database Standard Edition server. The company is planning a migration to AWS and wants to minimize development changes while moving the application. The AWS application environment should be highly available. Which combination of actions should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Refactor the application as serverless with AWS Lambda functions running .NET Core.
options.B: Rehost the application in AWS Elastic Beanstalk with the .NET platform in a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.C: Replatform the application to run on Amazon EC2 with the Amazon Linux Amazon Machine Image (AMI).
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate from the Oracle database to Amazon DynamoDB in a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate from the Oracle database to Oracle on Amazon RDS in a Multi-AZ deployment.

explanations.A: Refactor the application as serverless with AWS Lambda functions running .NET Core. 错误：重构应用程序为无服务器架构需要大量开发工作，与题目要求的“最小化开发更改”不符。
explanations.B: Rehost the application in AWS Elastic Beanstalk with the .NET platform in a Multi-AZ deployment. 正确：AWS Elastic Beanstalk支持.NET平台，可以快速迁移应用程序，同时支持多可用区部署以实现高可用性。
explanations.C: Replatform the application to run on Amazon EC2 with the Amazon Linux Amazon Machine Image (AMI). 错误：题目提到应用程序运行在Windows Server上，而Amazon Linux AMI不支持Windows环境，迁移到Linux需要大量开发工作。
explanations.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate from the Oracle database to Amazon DynamoDB in a Multi-AZ deployment. 错误：DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，与现有的Oracle数据库（关系型数据库）架构不兼容，迁移到DynamoDB需要对应用程序进行 大量修改。
explanations.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate from the Oracle database to Oracle on Amazon RDS in a Multi-AZ deployment. 正确：Amazon RDS支持Oracle数据库，可以使用AWS DMS进行迁移，同时支持多可用区部署以实现高可用性。

question: A company runs a containerized application on a Kubernetes cluster in an on-premises data center. The company is using a MongoDB database for data storage. The company wants to migrate some of these environments to AWS, but no code changes or deployment method changes are possible at this time. The company needs a solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes for compute and MongoDB on EC2 for data storage.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWs Fargate for compute and Amazon DynamoDB for data storage
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes for compute and Amazon DynamoDB for data storage. {$F Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with AWS Fargate for compute and Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) for data storage. {$F Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)

explanations.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes for compute and MongoDB on EC2 for data storage. 正确性分析：Amazon ECS可以运行容器化应用，但使用EC2实例运行MongoDB会增加管理开销（如手动安装、维护、备份等）。 错误原因：不符合“最小化操作开销”的要求。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate for compute and Amazon DynamoDB for data storage. 正确性分析：AWS Fargate减少了管理计算资源的开销，但DynamoDB是NoSQL数据库，与MongoDB的兼容性较低。 错误原因：需要代码修改以适配DynamoDB，不符合“不做代码或部署方法更改”的要求。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes for compute and Amazon DynamoDB for data storage. 正确性分析：Amazon EKS支持Kubernetes，但DynamoDB与MongoDB不兼容，目EC2 worker nodes增加了管理开销。 错误原因：不符合“不做代码更改”和“最小化操作开销”的要求。
explanations.D: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with AWS Fargate for compute and Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) for data storage. 正确性分析：Amazon EKS支持Kubernetes，AWS Fargate减少了计算资源管理开销，Amazon DocumentDB与MongoDB兼容，满 足“不做代码更改”的要求。 正确原因：完全符合题目要求，最小化操作开销目无需代码或部署方法更改。

question: A telemarketing company is designing its customer call center functionality on AWS. The company needs a solution that provides multiple speaker recognition and generates transcript files. The company wants to query the transcript files to analyze the business patterns. The transcript files must be stored for 7 years for auditing purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Rekognition for multiple speaker recognition. Store the transcript files in Amazon S3. Use machine learning models for transcript file analysis.
options.B: Use Amazon Transcribe for multiple speaker recognition. Use Amazon Athena for transcript file analysis.
options.C: Use Amazon Translate for multiple speaker recognition. Store the transcript files in Amazon Redshift. Use SQL queries for transcript file analysis.
options.D: Use Amazon Rekognition for multiple speaker recognition. Store the transcript files in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Textract for transcript file analysis.

explanations.A: 使用Amazon Rekognition进行多位讲话者识别。将转录文件存储在Amazon S3中。使用机器学习模型进行转录文件分析。 错误：Amazon Rekognition主要用于图像和视频分析，不支持多位讲话者识别。 正确：Amazon S3可以存储转录文件，满足长期存储需求。 错误：题目没有明确要求使用机器学习模型进行分析，目未提到具体的分析工具。
explanations.B: 使用Amazon Transcribe进行多位讲话者识别。使用Amazon Athena进行转录文件分析。 正确：Amazon Transcribe支持多位讲话者识别并生成转录文件。 正确：Amazon Athena可以对存储在Amazon S3中的转录文件进行SQL查询分析。 正确：Amazon S3可以满足7年的长期存储需求。
explanations.C: 使用Amazon Translate进行多位讲话者识别。将转录文件存储在Amazon Redshift中。使用SQL查询进行转录文件分析。 错误：Amazon Translate用于语言翻译，不支持多位讲话者识别。 错误：Amazon Redshift是数据仓库服务，虽然支持SQL查询，但不适合存储转录文件进行长期存储。
explanations.D: 使用Amazon Rekognition进行多位讲话者识别。将转录文件存储在Amazon S3中。使用Amazon Textract进行转录文件分析。 错误：Amazon Rekognition不支持多位讲话者识别。 正确：Amazon S3可以存储转录文件，满足长期存储需求。 错误：Amazon Textract用于提取文档中的文本人息，不适合分析转录文件。

question: A company hosts its application on AWS. The company uses Amazon Cognito to manage users. When users log in to the application, the application fetches required data from Amazon DynamoDB by using a REST API that is hosted in Amazon API Gateway. The company wants an AWS managed solution that will control access to the REST API to reduce development efforts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an AWS Lambda function to be an authorizer in API Gateway to validate which user made the request.
options.B: For each user, create and assign an API key that must be sent with each request. Validate the key by using an AWS Lambda function.
options.C: Send the users email address in the header with every request. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to validate that the user with that email address has proper access.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Cognito user pool authorizer in API Gateway to allow Amazon Cognito to validate each request. £ API Gateway

explanations.A: 配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数作为 API Gateway 中的授权器，用于验证哪个用户发出了请求。 分析：虽然Lambda授权器可以实现用户验证，但它需要开发和维护自定义代码，增加了运维工作量。这不符合题目要求的“减少开 发努力”和“最少运维开销”。因此此选项错误。
explanations.B: 为每个用户创建并分配一个必须随每次请求发送的 API 密钥。使用 AWS Lambda 函数验证该密钥。 分析：API密钥的管理和分配需要额外的开发工作，并且API密钥本身并不提供用户身份验证功能。还需要额外的Lambda函数来验证 密钥，这增加了运维复杂性。因此此选项错误。
explanations.C: 在每次请求的头部中发送用户的电子邮件地址。调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数以验证具有该电子邮件地址的用户是否具有适当的 访问权限。 分析：这种方法需要开发和维护自定义Lambda函数来验证用户权限，并且直接发送用户的电子邮件地址可能存在安全隐嬣。这不 符合题目要求的“减少开发努力”和“最少运维开销”。因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: 在 API Gateway 中配置一个 Amazon Cognito 用户池授权器，以允许 Amazon Cognito 验证每个请求。 分析：Amazon Cognito用户池授权器是AWS托管的解决方案，能够直接与API Gateway集成，自动处理用户身份验证和授权。这种 方法减少了开发工作量和运维开销，完全符合题目要求。因此此选项正确。

question: A company is developing a marketing communications service that targets mobile app users. The company needs to send confirmation messages with Short Message Service (SMS) to its users. The users must be able to reply to the SMS messages. The company must store the responses for a year for analysis. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Connect contact flow to send the SMS messages. Use AWS Lambda to process the responses.
options.B: Build an Amazon Pinpoint journey. Configure Amazon Pinpoint to send events to an Amazon Kinesis data stream for analysis and archiving.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to distribute the SMS messages. Use AWS Lambda to process the responses.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic. Subscribe an Amazon Kinesis data stream to the SNS topic for analysis and archiving.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Connect contact flow to send the SMS messages. Use AWS Lambda to process the responses. Amazon Connect主要用于构建呼叫中心解决方案，而不是发送SMS消息。 虽然可以使用AWS Lambda处理回复，但Amazon Connect并不适合此场景。 错误原因：此选项不符合发送SMS消息和存储回复的需求。
explanations.B: Build an Amazon Pinpoint journey. Configure Amazon Pinpoint to send events to an Amazon Kinesis data stream for analysis and archiving. Amazon Pinpoint专门用于发送SMS消息和管理用户交互。 可以配置将事件发送到Amazon Kinesis数据流以进行分析和归档。 正确原因：此选项完全满足发送SMS消息、处理回复以及存储数据的需求。
explanations.C: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to distribute the SMS messages. Use AWS Lambda to process the responses. Amazon SQS主要用于消息队列，而不是直接发送SMS消息。 虽然可以使用AWS Lambda处理回复，但SQS不适合发送SMS消息。 错误原因：此选项不符合发送SMS消息的需求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic. Subscribe an Amazon Kinesis data stream to the SNS topic for analysis and archiving. Amazon SNS可以发送通知，但不支持用户回复SMS消息。 FIFO主题主要用于严格的消息顺序，而不是SMS消息发送。 错误原因：此选项不支持用户回复SMS消息的需求。

question: A company is planning to move its data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted when it is stored in the S3 bucket. Additionally, the encryption key must be automatically rotated every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Move the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year.
options.D: Encrypt the data with customer key material before moving the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation.

explanations.A: Move the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys. 分析： SSE-S3是Amazon S3的内置加密选项，使用Amazon S3管理的加密密钥。 SSE-S3自动管理密钥的创建和轮换，无需用户干预。 此选项完全满足题目要求，并且操作开销最低。 结论： 正确。
