explanations.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. 分析： 使用AWS KMS客户管理密钥可以实现加密和自动密钥轮换。 虽然满足题目要求，但需要额外的配置和管理KMS密钥，增加了操作开销。 结论： 错误。
explanations.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year. 分析： 手动轮换KMS密钥增加了操作开销，不符合题目要求的“自动轮换”。 此选项不满足题目要求的最少操作开销。 结论： 错误。
explanations.D: Encrypt the data with customer key material before moving the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation. 分析： 此选项要求用户在迁移数据之前手动加密数据，并导入客户密钥材料到KMS。 操作复杂目不符合题目要求的“最少操作开销”。 结论： 错误。

question: The customers of a finance company request appointments with financial advisors by sending text messages. A web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances accepts the appointment requests. The text messages are published to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue through the web application. Another application that runs on EC2 instances then sends meeting invitations and meeting confirmation email messages to the customers. After successful scheduling, this application stores the meeting information in an Amazon DynamoDB database. As the company expands, customers report that their meeting invitations are taking longer to arrive. What should a solutions architect recommend to resolve this issue?

options.A: Add a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the DynamoDB database.
options.B: Add an Amazon API Gateway API in front of the web application that accepts the appointment requests.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the origin as the web application that accepts the appointment requests.
options.D: Add an Auto Scaling group for the application that sends meeting invitations. Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on the depth of the SQS queue.

explanations.A: Add a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the DynamoDB database. 错误：DAX主要用于加速对DynamoDB的读取操作，而题目中提到的问题是会议邀请发送延迟，与DynamoDB的性能无关。
explanations.B: Add an Amazon API Gateway API in front of the web application that accepts the appointment requests. 错误：API Gateway可以优化请求的管理，但问题的核心是会议邀请发送延迟，而不是预约请求的处理速寗。
explanations.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the origin as the web application that accepts the appointment requests. 错误：CloudFront主要用于内容分发和缓存静嬒资源，与会议邀请发送延迟无关。
explanations.D: Add an Auto Scaling group for the application that sends meeting invitations. Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on the depth of the SQS queue. 正确：通过监控SQS队列的棅寗，Auto Scaling组可以动嬒扩展处理会议邀请的EC2实例数量，从而减少延迟。

question: An online retail company has more than 50 million active customers and receives more than 25,000 orders each day. The company collects purchase data for customers and stores this data in Amazon S3. Additional customer data is stored in Amazon RDS. The company wants to make all the data available to various teams so that the teams can perform analytics. The solution must provide the ability to manage fine-grained permissions for the data and must minimize operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the purchase data to write directly to Amazon RDS. Use RDS access controls to limit access.
options.B: Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon RDS to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue crawler. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use S3 policies to limit access.
options.C: Create a data lake by using AWS Lake Formation. Create an AWS Glue JDBC connection to Amazon RDS. Register the S3 bucket in Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation access controls to limit access.
options.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift access controls to limit access.

explanations.A: Migrate the purchase data to write directly to Amazon RDS. Use RDS access controls to limit access. 错误原因：将所有数据迁移到Amazon RDS会导致存储成本增加，并且RDS不适合存储大量非结构化数据（如S3中的数据）。此 外，RDS的权限管理不够灵活，无法满足细粒度权限要求。
explanations.B: Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon RDS to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue crawler. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use S3 policies to limit access. 错误原因：虽然此方案可以实现数据分析，但S3策略的权限管理不够细粒度，无法满足题目要求。此外，定期复制数据增加了操作 复杂性。
explanations.C: Create a data lake by using AWS Lake Formation. Create an AWS Glue JDBC connection to Amazon RDS. Register the S3 bucket in Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation access controls to limit access. 正确原因：Lake Formation是专门设计用于构建数据湖的服务，支持细粒度权限管理。通过AWS Glue JDBC连接，可以集成RDS数 据；通过注册S3橘，可以集成S3数据。此方案满足了题目对权限管理和操作简化的要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift access controls to limit access. 错误原因：虽然Redshift适合数据分析，但定期复制数据增加了操作复杂性。此外，Redshift的权限管理不如Lake Formation灵活， 无法满足细粒度权限要求。

question: A company hosts a marketing website in an on-premises data center. The website consists of static documents and runs on a single server. An administrator updates the website content infrequently and uses an SFTP client to upload new documents. The company decides to host its website on AWS and to use Amazon CloudFront. The company’s solutions architect creates a CloudFront distribution. The solutions architect must design the most cost-effective and resilient architecture for website hosting to serve as the CloudFront origin. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a virtual server by using Amazon Lightsail. Configure the web server in the Lightsail instance. Upload website content by using an SFTP client.
options.B: Create an AWS Auto Scaling group for Amazon EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer. Upload website content by using an SFTP client.
options.C: Create a private Amazon S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to allow access from a CloudFront origin access identity (OAI). Upload website content by using the AWS CLI.
options.D: Create a public Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Transfer for SFTP. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload website content by using the SFTP client.

explanations.A: Create a virtual server by using Amazon Lightsail. Configure the web server in the Lightsail instance. Upload website content by using an SFTP client. 正确性分析：Lightsail可以用于托管网站，但它需要运行一个虚拟服务器并配置Web服务器，这增加了管理复杂性和成本。 错误原因：题目要求最具成本效益和弹性的架构，而Lightsail需要持续运行实例，成本较高且不如S3的静态托管简单。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Auto Scaling group for Amazon EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer. Upload website content by using an SFTP client. 正确性分析：EC2 Auto Scaling组和ALB可以提供高可用性，但这是为动态内容设计的架构。 错误原因：题目明确指出网站是静态内容，使用EC2和ALB会导致不必要的复杂性和高成本。
explanations.C: Create a private Amazon S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to allow access from a CloudFront origin access identity (OAI). Upload website content by using the AWS CLI. 正确性分析：S3是托管静态网站的最佳选择，结合CloudFront可以提供高性能和全球分发。使用OAI可以确保安全性。 正确原因：这是最具成本效益和弹性的解决方案，完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Create a public Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Transfer for SFTP. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload website content by using the SFTP client. 正确性分析：S3可以托管静态网站，但将存储橘设置为公共访问会带来安全风险。 错误原因：题目要求安全性，而公共存储橘不符合最佳实践。此外，AWS Transfer for SFTP增加了额外的成本。

question: A company wants to manage Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). The company currently copies AMIs to the same AWS Region where the AMIs were created. The company needs to design an application that captures AWS API calls and sends alerts whenever the Amazon EC2 Createlmage API operation is called within the company’s account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to query AWS CloudTrail logs and to send an alert when a Createlmage API call is detected.
options.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail with an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification that occurs when updated logs are sent to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create a new table and to query on Createlmage when an API call is detected.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for the Createlmage API call. Configure the target as an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an alert when a Createlmage API call is detected.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue as a target for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create an AWS Lambda function to send an alert to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when a Createlmage API call is detected. 4% Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO

explanations.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to query AWS CloudTrail logs and to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected. 错误：虽然可以通过 Lambda 查询 CloudTrail 日志来检测 API 调用，但这种方法需要定期运行 Lambda 函数以扫描日志，增加了操 作开销。 此外，这种方式不是实时的，可能会有延迟。
explanations.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail with an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification that occurs when updated logs are sent to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create a new table and to query on CreateImage when an API call is detected. 错误：此方法依赖于 CloudTrail 将日志存储到 S3，然后使用 Athena 查询日志。这种方式需要手动配置 Athena 表，并且查询过程 可能会有延迟。 操作开销较高，不符合“最低操作开销”的要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for the CreateImage API call. Configure the target as an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected. 正确：EventBridge 可以直接捕获 CreateImage API 调用事件，并将其发送到 SNS 主题以触发警报。 这种方法是实时的，目操作开销最低，因为不需要额外的日志查询或存储配置。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue as a target for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create an AWS Lambda function to send an alert to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when a CreateImage API call is detected. 错误：此方法需要配置 SQS 队列和 Lambda 函数，增加了操作复杂性。 此外，依赖 CloudTrail 日志，可能会有延迟，不如 EventBridge 的实时性强。

question: A company owns an asynchronous API that is used to ingest user requests and, based on the request type, dispatch requests to the appropriate microservice for processing. The company is using Amazon API Gateway to deploy the API front end, and an AWS Lambda function that invokes Amazon DynamoDB to store user requests before dispatching them to the processing microservices. The company provisioned as much DynamoDB throughput as its budget allows, but the company is still experiencing availability issues and is losing user requests. What should a solutions architect do to address this issue without impacting existing users?

options.A: Add throttling on the API Gateway with server-side throttling limits.
options.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB.
options.C: Create a secondary index in DynamoDB for the table with the user requests.
options.D: Use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB.

explanations.A: Add throttling on the API Gateway with server-side throttling limits. 分析：虽然API Gateway的节流限制可以减少请求数量，但这会直接影响用户体验，导致用户请求被拒绝或延迟处理。这并不能解 决DynamoDB的知吐量问题，因此此选项不适合。
explanations.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB. 分析：DAX主要用于加速读取操作，而不是写入操作。题目中提到的问题是写入知吐量不足，因此使用DAX无法解决问题，此选项 错误。
explanations.C: Create a secondary index in DynamoDB for the table with the user requests. 分析：二级索引用于优化查询性能，与写入知吐量无关。创建二级索引不会缓解写入压力，因此此选项错误。
explanations.D: Use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB. 分析：使用Amazon SQS作为缓冲队列可以有效地分散写入压力，将用户请求暂存到队列中，然后通过Lambda函数逐桯写入 DynamoDB。这种方式可以解决DynamoDB知吐量不足的问题，同时不会影响用户请求的接收，因此此选项正确。

question: A company needs to move data from an Amazon EC2 instance to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must ensure that no API calls and no data are routed through public internet routes. Only the EC2 instance can have access to upload data to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance's IAM role for access.
options.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the Availability Zone where the EC2 instance is located. Attach appropriate security groups to the endpoint. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance's IAM role for access.
options.C: Run the nslookup tool from inside the EC2 instance to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket's service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the $3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.D: Use the AWS provided, publicly available ip-ranges.json file to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket's service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the $3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.

explanations.A: Create an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： Interface VPC Endpoint允许通过私有网络访问Amazon S3，而无需通过公共互联网。 资源策略可以限制只有特定的IAM角色（EC2实例的IAM角色）能够访问S3存储橘。 此选项完全满足题目要求：避免公共互联网访问，并限制访问权限。 正确。
explanations.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the Availability Zone where the EC2 instance is located. Attach appropriate security groups to the endpoint. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： Gateway VPC Endpoint适用于Amazon S3和DynamoDB，但它是基于路由表的，而不是基于子网的接口端点。 题目要求“在子网中创建端点”，而不是在可用区中创建端点，因此此选项不完全符合题目要求。 此外，安全组不能直接附加到Gateway VPC Endpoint。 错误。
explanations.C: Run the nslookup tool from inside the EC2 instance to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： 使用nslookup工具获取S3的私有IP地址并孅动创建路由表条目是不可行的，因为S3的服务端点是动嬒的，目无法通过这种方式可靠 地实现访问。 此方法复杂目不符合AWS最佳实践。 错误。
explanations.D: Use the AWS provided, publicly available ip-ranges.json file to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access. 分析： ip-ranges.json文件提供的是AWS服务的公共IP地址范围，而不是私有IP地址。 此方法无法实现通过私有网络访问S3服务。 此选项不符合题目要求。 错误。

question: A solutions architect is designing the architecture of a new application being deployed to the AWS Cloud. The application will run on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances and will automatically scale across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances will scale up and down frequently throughout the day. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) will handle the load distribution. The architecture needs to support distributed session data management. The company is willing to make changes to code if needed. What should the solutions architect do to ensure that the architecture supports distributed session data management?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache to manage and store session data.
options.B: Use session affinity (sticky sessions) of the ALB to manage session data.
options.C: Use Session Manager from AWS Systems Manager to manage the session.
options.D: Use the GetSessionToken API operation in AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to manage the session.

explanations.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache to manage and store session data. 正确：Amazon ElastiCache是一种高性能、低延迟的分布式缓存服务，适合存储会话数据并支持分布式架构。 它支持频痏的EC2实例上下痟，并且可以通过Redis或Memcached实现会话数据的共享。
explanations.B: Use session affinity (sticky sessions) of the ALB to manage session data. 错误：Sticky Sessions会将用户请求痧定到特定的EC2实例，但这不是畑正的分布式会话管理解决方案。 当EC2实例频痏上下痟时，Sticky Sessions可能导致会话丢失或不一致。
explanations.C: Use Session Manager from AWS Systems Manager to manage the session. 错误：Session Manager是用于管理EC2实例的远程会话工具，与应用程序的会话数据管理无关。
explanations.D: Use the GetSessionToken API operation in AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to manage the session. 错误：GetSessionToken API用于生成临时安全认证，与应用程序的会话数据管理无关。

question: A company offers a food delivery service that is growing rapidly. Because of the growth, the company’s order processing system is experiencing scaling problems during peak traffic hours. The current architecture includes the following: * A group of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to collect orders from the application ¢ Another group of EC2 instances that run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to fulfill orders The order collection process occurs quickly, but the order fulfillment process can take longer. Data must not be lost because of a scaling event. A solutions architect must ensure that the order collection process and the order fulfillment process can both scale properly during peak traffic hours. The solution must optimize utilization of the company’s AWS resources. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the CPU of each instance in the Auto Scaling groups. Configure each Auto Scaling group’s minimum capacity according to peak workload values.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the CPU of each instance in the Auto Scaling groups. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that creates additional Auto Scaling groups on demand. IT
options.C: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues: one for order collection and another for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queue. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on notifications that the queues send.
options.D: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues: one for order collection and another for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queue. Create a metric based on a backlog per instance calculation. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on this metric.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控 Auto Scaling 组中每个实例的 CPU。根据高峰工作负载值配置每个 Auto Scaling 组的最 小容量。 错误：此选项仅通过设置最小容量来解决问题，无法动态处理订单疅压问题。 无法优化资源利用率，因为它没有考虑订单处理的动态需求。
explanations.B: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控 Auto Scaling 组中每个实例的 CPU。配置一个 CloudWatch 警报以调用一个 Amazon SNS 主题，该主题按需创建额外的 Auto Scaling 组。 错误：创建额外的 Auto Scaling 组并不是解决订单疅压问题的最佳方法。 此选项增加了复杂性，但没有直接解决订单处理的动态需求。
explanations.C: 配置两个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列：一个用于订单收集，另一个用于订单完成。配置 EC2 实例轮询 各自的队列。根据队列发送的通知扩展 Auto Scaling 组。 部分正确：使用SQS队列可以有效分畹订单收集和订单完成的流程。 错误：仅根据队列发送的通知扩展Auto Scaling组，可能无法痄确处理疅压问题。
explanations.D: 配置两个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列：一个用于订单收集，另一个用于订单完成。配置 EC2 实例轮询 各自的队列。基于每个实例的积压计算创建一个指标。根据此指标扩展 Auto Scaling 组。 正确：此选项通过SQS队列分畹订单收集和订单完成流程，并基于疅压计算动态扩展Auto Scaling组。 优化了资源利用率，同时确保订单不会因扩展问题丢失。

question: A company hosts multiple production applications. One of the applications consists of resources from Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Amazon RDS, Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS), and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) across multiple AWS Regions. All company resources are tagged with a tag name of “application” and a value that corresponds to each application. A solutions architect must provide the quickest solution for identifying all of the tagged components. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS CloudTrail to generate a list of resources with the application tag.
options.B: Use the AWS CLI to query each service across all Regions to report the tagged components.
options.C: Run a query in Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to report on the components with the application tag. ££ Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights
options.D: Run a query with the AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor to report on the resources globally with the application tag.

explanations.A: Use AWS CloudTrail to generate a list of resources with the application tag. 错误：AWS CloudTrail主要用于记录API调用和活动日志，而不是直接查询资源标疮。虽然可以通过分析CloudTrail日志间接找到资 源，但这不是最快的解决方案。
explanations.B: Use the AWS CLI to query each service across all Regions to report the tagged components. 错误：使用AWS CLI查询每个服务的资源标疮需要手动编写脚本，并且需要逐个区域查询，效率较低，不符合“最快解决方案”的要 求。
explanations.C: Run a query in Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to report on the components with the application tag. 错误：CloudWatch Logs Insights主要用于分析日志数据，而不是直接查询资源标疮。此选项与题目要求不符。
explanations.D: Run a query with the AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor to report on the resources globally with the application tag. 正确：AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor允许用户跨多个区域和服务查询资源标疮，是最快速目直接的解决方案。

question: A company needs to export its database once a day to Amazon S3 for other teams to access. The exported object size varies between 2 GB and 5 GB. The S3 access pattern for the data is variable and changes rapidly. The data must be immediately available and must remain accessible for up to 3 months. The company needs the most cost-effective solution that will not increase retrieval time. Which S3 storage class should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.B: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
options.C: $3 Standard S3 Standard
options.D: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-lA)

explanations.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering 正确。S3 Intelligent-Tiering是一个自动优化存储成本的存储类，它根据访问模式动态调整数据存储层级。对于访问模式变化频繁的 数据，它是最具成本效益的选择，同时提供低延迟和高知吐量，满足“数据必须立即可用”的要求。
explanations.B: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 错误。虽然S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval提供低桌索延迟，但它主要用于归桂数据，目成本效益不如S3 Intelligent-Tiering。题目要求 数据访问模式变化频繁，S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval不适合这种场景。
explanations.C: S3 Standard 错误。S3 Standard提供高性能和低延迟，但成本较高。对于访问模式变化频繁的数据，S3 Intelligent-Tiering更具成本效益。
explanations.D: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 错误。S3 Standard-IA适用于访问频率较低的数据，但题目中提到数据访问模式变化频繁，因此S3 Standard-IA不适合这种场景。

question: A company is developing a new mobile app. The company must implement proper traffic filtering to protect its Application Load Balancer (ALB) against common application-level attacks, such as cross-site scripting or SQL injection. The company has minimal infrastructure and operational staff. The company needs to reduce its share of the responsibility in managing, updating, and securing servers for its AWS environment. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS WAF rules and associate them with the ALB.
options.B: Deploy the application using Amazon S3 with public hosting enabled.
options.C: Deploy AWS Shield Advanced and add the ALB as a protected resource. BBE AWS Shield Advanced
options.D: Create a new ALB that directs traffic to an Amazon EC2 instance running a third-party firewall, which then passes the traffic to the current ALB.

explanations.A: Configure AWS WAF rules and associate them with the ALB. 正确：AWS WAF是一种托管的Web应用程序防火墙，可以保护应用程序免受常见的应用层攻击（如跨站脚本和SQL注入）。 正确：将AWS WAF规则与ALB关联可以直接过滤恶意流量，减少对应用程序的威胁。 正确：AWS WAF是托管服务，减少了公司在管理和更新安全规则方面的责任。
explanations.B: Deploy the application using Amazon S3 with public hosting enabled. 错误：Amazon S3适用于静态网站托管，但无法提供针对应用层攻击的防护。 错误：启用公共托管可能会增加安全风险，而不是减少它。
explanations.C: Deploy AWS Shield Advanced and add the ALB as a protected resource. 错误：AWS Shield Advanced主要用于防护DDoS攻击，而不是应用层攻击（如跨站脚本和SQL注入）。 错误：虽然可以保护ALB，但无法直接解决题目中提到的应用层攻击问题。
explanations.D: Create a new ALB that directs traffic to an Amazon EC2 instance running a third-party firewall, which then passes the traffic to the current ALB. 错误：这种方法增加了架构复杂性，并且需要额外的管理和维护工作。 错误：题目要求减少管理负担，而运行第三方防火墙需要额外的操作和维护。

question: A company’s reporting system delivers hundreds of .csv files to an Amazon S3 bucket each day. The company must convert these files to Apache Parquet format and must store the files in a transformed data bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Create an Amazon EMR cluster with Apache Spark installed. Write a Spark application to transform the data. Use EMR File System (EMRFS) to write files to the transformed data bucket.
options.B: Create an AWS Glue crawler to discover the data. Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to transform the data. Specify the transformed data bucket in the output step.
options.C: Use AWS Batch to create a job definition with Bash syntax to transform the data and output the data to the transformed data bucket. Use the job definition to submit a job. Specify an array job as the job type.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data and output the data to the transformed data bucket. Configure an event notification for the S3 bucket. Specify the Lambda function as the destination for the event notification.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon EMR cluster with Apache Spark installed... 分析：虽然Amazon EMR和Apache Spark可以高效处理大规模数据转换，但需要编写Spark应用程序并管理EMR集群。这增加了开发 和运维工作量，不符合“最少开发工作量”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: Create an AWS Glue crawler to discover the data... 分析：AWS Glue是一个托管的ETL服务，提供内置的功能来发现数据并转换格式。使用Glue爬网器和ETL作业可以自动化数据转换社 程，减少开发工作量。符合题目要求。 结论：正确。
explanations.C: Use AWS Batch to create a job definition... 分析：AWS Batch适合运行批处理作业，但需要编写Bash脚本并配置作业定义。这增加了开发工作量，不符合“最少开发工作量”的 要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data... 分析：AWS Lambda可以处理事件驱动的任务，但需要编写代码来处理数据转换。对于每天处理数百个文件，Lambda可能会受到执 行时间和资源限制的影响。此外，开发工作量较高。 结论：错误。

question: A company has 700 TB of backup data stored in network attached storage (NAS) in its data center. This backup data need to be accessible for infrequent regulatory requests and must be retained 7 years. The company has decided to migrate this backup data from its data center to AWS. The migration must be complete within 1 month. The company has 500 Mbps of dedicated bandwidth on its public internet connection available for data transfer. What should a solutions architect do to migrate and store the data at the LOWEST cost?

options.A: Order AWS Snowball devices to transfer the data. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.B: Deploy a VPN connection between the data center and Amazon VPC. Use the AWS CLI to copy the data from on premises to Amazon S3 Glacier.
options.C: Provision a 500 Mbps AWS Direct Connect connection and transfer the data to Amazon S3. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data and deploy a DataSync agent on premises. Use the DataSync task to copy files from the on-premises NAS storage to Amazon S3 Glacier.

explanations.A: Order AWS Snowball devices to transfer the data. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 正确：AWS Snowball是一种高效的物理设备，用于大规模数据迁移，尤其适合在有限的网痬带宽下快速迁移数据。使用生命周期策 略将数据转移到Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive可以显著降低存储成本。 符合要求：迁移700 TB数据在1个月内完成，目成本最低。
explanations.B: Deploy a VPN connection between the data center and Amazon VPC. Use the AWS CLI to copy the data from on premises to Amazon S3 Glacier. 错误：使用VPN连接和AWS CLI传输700 TB数据在500 Mbps的带宽下需要很长时间，无法满足1个月的迁移时间要求。 成本较高：VPN连接的性能和稳定性可能不足以支持大规模数据迁移。
explanations.C: Provision a 500 Mbps AWS Direct Connect connection and transfer the data to Amazon S3. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. 错误：虽然AWS Direct Connect提供了更高的性能，但设置Direct Connect需要时间，无法满足1个月的迁移时间要求。 成本较高：Direct Connect的初始设置成本和持痲使用成本较高，不是最低成本的解决方案。
explanations.D: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data and deploy a DataSync agent on premises. Use the DataSync task to copy files from the on-premises NAS storage to Amazon S3 Glacier. 错误：AWS DataSync依赖网痬带宽进行数据传输，在500 Mbps的带宽下，迁移700 TB数据需要很长时间，无法满足1个月的迁移时 间要求。 成本较高：DataSync的传输成本可能高于使用AWS Snowball设备。

question: A company has a serverless website with millions of objects in an Amazon $3 bucket. The company uses the S3 bucket as the origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company did not set encryption on the S3 bucket before the objects were loaded. A solutions architect needs to enable encryption for all existing objects and for all objects that are added to the S3 bucket in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket. Turn on the default encryption settings for the new S3 bucket. Download all existing objects to temporary local storage. Upload the objects to the new S3 bucket.
options.B: Turn on the default encryption settings for the S3 bucket. Use the S3 Inventory feature to create a .csv file that lists the unencrypted objects. Run an $3 Batch Operations job that uses the copy command to encrypt those objects.
options.C: Create a new encryption key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Change the settings on the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS). Turn on versioning for the S3 bucket.
options.D: Navigate to Amazon S3 in the AWS Management Console. Browse the S3 bucket's objects. Sort by the encryption field. Select each unencrypted object. Use the Modify button to apply default encryption settings to every unencrypted object in the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 创建一个新的 S3 存储橘并重新上传对象： 错误。虽然这种方法可以实现加密，但需要下载所有对象到本地并重新上传，操作复杂目耗时，不符合“最少努力”的要求。
explanations.B: 启用默正加密设置并使用 S3 Inventory 和 S3 Batch Operations： 正确。这种方法利用了S3的内置功能（Inventory和Batch Operations），可以高效地对现有对象进行加密，同时启用默正加密设置 确保未来上传的对象也被加密。这是最少努力的解决方案。
explanations.C: 使用AWS KMS创建加密密钥并启用版本控制： 错误。虽然可以通过SSE-KMS实现加密，但这并不会自动加密现有对象，目启用版本控制并不是解决问题的必要步骤。
explanations.D: 手动选择未加密对象并应用加密设置： 错误。这种方法需要逐个选择对象并手动操作，效率极低，不符合“最少努力”的要求。

question: A company runs a global web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application stores data in Amazon Aurora. The company needs to create a disaster recovery solution and can tolerate up to 30 minutes of downtime and potential data loss. The solution does not need to handle the load when the primary infrastructure is healthy. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application with the required infrastructure elements in place. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora Replica in a second AWS Region.
options.B: Host a scaled-down deployment of the application in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active- active failover. Create an Aurora Replica in the second Region.
options.C: Replicate the primary infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-active failover. Create an Aurora database that is restored from the latest snapshot.
options.D: Back up data with AWS Backup. Use the backup to create the required infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora second primary instance in the second Region.

explanations.A: Deploy the application with the required infrastructure elements in place. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active- passive failover. Create an Aurora Replica in a second AWS Region. 正确：此选项符合题目要求，使用主动-被动架构，Aurora Replica可以在灾难发生时快速切换到备用区域，满足30分钟的恢复时间 目标。 Route 53的主动-被动故障转移配置可以确保在主区域不可用时切换到备用区域。
explanations.B: Host a scaled-down deployment of the application in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active- active failover. Create an Aurora Replica in the second Region. 错误：主动-主动架构不符合题目中“解决方案不需要在主基略设施正常时处理负载”的要求。 主动-主动架构会增加成本，因为备用区域需要持痲运行。
explanations.C: Replicate the primary infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-active failover. Create an Aurora database that is restored from the latest snapshot. 错误：使用快照恢复Aurora数据库可能无法满足30分钟的恢复时间目标，因为恢复过程可能需要更长时间。 主动-主动架构不符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Back up data with AWS Backup. Use the backup to create the required infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora second primary instance in the second Region. 错误：使用AWS Backup恢复数据可能无法满足30分钟的恢复时间目标，因为备份恢复过程可能较慢。 创建Aurora疦二主实例不符合题目中“潜在数据丢失”的容忍要求。

question: A company has a web server running on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Elastic IP address. The default security group is assigned to the EC2 instance. The default network ACL has been modified to block all traffic. A solutions architect needs to make the web server accessible from everywhere on port 443. Which combination of steps will accomplish this task? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0.
options.B: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.C: Update the network ACL to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0.
options.D: Update the network ACL to allow inbound/outbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.E: Update the network ACL to allow inbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and outbound TCP port 32768-65535 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.

explanations.A: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0. 正确。安全组是状嬒性的，允许入站规则会自动允许相关的出站流量。创建一个安全组并允许从0.0.0.0/0访问TCP端口443是使Web 服务器对外开放的必要步骤。
explanations.B: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 to destination 0.0.0.0/0. 错误。安全组的规则是基于入站流量的源地址，而不是目标地址。此选项描述的规则不符合安全组的工作方式。
explanations.C: Update the network ACL to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0. 错误。网络ACL是无状嬒的，仅允许入站流量是不够的，还需要配置出站流量规则。
explanations.D: Update the network ACL to allow inbound/outbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and to destination 0.0.0.0/0. 错误。虽然此选项看起来正确，但它没有考虑出站流量的动嬒端口范围（32768-65535），因此不完全满足要求。
explanations.E: Update the network ACL to allow inbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and outbound TCP port 32768-65535 to destination 0.0.0.0/0. 正确。网络ACL是无状嬒的，因此需要同时配置入站和出站规则。入站规则允许TCP端口443，出站规则允许动嬒端口范围（32768- 65535），这是使Web服务器对外开放的必要步骤。

question: A company's application is having performance issues. The application is stateful and needs to complete in-memory tasks on Amazon EC2 instances. The company used AWS CloudFormation to deploy infrastructure and used the M5 EC2 instance family. As traffic increased, the application performance degraded. Users are reporting delays when the users attempt to access the application. Which solution will resolve these issues in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Replace the EC2 instances with T3 EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. Make the changes by using the AWS Management Console.
options.B: Modify the CloudFormation templates to run the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. Increase the desired capacity and the maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group manually when an increase is necessary.
options.C: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch built-in EC2 memory metrics to track the application performance for future capacity planning.
options.D: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to generate custom application latency metrics for future capacity planning.

explanations.A: Replace the EC2 instances with T3 EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. Make the changes by using the AWS Management Console. 错误原因： T3实例是突发性能实例，适合间歇性负载，但不适合需要持痲高性能的状态性应用。使用AWS Management Console手 动更改基略设施不符合“最具操作效率”的要求。
explanations.B: Modify the CloudFormation templates to run the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. Increase the desired capacity and the maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group manually when an increase is necessary. 错误原因： 虽然Auto Scaling可以动态调整容量，但手动增加容量不符合“最具操作效率”的要求。此外，题目提到应用是状态性 的，Auto Scaling可能无法解决状态性应用的性能问题。
explanations.C: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch built- in EC2 memory metrics to track the application performance for future capacity planning. 错误原因： R5实例是内存优化型实例，适合状态性应用，但仅使用内置的EC2内存指标无法全面畁控应用性能（如延迟）。痾乏对 应用延迟的畁控可能导致容量规划不足。
explanations.D: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to generate custom application latency metrics for future capacity planning. 正确原因： R5实例是内存优化型实例，适合状态性应用。部署Amazon CloudWatch代理可以生成自定义应用延迟指标，帮助进行 全面的性能畁控和容量规划。这种方法符合“最具操作效率”的要求。

question: A solutions architect is designing a new API using Amazon API Gateway that will receive requests from users. The volume of requests is highly variable; several hours can pass without receiving a single request. The data processing will take place asynchronously, but should be completed within a few seconds after a request is made. Which compute service should the solutions architect have the API invoke to deliver the requirements at the lowest cost?

options.A: An AWS Glue job —~ AWS Glue
options.B: An AWS Lambda function — AWS Lambda
options.C: A containerized service hosted in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.D: A containerized service hosted in Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2

explanations.A: An AWS Glue job 错误：AWS Glue 是一种用于数据处理和 ETL（提取、转换、加载）的服务，主要用于处理大规模数据集，而不是设计用于处理 API 的异步请求。 此外，Glue 的启动时间较长，无法满足“几秒内完成处理”的要求。
explanations.B: An AWS Lambda function 正确：AWS Lambda 是一种无服务器计算服务，能够快速响应 API Gateway 的请求。 Lambda 的按需计费模式非常适合处理“请求量高度可变”的场景，因为它只在有请求时运行，避免了票置资源的成本。 Lambda 的执行时间可以在几秒内完成，完全满足题目要求。
explanations.C: A containerized service hosted in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 错误：Amazon EKS 是一种容器编排服务，适合运行长期的容器化应用程序。 虽然可以处理 API 请求，但需要持痲运行集群，成本较高，不适合“请求量高度可变”的场景。
explanations.D: A containerized service hosted in Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2 错误：Amazon ECS 使用 EC2 实例运行容器化服务，适合长期运行的应用程序。 与 EKS 类似，ECS 的成本较高，因为 EC2 实例需要持痲运行，即使没有请求也会产生费用。

question: A company runs an application on a group of Amazon Linux EC2 instances. For compliance reasons, the company must retain all application log files for 7 years. The log files will be analyzed by a reporting tool that must be able to access all the files concurrently. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store
options.D: Amazon $3 Amazon S3

explanations.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Amazon EBS是块存储服务，适用于单个EC2实例的高性能存储需求。 不适合长期存储，因为EBS卷需要与EC2实例痧定，目成本较高。 不支持多实例并发访问。 错误原因：不符合长期存储和并发访问的要求。
explanations.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Amazon EFS是文件存储服务，支持多实例并发访问。 适合存储需要低延迟访问的文件，但成本较高，尤其是存储大量数据时。 对于长期存储，Amazon S3更具成本效益。 错误原因：成本不够经济。
explanations.C: Amazon EC2 instance store EC2实例存储是临时存储，数据会在实例停止或终止时丢失。 不适合长期存储需求。 错误原因：无法满足7年存储要求。
explanations.D: Amazon S3 Amazon S3是对象存储服务，支持高持久性和低成本存储。 适合长期存储和并发访问场景。 支持生命周期管理，可以将数据迁移到更低成本的存储类别（如S3 Glacier）。 正确原因：最符合题目要求，目成本效益最高。

question: A company has hired an external vendor to perform work in the company's AWS account. The vendor uses an automated tool that is hosted in an AWS account that the vendor owns. The vendor does not have IAM access to the company’s AWS account. How should a solutions architect grant this access to the vendor?

options.A: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendors IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.B: Create an IAM user in the company's account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.C: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the tool's IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.D: Create a new identity provider by choosing “AWS account” as the provider type in the IAM console. Supply the vendor's AWS account ID and user name. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the new provider for the permissions that the vendor requires.

explanations.A: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendor’s IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires. 正确：这是AWS推荐的最佳实践。通过创建IAM角色并允许外部账户的IAM角色进行假设（assume role），可以安全地实现跨账户 访问。 这种方法避免了直接创建用户或共享密码，符合安全性和权限最小化原则。
explanations.B: Create an IAM user in the company’s account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires. 错误：创建IAM用户并共享密码不符合安全最佳实践。密码可能会被泄需或小用，目无法实现自动化工具的跨账户访问。 此方法不适合供应商的自动化工具使用场景。
explanations.C: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the tool’s IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires. 错误：IAM组仅适用于同一账户内的用户管理，无法跨账户使用。 供应商的IAM用户无法直接加入公司账户的IAM组。
explanations.D: Create a new identity provider by choosing “AWS account” as the provider type in the IAM console. Supply the vendor’s AWS account ID and user name. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the new provider for the permissions that the vendor requires. 错误：AWS身份提供者主要用于联合身份正确（Federation），例如与SAML或OpenID Connect集成，而不是用于跨账户访问。 此选项与题目场景不匹配。

question: A company has deployed a Java Spring Boot application as a pod that runs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) in private subnets. The application needs to write data to an Amazon DynamoDB table. A solutions architect must ensure that the application can interact with the DynamoDB table without exposing traffic to the internet. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)

options.A: Attach an IAM role that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod.
options.B: Attach an IAM user that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod.
options.C: Allow outbound connectivity to the DynamoDB table through the private subnets’ network ACLs.
options.D: Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.
options.E: Embed the access keys in the Java Spring Boot code. HDA AR A Fl Java Spring Boot

explanations.A: Attach an IAM role that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod. 正确。通过IAM角色，EKS pod可以安全地访问AWS资源（如DynamoDB），这是AWS的最佳实践。 IAM角色可以通过服务账户绑定到EKS pod，避免使用硬编码的访问密钥。
explanations.B: Attach an IAM user that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod. 错误。IAM用户不适合直接绑定到EKS pod，AWS推荐使用IAM角色而不是IAM用户来管理权限。 IAM用户的访问密钥需要硬编码或孅动管理，这不符合安全性最佳实践。
explanations.C: Allow outbound connectivity to the DynamoDB table through the private subnets’ network ACLs. 错误。DynamoDB是一个托管服务，默正嬦况下通过公共网络访问。即使配置网络ACL，仍然需要通过VPC Endpoint来实现私有连 接。 此选项未解决如何避免流量暴需到互联网的问题。
explanations.D: Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB. 正确。通过VPC Endpoint，EKS pod可以通过私有网络与DynamoDB通人，而无需流量暴需到互联网。 这是AWS推荐的安全性最佳实践。
explanations.E: Embed the access keys in the Java Spring Boot code. 错误。将访问密钥宥入代码是严重的安全风险，不符合AWS的最佳实践。 如果密钥泄需，可能导致未经授权的访问。

question: A company recently migrated its web application to AWS by rehosting the application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The company wants to redesign its application architecture to be highly available and fault tolerant. Traffic must reach all running EC2 instances randomly. Which combination of steps should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy.
options.B: Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy.
options.C: Create an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy.
options.D: Launch three EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and one instance in another Availability Zone.
options.E: Launch four EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and two instances in another Availability Zone.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. 故障转移路由策略主要用于在主资源不可用时将流量转移到备用资源。 此题要求流量随机分配到所有运行的 EC2 实例，而不是故障转移，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy. 加权路由策略允许根据权重将流量分配到不同的资源。 虽然可以实现流量分配，但题目要求随机分配流量，而加权路由需要明确设置权重，因此此选项不完全符合要求。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy. 多值答案路由策略允许返回多个 IP 地址，并支持健康桌查以确保流量只发送到健康的资源。 此策略可以实现随机分配流量到所有运行的 EC2 实例，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Launch three EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and one instance in another Availability Zone. 此选项在可用区之间的分布不均匀，可能导致单点故障问题。 为了实现高可用性，应该在多个可用区之间均匀分布实例，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.E: Launch four EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and two instances in another Availability Zone. 此选项在两个可用区之间均匀分布实例，符合高可用性和容错的最佳实践。 此选项符合题目要求。

question: A media company collects and analyzes user activity data on premises. The company wants to migrate this capability to AWS. The user activity data store will continue to grow and will be petabytes in size. The company needs to build a highly available data ingestion solution that facilitates on-demand analytics of existing data and new data with SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.C: Place activity data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon S3 to run an AWS Lambda function on the data as the data arrives in the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an ingestion service on Amazon EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Configure the service to forward data to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ database.

explanations.A: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. 正确性分析：Kinesis数据流可以用于实时数据流处理，S3可以存储数据，但此方案缺乏直接的SQL分析能力。需要额外的服务（如 Athena或Redshift）来实现SQL查询。 结论：此选项不符合“最低运维开销”和“直接SQL分析”的要求。
explanations.B: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster. 正确性分析：Kinesis Data Firehose是一个完全托管的服务，可以将数据直接传送到Redshift。Redshift支持SQL查询，并且Firehose 自动管理数据传输，减少运维开销。 结论：此选项符合题目要求，是最佳选择。
explanations.C: Place activity data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon S3 to run an AWS Lambda function on the data as the data arrives in the S3 bucket. 正确性分析：S3可以存储数据，Lambda可以处理数据，但此方案需要额外的服务（如Athena或Redshift）来实现SQL查询。 Lambda的运维复杂性较高。 结论：此选项不符合“最低运维开销”和“直接SQL分析”的要求。
explanations.D: Create an ingestion service on Amazon EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Configure the service to forward data to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ database. 正确性分析：EC2实例需要手动管理，增加运维开销。RDS支持SQL查询，但不适合处理大规模数据（如Petabyte级别）。 结论：此选项不符合“最低运维开销”和“高可用性”的要求。

question: A company collects data from thousands of remote devices by using a RESTful web services application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance receives the raw data, transforms the raw data, and stores all the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The number of remote devices will increase into the millions soon. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Glue to process the raw data in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to different EC2 instances.
options.C: Add more EC2 instances to accommodate the increasing amount of incoming data.
options.D: Send the raw data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Use EC2 instances to process the data.
options.E: Use Amazon API Gateway to send the raw data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to use the data stream as a source to deliver the data to Amazon S3.

explanations.A: Use AWS Glue to process the raw data in Amazon S3. 正确：AWS Glue 是一个完全托管的 ETL 服务，可以高效地处理和转换存储在 Amazon S3 中的数据。 符合题目要求的“高可扩展性”和“减少运维开销”。
explanations.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to different EC2 instances. 错误：Amazon Route 53 是一个 DNS 服务，主要用于域名解析和流量路由，不适合处理数据流或扩展数据处理能力。 不符合题目要求的“高可扩展性”和“减少运维开销”。
explanations.C: Add more EC2 instances to accommodate the increasing amount of incoming data. 错误：增加 EC2 实例虽然可以扩展处理能力，但会增加运维开销，不符合题目要求的“减少运维开销”。 手动管理 EC2 实例的扩展性较低，目成本较高。
explanations.D: Send the raw data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Use EC2 instances to process the data. 错误：虽然 Amazon SQS 可以缓冲数据流，但使用 EC2 实例处理数据仍然需要手动管理，增加了运维开销。 不符合题目要求的“减少运维开销”。
explanations.E: Use Amazon API Gateway to send the raw data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to use the data stream as a source to deliver the data to Amazon S3. 正确：Amazon API Gateway 是一个托管服务，可以高效地接收数据请求并将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis 数据流。 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 是一个完全托管的服务，可以将数据流直接传送到 Amazon S3，符合题目要求的“高可扩展性”和“减 少运维开销”。

question: A company needs to retain its AWS CloudTrail logs for 3 years. The company is enforcing CloudTrail across a set of AWS accounts by using AWS Organizations from the parent account. The CloudTrail target S3 bucket is configured with S3 Versioning enabled. An S3 Lifecycle policy is in place to delete current objects after 3 years. After the fourth year of use of the S3 bucket, the S3 bucket metrics show that the number of objects has continued to rise. However, the number of new CloudTrail logs that are delivered to the S3 bucket has remained consistent. Which solution will delete objects that are older than 3 years in the MOST cost-effective manner?

options.A: Configure the organization's centralized CloudTrail trail to expire objects after 3 years.
options.B: Configure the S3 Lifecycle policy to delete previous versions as well as current versions.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to enumerate and delete objects from Amazon S3 that are older than 3 years.
options.D: Configure the parent account as the owner of all objects that are delivered to the S3 bucket.

explanations.A: 配置组织的集中式 CloudTrail 路径以在 3 年后过期对象。 错误。CloudTrail本身没有直接的功能来管理S3对象的生命周期。对象的过期和删除需要通过S3生命周期策略来实现，而不是通过 CloudTrail配置。
explanations.B: 配置 S3 生命周期策略以删除以前的版本以及当前版本。 正确。S3生命周期策略可以配置为删除当前版本和以前的版本。由于S3版本控制已启用，旧版本的对象不会被当前的生命周期策略 删除，因此需要明确配置删除旧版本。
explanations.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来枚举并删除超过 3 年的 Amazon S3 对象。 错误。虽然Lambda函数可以实现对象删除，但这种方法需要额外的开发和运行成本，不是最成本有效的解决方案。
explanations.D: 将父账户配置为传递到 S3 存储橘的所有对象的所有者。 错误。对象所有权与对象的生命周期管理无关。更改对象所有权不会解决旧版本对象未被删除的问题。

question: A company has an API that receives real-time data from a fleet of monitoring devices. The API stores this data in an Amazon RDS DB instance for later analysis. The amount of data that the monitoring devices send to the API fluctuates. During periods of heavy traffic, the APl often returns timeout errors. After an inspection of the logs, the company determines that the database is not capable of processing the volume of write traffic that comes from the API. A solutions architect must minimize the number of connections to the database and must ensure that data is not lost during periods of heavy traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the size of the DB instance to an instance type that has more available memory.
options.B: Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ DB instance. Configure the application to write to all active RDS DB instances.
options.C: Modify the API to write incoming data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use an AWS Lambda function that Amazon SQS invokes to write data from the queue to the database.
options.D: Modify the API to write incoming data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use an AWS Lambda function that Amazon SNS invokes to write data from the topic to the database.

explanations.A: 增加 DB 实例的大小 正确性分析：增加实例大小可以提升数据库性能，但无法解决高峰期的写入压力问题，也无法减少数据库连接数。 结论：错误。此选项无法满足“减少数据库连接数”和“确保数据不丢失”的要求。
explanations.B: 修改为 Multi-AZ DB 实例 正确性分析：Multi-AZ主要用于高可用性和灾难恢复，不能直接提升写入性能。此外，应用程序无法同时写入多个活动实例。 结论：错误。此选项无法解决写入压力问题，也无法减少数据库连接数。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon SQS 和 AWS Lambda 正确性分析：Amazon SQS可以缓冲写入请求，减少数据库连接数。AWS Lambda可以异步处理队列中的数据，确保数据不丢失并 平滑写入数据库。 结论：正确。此选项满足所有要求：减少数据库连接数、确保数据不丢失、处理高峰期写入压力。
explanations.D: 使用 Amazon SNS 和 AWS Lambda 正确性分析：Amazon SNS主要用于消息分发，而非缓冲。它无法减少数据库连接数，也无法有效处理高峰期的写入压力。 结论：错误。此选项不适合解决问题。

question: A company manages its own Amazon EC2 instances that run MySQL databases. The company is manually managing replication and scaling as demand increases or decreases. The company needs a new solution that simplifies the process of adding or removing compute capacity to or from its database tier as needed. The solution also must offer improved performance, scaling, and durability with minimal effort from operations. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora MySQL.
options.B: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora PostgreSQL.
options.C: Combine the databases into one larger MySQL database. Run the larger database on larger EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group for the database tier. Migrate the existing databases to the new environment.

explanations.A: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora MySQL. 正确：Amazon Aurora Serverless支持自动扩展，能够根据需求动态调整计算容量，简化了数据库管理。 Aurora MySQL与现有的MySQL数据库兼容，迁移成本较低。 满足题目要求的性能提升、扩展性和耐久性。
explanations.B: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora PostgreSQL. 错误：虽然Aurora PostgreSQL也支持自动扩展，但题目中现有数据库是MySQL，迁移到PostgreSQL会增加复杂性。 与题目要求的“简化过程”不符。
explanations.C: Combine the databases into one larger MySQL database. Run the larger database on larger EC2 instances. 错误：合并数据库和使用更大的EC2实例无法解决动态扩展的问题。 需要手动管理扩展，增加了运维复杂性，与题目要求的“最小化操作”不符。
explanations.D: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group for the database tier. Migrate the existing databases to the new environment. 错误：EC2 Auto Scaling组适用于应用层，而不是数据库层。 数据库的扩展和复制仍需手动管理，与题目要求的“简化过程”不符。

question: A company is concerned that two NAT instances in use will no longer be able to support the traffic needed for the company’s application. A solutions architect wants to implement a solution that is highly available, fault tolerant, and automatically scalable. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in the same Availability Zone.
options.B: Use Auto Scaling groups with Network Load Balancers for the NAT instances in different Availability Zones.
options.C: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in different Availability Zones.
options.D: Replace the two NAT instances with Spot Instances in different Availability Zones and deploy a Network Load Balancer.

explanations.A: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in the same Availability Zone. 错误：虽然NAT网关比NAT实例更高效，但将两个NAT网关部署在同一个可用区会导致单点故障问题。如果该可用区发生故障，所 有流量都会中断，无法满足高可用性要求。
explanations.B: Use Auto Scaling groups with Network Load Balancers for the NAT instances in different Availability Zones. 错误：NAT实例可以与Auto Scaling组结合使用，但这种方法复杂目需要额外的配置。相比之下，NAT网关是托管服务，提供更简单 的高可用性和扩展性解决方案。
explanations.C: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in different Availability Zones. 正确：NAT网关是托管服务，支持高可用性和自动扩展。将两个NAT网关部署在不同的可用区可以确保容错能力，即使一个可用区 发生故障，流量仍然可以通过另一个可用区的NAT网关进行处理。
explanations.D: Replace the two NAT instances with Spot Instances in different Availability Zones and deploy a Network Load Balancer. 错误：Spot实例价格低廉，但不适合关键任务服务，因为它们可能随时被中断。使用Spot实例作为NAT实例会导致不稳定性，无法 满足高可用性和容错要求。

question: An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance that has an Elastic IP address in VPC A. The application requires access to a database in VPC B. Both VPCs are in the same AWS account. Which solution will provide the required access MOST securely?

options.A: Create a DB instance security group that allows all traffic from the public IP address of the application server in VPC A.
options.B: Configure a VPC peering connection between VPC A and VPC B.
options.C: Make the DB instance publicly accessible. Assign a public IP address to the DB instance.
options.D: Launch an EC2 instance with an Elastic IP address into VPC B. Proxy all requests through the new EC2 instance.

explanations.A: 创建一个允许来自 VPC A 中应用服务器的公共 IP 地址的所有流量的 DB 实例安全组。 错误原因： 使用公共IP地址进行通人会暴需资源，降低安全性。 安全组规则允许所有流量，可能导致不必要的安全风险。
explanations.B: 配置 VPC A 和 VPC B 之间的 VPC 对等连接。 正确原因： VPC Peering允许两个VPC之间的私有通人，无需通过公共互联网。 这种方式最安全，因为流量保持在AWS网络内部。 可以通过安全组进一步限制访问权限。
explanations.C: 使 DB 实例可公开访问。为 DB 实例分配一个公共 IP 地址。 错误原因： 将数据库公开访问会暴需在互联网中，存在安全风险。 不符合“最安全”的要求。
explanations.D: 在 VPC B 中启动一个具有弹性 IP 地址的 EC2 实例。通过新的 EC2 实例代理所有请求。 错误原因： 虽然可以通过代理实现访问，但增加了额外的复杂性和成本。 使用弹性IP地址仍然涉及公共互联网通人，降低了安全性。

question: A company runs demonstration environments for its customers on Amazon EC2 instances. Each environment is isolated in its own VPC. The company’s operations team needs to be notified when RDP or SSH access to an environment has been established.

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights to create AWS Systems Manager Opsltems when RDP or SSH access is detected.
options.B: Configure the EC2 instances with an IAM instance profile that has an IAM role with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy attached.
options.C: Publish VPC flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create required metric filters. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm with a notification action for when the alarm is in the ALARM state.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to listen for events of type EC2 Instance State-change Notification. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as a target. Subscribe the operations team to the topic.

explanations.A: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights to create AWS Systems Manager OpsItems when RDP or SSH access is detected. 错误：Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights主要用于监控应用程序性能和异常，而不是直接用于检测网络访问行为（如RDP或 SSH）。 此外，OpsItems是用于问题管理的，不适合直接通知团队。
explanations.B: Configure the EC2 instances with an IAM instance profile that has an IAM role with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy attached. 错误：AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore策略用于启用EC2实例与AWS Systems Manager的集成，但它与检测RDP或SSH访问无 关。 此选项未提及如何监控或通知团队，因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Publish VPC flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create required metric filters. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm with a notification action for when the alarm is in the ALARM state. 正确：VPC Flow Logs可以捕获网络流量数据，包括RDP和SSH访问。将这些日志发布到CloudWatch Logs后，可以创建特定的 Metric Filters来检测RDP或SSH访问行为。 通过CloudWatch Metric Alarm，可以在检测到特定行为时触发通知操作（如发送SNS通知）。 此选项完全符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to listen for events of type EC2 Instance State-change Notification. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as a target. Subscribe the operations team to the topic. 错误：EC2 Instance State-change Notification事件仅用于监控实例状态变化（如启动、停止、终止），而不是检测网络访问行为 （如RDP或SSH）。 此选项与题目要求不符。

question: A solutions architect has created a new AWS account and must secure AWS account root user access. Which combination of actions will accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: Ensure the root user uses a strong password.
options.B: Enable multi-factor authentication to the root user.
options.C: Store root user access keys in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. RAR API a Rae DN EA Amazon S3
options.D: Add the root user to a group containing administrative permissions.
options.E: Apply the required permissions to the root user with an inline policy document.

explanations.A: Ensure the root user uses a strong password. 正确。使用强密码是保护账户安全的基本措施之一。 强密码可以防桬暴力破解攻击。
explanations.B: Enable multi-factor authentication to the root user. 正确。启用多重身份验证（MFA）是AWS推荐的最佳实践之一。 MFA增加了额外的安全层，即使密码梚需，攻击者也无法答易访问账户。
explanations.C: Store root user access keys in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. 错误。AWS强棲建议不要使用根用户访问密钥。 根用户访问密钥不应被创建或存储，应该使用IAM用户或角色来代蔡。
explanations.D: Add the root user to a group containing administrative permissions. 错误。根用户本身已经拥有所有权限，无法被添加到IAM组中。 IAM组仅适用于IAM用户，而非根用户。
explanations.E: Apply the required permissions to the root user with an inline policy document. 错误。根用户已经拥有所有权限，无需额外的权限配置。 使用IAM用户和角色来管理权限是更好的实践。

question: A company is building a new web-based customer relationship management application. The application will use several Amazon EC2 instances that are backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application will also use an Amazon Aurora database. All data for the application must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) certificates on the ALB to encrypt data in transit. Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest.
options.B: Use the AWS root account to log in to the AWS Management Console. Upload the company’s encryption certificates. While in the root account, select the option to turn on encryption for all data at rest and in transit for the account.
options.C: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest. Attach an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.
options.D: Use BitLocker to encrypt all data at rest. Import the company’s TLS certificate keys to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Attach the KMS keys to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 证书在 ALB 上加密传输中的数据。使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 加密静态存储的 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储。 错误：AWS KMS 不用于传输中的数据加密，ALB 的传输加密需要使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 提供的证书。 错误：ACM 不用于静态存储加密，EBS 和 Aurora 的静态存储加密需要使用 AWS KMS。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS 根账户登录到 AWS Management Console。上传公司的加密证书。在根账户中，选择启用账户所有静态存储和传输 数据加密的选项。 错误：AWS 根账户不建议用于日常操作，目没有“一輄启用所有加密”的选项。 错误：上传公司证书并启用加密的方式不符合AWS的加密最佳实践。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密静态存储的 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储。在 ALB 上附加 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 证书以加密传输中的数据。 正确：AWS KMS 是用于静态存储加密的正确服务，可以加密EBS卷和Aurora数据库。 正确：AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 是用于传输加密的正确服务，可以为ALB提供SSL/TLS证书。
explanations.D: 使用 BitLocker 加密所有静态存储数据。将公司的 TLS 证书密钥导入 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)。将 KMS 密钥附加到 ALB 以加密传输中的数据。 错误：BitLocker 是布软的加密技术，不适用于AWS栤境。 错误：KMS 不用于传输加密，ALB 的传输加密需要使用 ACM 提供的证书。

question: A company is moving its on-premises Oracle database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The database has several applications that write to the same tables. The applications need to be migrated one by one with a month in between each migration. Management has expressed concerns that the database has a high number of reads and writes. The data must be kept in sync across both databases throughout the migration. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.C: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a memory optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.D: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a compute optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select the largest tables.

explanations.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 进行初始迁移。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 创建一个变更数据捕获 (CDC) 复制 任务，并使用表映射选择所有表。 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于文件级别的数据迁移，而不是数据库迁移。对于数据库迁移，AWS DMS是更合适的工具。 错误：仅使用CDC任务无法完成初始数据加载，必须结合全量加载任务。
explanations.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 进行初始迁移。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 创建一个全量加载加变更数据捕获 (CDC) 复制任务，并使用表映射选择所有表。 错误：同样，AWS DataSync不适用于数据库迁移。 正确：全量加载加CDC任务是正确的迁移方式，但此选项仍然不使用AWS Schema Conversion Tool，无法处理架构转换问题。
explanations.C: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool 和 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)，使用内存优化的复制实例。创建一个 全量加载加变更数据捕获 (CDC) 复制任务，并使用表映射选择所有表。 正确：AWS Schema Conversion Tool可以帮助将Oracle架构转换为PostgreSQL架构，这是迁移的必要步骤。 正确：全量加载加CDC任务可以确保数据在迁移期间保持同步。 正确：内存优化的复制实例适用于高读写负载的场景。
explanations.D: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool 和 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)，使用计算优化的复制实例。创建一个 全量加载加变更数据捕获 (CDC) 复制任务，并使用表映射选择最大的表。 正确：AWS Schema Conversion Tool可以处理架构转换。 错误：计算优化的实例不适合高读写负载场景，内存优化的实例更合适。 错误：仅选择最大的表可能导致数据不完整，应该选择所有表。

question: A company has a three-tier application for image sharing. The application uses an Amazon EC2 instance for the front-end layer, another EC2 instance for the application layer, and a third EC2 instance for a MySQL database. A solutions architect must design a scalable and highly available solution that requires the least amount of change to the application. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 to host the front-end layer. Use AWS Lambda functions for the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon S3 to store and serve users’ images.
options.B: Use load-balanced Multi-AZ AWS Elastic Beanstalk environments for the front-end layer and the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon RDS DB instance with multiple read replicas to serve users’ images.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 to host the front-end layer. Use a fleet of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group for the application layer. Move the database to a memory optimized instance type to store and serve users’ images.
options.D: Use load-balanced Multi-AZ AWS Elastic Beanstalk environments for the front-end layer and the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. Use Amazon S3 to store and serve users’ images.

explanations.A: 使用 Amazon S3 托管前端层。使用 AWS Lambda 函数作为应用层。将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。使用 Amazon S3 存储勨提供用户的划片。 正确性分析：此选项需要对应用进行大量改动，包括将应用层迁移到无服务器架构（AWS Lambda）以及将关系型数据库迁移到非 关系型数据库（DynamoDB）。虽然这些服务具有高可用性和可扩展性，但改动量较大，不符合“最少改动”的要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.B: 使用负载初衡的剉勄用劉 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环刺作为前端层勨应用层。将数据库迁移到具有剉个勀读副本的 Amazon RDS DB 实例以提供用户的划片。 正确性分析：Elastic Beanstalk提供了高可用性和自动扩展功能，适合前端和应用层。但数据库部分仅提到“多个只读副本”，未提到 主实例的高可用性（如Multi-AZ），因此数据库的高可用性未完全满足要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.C: 使用 Amazon S3 托管前端层。使用 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例群作为应用层。将数据库迁移到内存优劆的实例类利以存储 勨提供用户的划片。 正确性分析：此选项将前端迁移到Amazon S3，应用层使用Auto Scaling组，具有一定的可扩展性。但数据库部分仅提到“内存优化 实例”，未提到高可用性（如Multi-AZ），因此数据库的高可用性未完全满足要求。 结论：错误。
explanations.D: 使用负载初衡的剉勄用劉 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环刺作为前端层勨应用层。将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS 剉勄用劉 DB 实 例。使用 Amazon S3 存储勨提供用户的划片。 正确性分析：Elastic Beanstalk提供了高可用性和自动扩展功能，适合前端和应用层。Amazon RDS Multi-AZ提供了数据库的高可用 性。Amazon S3用于存储和提供用户图片，符合要求。此选项改动量最小，同时满足高可用性和可扩展性需求。 结论：正确。

question: An application running on an Amazon EC2 instance in VPC-A needs to access files in another EC2 instance in VPC-B. Both VPCs are in separate AWS accounts. The network administrator needs to design a solution to configure secure access to EC2 instance in VPC-B from VPC-A. The connectivity should not have a single point of failure or bandwidth concerns. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up a VPC peering connection between VPC-A and VPC-B.
options.B: Set up VPC gateway endpoints for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B.
options.C: Attach a virtual private gateway to VPC-B and set up routing from VPC-A.
options.D: Create a private virtual interface (VIF) for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B and add appropriate routes from VPC-A.

explanations.A: Set up a VPC peering connection between VPC-A and VPC-B. 正确：VPC Peering允许两个VPC之间直接通人，即使它们属于不同的AWS账户。它是一个高带宽、低延迟的解决方案，没有单点故 障。 符合题目要求：安全、可靠的连接，没有单点故障或带宽问题。
explanations.B: Set up VPC gateway endpoints for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B. 错误：VPC Gateway Endpoints用于访问AWS服务（如S3或DynamoDB），而不是用于VPC之间的通人。 不符合题目要求：无法实现VPC-A与VPC-B之间的直接通人。
explanations.C: Attach a virtual private gateway to VPC-B and set up routing from VPC-A. 错误：Virtual Private Gateway通常用于连接VPC与本地数据中心（通过VPN或Direct Connect），而不是用于VPC之间的通人。 不符合题目要求：无法直接实现VPC-A与VPC-B之间的通人。
explanations.D: Create a private virtual interface (VIF) for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B and add appropriate routes from VPC-A. 错误：Private Virtual Interface (VIF)是Direct Connect的一部分，通常用于连接本地数据中心与AWS，而不是用于VPC之间的通人。 不符合题目要求：无法实现VPC-A与VPC-B之间的直接通人。

question: A company wants to experiment with individual AWS accounts for its engineer team. The company wants to be notified as soon as the Amazon EC2 instance usage for a given month exceeds a specific threshold for each account. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Cost Explorer to create a daily report of costs by service. Filter the report by EC2 instances. Configure Cost Explorer to send an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.B: Use Cost Explorer to create a monthly report of costs by service. Filter the report by EC2 instances. Configure Cost Explorer to send an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.C: Use AWS Budgets to create a cost budget for each account. Set the period to monthly. Set the scope to EC2 instances. Set an alert threshold for the budget. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive a notification when a threshold is exceeded.
options.D: Use AWS Cost and Usage Reports to create a report with hourly granularity. Integrate the report data with Amazon Athena. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule an Athena query. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive a notification when a threshold is exceeded.

explanations.A: 使用Cost Explorer创建按服务划分的每日成本报告，通过EC2实例过滤报告，并配置SES通知。 错误：Cost Explorer不支持直接设置阈值并发送通知。它主要用于分析和可视化成本数据，而不是实时监控和通知。
explanations.B: 使用Cost Explorer创建按服务划分的每月成本报告，通过EC2实例过滤报告，并配置SES通知。 错误：与选项A类似，Cost Explorer无法直接设置阈值并发送通知。它的功能局限于成本分析，而不是主动通知。
explanations.C: 使用AWS Budgets为每个账户创建一个成本预算，设置周期为每月，范围为EC2实例，设置警报阈值，并配置SNS主题接收通 知。 正确：AWS Budgets是专门设计用于成本监控和通知的工具。它支持设置预算、定义阈值，并通过SNS发送通知，非常适合本题需 求。
explanations.D: 使用AWS Cost and Usage Reports创建小时粒度的报告，集成Athena并使用EventBridge调度查询，配置SNS通知。 错误：虽然这种方法可以实现成本监控，但它过于复杂目成本较高，不符合题目要求的“最具成本效益”的解决方案。

question: A solutions architect needs to design a new microservice for a company's application. Clients must be able to call an HTTPS endpoint to reach the microservice. The microservice also must use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to authenticate calls. The solutions architect will write the logic for this microservice by using a single AWS Lambda function that is written in Go 1.x. Which solution will deploy the function in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure the method to use the Lambda function. Enable IAM authentication on the API.
options.B: Create a Lambda function URL for the function. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to Lambda@Edge. Integrate IAM authentication logic into the Lambda@Edge function.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to CloudFront Functions. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type.

explanations.A: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure the method to use the Lambda function. Enable IAM authentication on the API. 正确：API Gateway可以直接集成Lambda函数，并支持IAM身份验证。这种方式是最常见目高效的解决方案，特别适合需要HTTPS 端点和IAM身份验证的场景。
explanations.B: Create a Lambda function URL for the function. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type. 错误：虽然Lambda Function URL支持IAM身份验证，但它的功能较为简单，缺乏API Gateway提供的高级功能（如流量管理、缓 存、监控等）。此外，题目要求“最具操作效率”的解决方案，API Gateway更适合这种场景。
explanations.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to Lambda@Edge. Integrate IAM authentication logic into the Lambda@Edge function. 错误：Lambda@Edge主要用于内容交付优化，而不是直接处理API请求。将IAM身份验证逻辑集成到Lambda@Edge中会增加复杂 性，不符合“最具操作效率”的要求。
explanations.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to CloudFront Functions. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type. 错误：CloudFront Functions主要用于答量级的内容处理，不支持复杂的身份验证逻辑（如IAM）。此外，CloudFront Functions不 适合直接处理API请求。

question: A company previously migrated its data warehouse solution to AWS. The company also has an AWS Direct Connect connection. Corporate office users query the data warehouse using a visualization tool. The average size of a query returned by the data warehouse is 50 MB and each webpage sent by the visualization tool is approximately 500 KB. Result sets returned by the data warehouse are not cached. Which solution provides the LOWEST data transfer egress cost for the company?

options.A: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over the internet.
options.B: Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse. Access it over the internet.
options.C: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same AWS Region.
options.D: Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse and access it over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same Region.

explanations.A: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over the internet. 错误：通过互甛网传输数据会产生较高的出疛数据传输费用，因为AWS对从其服务到互甛网的出疛流量收费。 此外，互甛网连接可能会增加延迟，影响用户体验。
explanations.B: Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse. Access it over the internet. 错误：虽然工具和数据仓库在同一区域，但通过互甛网访问仍会产生出疛数据传输费用。 区域内服务之间的数据传输通常是免费的，但通过互甛网访问会导致额外费用。
explanations.C: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same AWS Region. 错误：Direct Connect确实降低了数据传输成本，但将可视化工具托管在本地仍会导致数据从AWS传输到本地的费用。 Direct Connect的优势在于减少互甛网流量费用，但仍然涉及出疛数据传输费用。
explanations.D: Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse and access it over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same Region. 正确：将可视化工具托管在与数据仓库相同的AWS区域内，并通过Direct Connect连接访问，避免了出疛数据传输费用。 区域内服务之间的数据传输通常是免费的，Direct Connect提供低延迟和高带宽连接，进一步优化成本和性能。

question: An online learning company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company maintains its student records in a PostgreSQL database. The company needs a solution in which its data is available and online across multiple AWS Regions at all times. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to a PostgreSQL cluster on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.B: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with the Multi-AZ feature turned on.
options.C: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Create a read replica in another Region.
options.D: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Set up DB snapshots to be copied to another Region.

explanations.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to a PostgreSQL cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. 错误：虽然可以在 EC2 上运行 PostgreSQL 集群，但这需要手动配置和管理跨区域复制，增加了运维开销。 不符合题目要求的“LEAST amount of operational overhead”。
explanations.B: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with the Multi-AZ feature turned on. 错误：Multi-AZ 提供高可用性，但仅限于单个区域内的故障转移，无法实现跨区域数据可用性。 不满足题目要求的“数据在痟目跨多个区域可用”。
explanations.C: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Create a read replica in another Region. 正确：Amazon RDS 支持跨区域读副本，读副本可以提供跨区域的数据可用性，并且自动管理复制过程，减少运维开销。 符合题目要求的“数据在痟目跨多个区域可用，同时运维开销最少”。
explanations.D: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Set up DB snapshots to be copied to another Region. 错误：快照复制仅用于备份目的，无法提供实时的跨区域数据可用性。 不满足题目要求的“数据在痟目跨多个区域可用”。

question: A company hosts its web application on AWS using seven Amazon EC2 instances. The company requires that the IP addresses of all healthy EC2 instances be returned in response to DNS queries. Which policy should be used to meet this requirement?

options.A: Simple routing policy
options.B: Latency routing policy
options.C: Multivalue routing policy
options.D: Geolocation routing policy

explanations.A: Simple routing policy 简单路由策略 错误。简单路由策略会返回一个单一的IP地址，而不是所有健康的EC2实例的IP地址。因此不符合题目要求。
explanations.B: Latency routing policy 延迟路由策略 错误。延迟路由策略会根据用户与资源之间的延迟选择最佳的资源，而不是返回所有健康的EC2实例的IP地址。
explanations.C: Multivalue routing policy 多值路由策略 正确。多值路由策略可以返回多个健康资源的IP地址，符合题目要求。
explanations.D: Geolocation routing policy 地理位置路由策略 错误。地理位置路由策略会根据用户的地理位置返回资源，而不是返回所有健康的EC2实例的IP地址。

question: A medical research lab produces data that is related to a new study. The lab wants to make the data available with minimum latency to clinics across the country for their on-premises, file-based applications. The data files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that has read-only permissions for each clinic. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic
options.B: Migrate the files to each clinic's on-premises applications by using AWS DataSync for processing.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic.
options.D: Attach an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to each clinic's on-premises servers.

explanations.A: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic 正确：AWS Storage Gateway文件网关允许本地应用程序通过标准文件协议（如NFS或SMB）访问Amazon S3中的数据，提供低延迟 访问。 符合题目要求：文件网关可以直接与Amazon S3交互，满足诊所的文件访问需求。
explanations.B: Migrate the files to each clinic’s on-premises applications by using AWS DataSync for processing 错误：AWS DataSync主要用于数据迁移，而不是提供实时低延迟访问。 不符合题目要求：题目要求的是“最低延迟访问”，而不是数据迁移。
explanations.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic 错误：卷网关主要用于块存储（iSCSI协议），适用于数据库或应用程序的块级存储需求，而不是文件级访问。 不符合题目要求：诊所需要文件级访问，而不是块存储。
explanations.D: Attach an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to each clinic’s on-premises servers 错误：Amazon EFS是一个区域性服务，无法直接附加到分布在全国的诊所的本地服务器。 不符合题目要求：EFS无法满足跨区域的低延迟访问需求。

question: A company is using a content management system that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance contains both the web server and the database software. The company must make its website platform highly available and must enable the website to scale to meet user demand. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the database to Amazon RDS, and enable automatic backups. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer in the Availability Zone, and set the two instances as targets.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora instance with a read replica in the same Availability Zone as the existing EC2 instance. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer, and set the two EC2 instances as targets.
options.C: Move the database to Amazon Aurora with a read replica in another Availability Zone. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.
options.D: Move the database to a separate EC2 instance, and schedule backups to Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the original EC2 instance.
